tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dang po/

klad kyi don bshad pa/ ༄༅/ /oswa sti sidhaṃ/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thub dbang zhabs rdul mgos mchod nas/ /spyod phyogs gling bzhi bshad do zhes/ /de gsung smṛ ti'i lugs bzhin bri/ /dge bsam yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ de'ang le'u bcu las le'u dang po'i sdom ni/ bu mo klu sgrub ded dpon dang*/ / rgyal po nor bzang mdza' bo'i bu/ / tshangs pa legs skyes khron pa'i mi/ / dge slong dga' byed phra'u dang*// byams pa'i stobs dang bcu gsum mo/ / gnyis pa/ gzhung gi don bshad pa/ ka1 le'u dang po'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ phyag 'os kun la'ang gus par phyag 'tshal te/ zhes pa'i skabs su/ byang sems kyis/ nyan rang la sogs yul dman pa la phyag bya ba ma yin te/ dper na rgyal po ma skyes dgras gnas brtan 'od srung sogs nyan thos rnams pho brang du gdugs tshod la gdan drangs pa na/ rgyal po'i sras mo lo bcu drug lon pa mdzes sdug gcig yod pa khri las mi ldang ba la/ rgyal pos/ 'phags pa 'di 'dra ba byon dus phyag sogs mi byed pa khyod ni dman pa'i gnas so zhes smras pas/ bu mo na re/ yab rang yang smad pa'i gnas so zer ro/ / de ci dris pas/ / 'khor lo sgyur rgyal mtshan dang rab ldan pas/ / phal pa rnams la phyag sogs mi byed ltar/ / rgyal po'i sras mo mtshan dang rab ldan pas/ / phal pa rnams la phyag sogs mi byed ltar/ / rgyal ba'i sras po mtshan dang rab ldan pas/ / nyan rang rnams la phyag byed ga la 'gyur/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang sems dang*/ 'khor lo sgyur bas yab de nyid kyi gdung 'tshob nus pa'i phyir ro// kho mo yang byang sems yin pas nyan rang la phyag mi 'tshal zhes zer ro/ / gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu/ /bhe ta'i yul grong khyer dzhe tar bram ze rnal 'byor rgyal ba'i lha'i chen ma blo ldan ma la bu blo gros 'phags btsas te/

mtshan mkhan la bstan pas/ tshe ring na ston pa gnyis pa gcig ste/ tshe zhag bdun las med zer ba la/ klus shis pa brjod pas lo bdun du gyur/ yang rma bya chen mo bsgrubs pas lo bco lngar gyur pa'i tshe/ chun ma gzugs ldan ma'i bram ze mnyes par byas te/ bdag gi bu bsod nams 'phags la sman gyi mnga' thang gnang bar zhu byas pas/ thub chod du sbyin du mi rung bas thabs kyis sbyin no/ / zhes de la gso rigs kyi man ngag thams cad yongs rdzogs su bslabs tshar ba dang*/ blo gros 'phags pa dang rgan pas zhag gsum na khyed gnyis su mkhas pa zhig la mnga' thang thams cad gtod do slobs shig zer ro// der yum ngo gnag pa'i rgyu dris pas/ gong ltar bsnyad/ khyod bu thu bo yin yang srid mi thob pa la ma dga' zer/ mi dgyes mi 'tshal gyis mar me sta gon mdzod cig zer nas/ nub dang po la yab kyi bzhed pa gcig/ gnyis pa la yab kyi nor ba/ gsum pa la yin lugs bzhin rtogs nas/ nyin gsum rim bzhin bshad pas/ nu bos ye ma spobs pa/ yum gnyis ngo log pa'i tshe/ phu bos yab yum mi dgyes mi 'tshal gyis srid kho la gtod la/ bdag rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas dgyes te gnang nas/ na len+d+rar sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po la rab tu byung ste/ gnas lnga thams cad lan re gzigs pa'am gsan pas mkhyen kyang*/ bco lnga'i lo grangs tshang nas/ dpal gyi rir mya ngan gyi gling du 'grengs pas/ sa ra has dris pa na/ zhag bdun las tshe med zer bas/ ngas rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub sbyin gyis/ rtse lngar 'jam dpal la zhus la/ 'chi med sgron ma la gsol ba thob gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pas/ zhag lnga na mthong lam gyi yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis mngon du gyur te/ tshe'i dngos grub brnyes nas 'dzam bu gling du byon pas mu ge chen po 'dug nas/ de bskyab pa'i phyir dbyu gu ma mched gsum bsgrubs pas/ mnal lam du zangs gling du song la|

gser 'gyur slobs gsung rmis nas/ sang ri sul zhig tu sku khams seng du byon pa'i tshe/ sbrul nag cig gis sbrul dkar cig ded de/ drung du slebs pa dang*/ shing lo zhig sbor bskus pas 'phur/ me tog cig mgor bskus pas babs pa/ yang ded pas 'bras bu zhig khar bcug pas mi snang bar song ste/ slob dpon gyis kyang de gsum grar btums te shing los 'phur/ me tog gi zangs gling du babs te/ gser byin la slobs byas pas 'phel du dwogs nas ma byin/ 'dir thon pa ci yin zer/ shing lo 'di'i mthu byas pas/ de ster na bslab zer/ byin te lobs pa dang gra gsaib kyi shing los 'phur ba ded pa zin khar 'bras bus bsgribs nas/ me tog gis babs te/ bu mo gtsang ma'i gser khrag btang zhes pa la/ de'i lag nas byung ba'i g.ya' bskrus pa btang yang ma grub par/ mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba btab pas bzo gnas su bu mo rlung gis sngangs te 'goms pas gser mdung snad pa'i khrag lugs phor du lhung ste/ rtsi grub nas/ dngos po gang la des reg tshad gser du 'gyur te/ phyis dpe de bzhin du/ byang sems skyes tshad sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar dgongs nas/ sa ra has/ dngos grub mchog gi rdzas gcig gis/ / dngos gang gser du gyur pa ltar/ / byang chub mchog gis sems gcig gis/ / lus can rgyal ba'i skur 'gyur ro/ / zhes so/ / 'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos/ / ded dpon legs sgrol zhes pas gzings chen tshong pa mang po dang bcas te rgya mtshor phyin pas/ rlung gi drod tshad ma zin par mtsho'i gur du chad do/ / de na sngar yang tshong pa mang po shi ba'i rus pa mang po 'dug nas/ rab tu mi dga' zhing smre sngags mang po ston nas ngu ba la/ ded dpon gyis nyin par tshong pa rnams kyi sems gso ba'i phyir thabs yod do/ / zha ེ sa smras shing*/ mtshan mo ni de'i thabs kho na la rtog pa'i tshe/ skabs der de na shing ring po gcig la/

bya kha cig chags 'dug pas/ tshong dpon gyis bya skad shes te nyan pas/ sngar med pa'i bya mgron po gnyis ni shin tu tshon/ gzhi bya rnams ni rid pa la/ gzhi bya na re/ mgron po khyed tsho ba ji ltar yin zer/ mgron po na re/ nged ni rgyal po bsod nams can gyi 'bras chan la sogs pa'i lhag ma za'o zer/ mgron po na re/ gzhi bya khyed rid pa ci nyes zer/ nged ni rdai'u dkar nag las zar med do zer/ der tshong dpon gyis rgyal po de la nged tshong pa 'di tsam zhig mtsho gur 'di lta bur chud pas/ khyed la thabs yod na 'don dgos zer ba'i yi ge mgron bya'i sker mtshan mo ma tshor bar btags pa rgyal pos mthong nas rnga gdungs te tshong pa 'di lta bu 'don nus pa byung na rgyal srid phyed sbyin no/ / zhes bsgrags pas/ bram ze rdzu 'phrul can zhig na re/ rgyal srid tsam mi 'dod yul gru drug 'dod pas ngas 'don zer bas rgya mtsho'i steng na phar rdzu 'phrul gyis phyin pas/ tshong pa kun srin po sogs byung snyam nas skrag pa la/ tshong dpon de na re/ ngas bya la than btang yod pas/ 'u cag 'don pa yin srid kyis/ ma 'jigs shig smras pas/ gam du slebs pa dang*/ 'don mkhan yin te/ khyed rnams las gang rung gcig lus pas gzhan thams cad thon par bya'o/ / zer bas/ ded dpon gyis sdod par byas khas blangs so/ / der bram ze na re/ 'dir sdod pa des brag khung 'di ni gser gyi rnga gcig yod pa rdungs shig zer ba bzhin brdungs pas/ de na bya mang po yod pa kun 'grogs pa'i rlung shugs kyis gzings skyod nas thon zhing*/ rjes su tshong dpon yang thon no/ / sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang*/ grong khyer nyer ldan zhes bya bar/ yab rgyal po dri med sgra dang*/ yum btsun mo dge ldan ma gnyis/ shin tu sras kyis 'phongs pa la/ rgyal pos phyogs de'i drang srong mngon shes can zhig yod pa la dris pa/

bdag la ye nas bu'i skal ba med dam/ 'on te rkyen gyis btsas ma btub pa ci lags zhus pas/ drang srong na re/ rgyal po chen po khyed kyi bu skal ni sa phyogs 'di na bram ze bsam gtan byed pa zhig yod de/ de tshe'i dus byas nas rgyal po'i sras su skye'o zhes smras pa dang*/ rgyal po 'dod pa can sras rings pa'i dbang gis/ bram ze dus ma yin par 'tsho ba dang phral btang bas rgyal po'i sras su skye bar ma btub par skye ba gzhan blangs so/ / yang rgyal pos drang srong la smras pa/ bram ze tshe'i dus byas kyang*/ bdag gi sras su skyer ma btub pa ci zhus pas/ drang srong gis smras pa/ dus ma yin par srog dang phral bas lan gyis/ da lcags ri me 'bar ba'i kha na ri bong dmar skya rna ba g.yon pa gtum pa zhig skyes te/ de tshe 'phos ma thag rgyal po'i sras su skye'o zhes smras pas/ yang rgyal pos yul khams kyi mi mang po bzlog nas bshor bas/ ri bong dmar skya rna ba g.yon pa gtum pa zhig byung ba bsad do/ / ri bong des yid la smod pa bor ba/ nga lung stong du su la mi gnod pa'i rtswa za/ chu 'thung ba la rgyal po 'dis mi mang po bsdus nas bdag bsad pas/ nga tshe 'phos nas/ rgyal po khyed kyi gshed ma byed par gyur cig ces so/ / de tshe 'phos ma thag yum dge ldan ma'i mngal du zhugs te/ mngal na gnas tsam na/ sha kho na 'dod pa la/ sha gzhan ni ma phan/ yab kyi khrag cig btar nas btang bas so/ / der lo dus su bltams pa'i ming ni rgyal bu nor bu 'dzin zhes bya bar btags so/ / rgyal bu de ma ma du mas bskyangs te skyed bsrings nas/ skabs skabs la rgyal po'i spyan sngar phyag 'tshal du 'ongs pa las/ rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po de rnams mthong ste/dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig la dris pa/ yab kyi phun sum tshogs pa 'di rnams bdag gis nam 'thob/ rgyal po nam 'das pa'i tshe 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes smras pas/

rgyal bu chags shing brkam pas/ yab la mtshon bsnun pas/ yum gyis nga la ma skyes pa'i dgra zhig skyes so byas pas/ ma skyes dgrar grags so/ / de'i rkyen gyis yum grongs/ dgra bcom ma ut+pa la'i mdog nyes med du bsad/ de bzhin gshegs pa bkrongs 'dod kyi khrag phyung*/ dge 'dun phyes te/mtshams med lnga ka'ang byas par grags so/ / blon po rnams kyi rgyal bu spyi gtol can 'di la rgyal srid byin rgyu min na'ang*/ da sras 'theb mi gnang bas byin zer nas byin no/ / dus zhig na rgyal po de ri dwags bshor du phyin pas/ nags na drang sraung zhig dang phrad nas smras pa/ 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis khyod la ci zhig bya zhes dris pas/ drang srong gis smras pa/rgyal po chen po bdag dkon mchog gsum la brten nas 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub 'tshol ba'i dka' thub kyi sdug bsngal 'di lta bu ni bzod kyis/ khyod tshe 'di'i 'dod pa tsam gyi phyir pha ma sogs bsad nas mnar med pa'i dmyal bar 'gro ba 'di ni bdag gis mi bzod kyis/ zhes smras pa dang*/ drang srong chen po lha dkon mchog gsum bya ba ci yin/ sdig pa pha ma bsad pa sogs cir 'gyur/ de dag spangs pas 'bras bu ci 'thob dris pas/ drang srong gis las rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang du bshad pas/ shin tu 'gyod kyang mthong chos su 'bras bu me dbal gyis btab ste/ lus kyi mdog dbyibs thams cad mi sdug par gyur/ rnag gi dri mas sa'i phyogs thams cad gang*/ dngos su lus sems dmyal ba ltar sdug bsngal ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' la da ste zhag bdun na sa'i bar bye ste lus 'di nyid kyis mnar med du 'gro'o zhes thos pas/ sdug bsngal chen pos skrag nas ston pa drug la sdig bshags thams cad dris pas ma shes pa na/ bu 'tsho byed na re sangs rgyas kyi sar phyin na 'di las thar nges zer/ sangs rgyas dag pa/ dgra bcom dag pas bskor ba'i drung du/

bdag dmyal ba'i lus kyis ji ltar 'gro bar nus zer/ sangs rgyas ni shā ri'i bu dang lam chung la'ang chos mtshungs par ston/ gsal rgyal dang dbul po yin mnyam du sbyong*/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang lha byin la'ang thugs mnyam par gnas na ji ltar mi 'gro zer/ 'o na bden pa mthong na ngan 'gror mi 'gro bar gsungs pas/ 'u gnyis glang chen zhig la bzhon la nga lhung na zungs shig zer te phyin nas/ mtha' gcig na yod pa la lan gnyis 'bod kyang nga min snyam pa'i tshe/ gsum pa la rgyal chen ma skyes dgra zhes gsungs pas dga' ches nas lan de'u re ma thebs pa la/ khyod kyis mtshams med pa byas sam/ btsun pa med lags so/ /de dag gshogs shig/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa so sor bshags shing slar yang mi bgyid do/ / zhes pas/ rgyal rigs bzang po rang sdig tu ma zad thams cad kyi bshags pa legs so/ / zhes sdig pa kun dag nas bzod pa thob bo/ /der 'jam dpal la 'di'i 'gyod pa sol cig ces pas/ 'jam dpal gyis mtshams med lnga byas pa bden lags sam byas pas/ blo gros chen po mad lags so/ / gang gis byas sems kyis bslang nas lus kyis so/ / slong mkhan de phyi nang gang na/ mdog dbyibs ci 'dra zhes brtags pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par mkhyen nas 'khrul ngo'i sdig 'bras thams cad bdag la smin la/ de dag thams cad kyis byang chub thob par gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi de nyid mngon du gyur nas sa drug gi rtogs pa 'khrungs pa dang*/ nam mkhar/ ma skyes dgras ni mtshams med sdig byas pa'ang*/ / sems gcig gis ni rnal 'byor grol la ltos/ /zhes so/ /byams mgon blo dang ldan pas nor bzang bshad/ /sdong po bkod pa'i mdor/ grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas su/ /tshong dpon nor rten gyi bu nor bzang gis 'jam dpal la sems bskyed de/ bslab bya bstsal ba'i phyir mthar gyis byams pa'i drung du song ba dang*/

de lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram khang pa brtsegs pa rnam par snang mdzad rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snying po zhes pa'i phyogs gcig na 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus na chos ston pa rgyang ring po nas mthong nas/ khye'u de yang*/ dga' ba dang gus pa bskyed de lus thams cad kyis phab ste phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'phags pa byams pas kyang phyag g.yas pa glang po che'i sna ltar brkyangs nas gzhon nu de 'khor kun la ngoms pa'i tshul du bstan nas smras pa| ltos shig bsam pa yongs su dag pa 'di/ / nor bzang nor rnams rab tu brtan pa'i bu/ / byang chub spyod pa dam pa yongs 'tshol zhing*/ / mkhas pa nga yi drung du legs par 'ongs/ / legs par 'ongs sam snying rje'i byang chub khyod/ / byams pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs par legs 'ongs sam/ / legs par 'ongs sam lta na rab zhi ba/ / spyad pa spyod tshe dub pa ma gyur tam/ / rnam dag bsam ldan tshur shog 'ongs pa legs/ / skye med yid ldan tshur shog 'ongs pa legs//

dbang po ma zhum tshur shog 'ongs pa legs/ / spyad pa spyod tshe dub pa med grang ngo*/ / zhes sogs yon tan gyi bsngags pa brjod pa tshigs su bcad pa mang po gsungs pa dang*/ nor bzang gis byams pa'i g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba lan gsum byas/ mdun du thal mo sbyar nas smras pa/ 'phags pa/ bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu zhugs na/ de'i bslab pa la ji ltar bslab par bgyi ba dang*/ ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal bas bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ rigs kyi bu khyod ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba'o/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi sems ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ / 'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po 'phel bas zhing lta bu'o/ / 'jig rten rab tu brten pas sa lta bu'o/ / zhes bya ba nas/ rtsi dang sman dang rin po che la sogs pa dpe bdun cu lhag dang bcas pa gsungs pa'i nang nas 'di dag ci rigs par 'byung ba yin no/ / sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam/ /gang po'i rtogs brjod btags par/ pha ma tshangs dang slob dpon te/ / mkhas pas pha ma bkur byas nas/ / tshe 'dir kun gyis bstod 'gyur la/ / phyi mar bde 'gro dga' bde 'thob/ / ces pa la/ dge slong dag gis pha ma'i bkur sti de tsam du ci bzang zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bka' bstsal pa/ 'das pa'i dus su nga nyon mongs pa las ma grol ba de'i tshe/ ma la gnod pa chung ngus sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ba nyon cig/ dge slong dag 'das pa'i dus na wā rā ṇa sīr ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu byung ngo cog shi nas/ bram ze mtshan brtag pa la mkhas pa zhig na re/ da bu skyes na bu mo'i ming thogs shig 'tsho zer nas/ ring po ma lon par bud med sems can dang ldan pa ded dpon la gsol bas dgyes te/ bud med khang bzangs kyi steng gi cha la skyes pa med par gcig pur nyams rangs su bzhag/ sgra yid du mi 'ong ba mi thos par byas/

zas ha cang kha ba min pa sogs byin/ khye'u nas khye'u'i steng du 'gro bar byas te rkang pa sa la 'jog tu mi 'jug pa sogs sbrum ma'i rim gro cher byas pas/ zla ba bcu na khye'u gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa lta na sdug pa/ mgo bo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba| smin ma 'jam pa/ sna'i gzings mtho ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa btsas te btsas ston rgya cher byas nas mdza' bo'i bu mor ming btags so/ / pha rgya mtshor shi nas/ mas skyed de/ pha'i las dris pas/ drang por smras na shir dwogs nas/ 'bru/ spos/ gos/ rin chen 'tshong bas so zhes pas/ rim bzhin de dag gi rnyed pa ka sha pa ne bzhi brgyad bcu drug so gnyis rnyed pa ma la phul nas tshong pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig chas pa la mas ngu zhing rkang pa la 'jus kyang mgor rdog pa bsnun nas song ba la/ mas bu khyod la de'i rnam par smin par ma gyur cig ces so/ / der gru nya mid kyis bcom nas tshal pa gcig la 'jus pas thon nas rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin pas/ grong khyer dga' ba/ dga' byed/ stag myos/ tshangs pa'i bla ma zhes pa bzhir lha'i bu mo bzhi/ brgyad/ bcu drug /so gnyis kyis bsus nas/ lo de snyed kyi bar du lha'i dga' bde myong ngo*/ / de nas lho phyogs su ma 'gro zhes bkag kyang 'gro 'dod nas/ phyin pa dang*/ lcags kyi khang pa zhig gi nang du tshud nas sgo rang 'grig ste/ nang na mi bo che zhig gi mgo bo la 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rnag khrag gis 'tsho ba mthong nas dris pas ma la rdaug pas bsnun 'bras zer/ 'o na bdag kyang las des 'dir khrid do snyam pa dang*/ nam mkha' las dga' ba dang ni dga' byed dang*/ / rtag myos tshangs pa'i bla ma rnams/ / spangs nas ci phyir khyod 'dir 'ongs/ / zhes grags pa dang*/ las kyi dbang gis 'ongs so zhes pa dang*/ bcings pa grol zhing*/ grol ba 'ching bar 'gyur ro zer ba dang*/ de 'phags nas bu mo'i mgo bo la 'khor ro/

de las thar pa de la 'di ji tsam zhig 'khor dris pas lo drug khri dang drug stong zer/ 'o na thar dka'o snyam nas yi mug ste/ 'dir gzhan 'ong ngam byas pas/ 'di'i las su bsags thams cad 'ong zer/ rang la dpag nas gzhan gces kyi snying rje skyes te/ 'di lta bu myong nges kyi las 'bras bsags pa thams cad bdag la smin la da 'dir su'ang 'ongs par ma gyur cig ces brjod ma thag tu/ 'khor lo de byang sems mdza' bo'i bu mo'i mgo las ta la bdun srid tsam du 'phags te shi nas dga' ldan du skyes so/ /dge slong dag ma la pa ne me phul 'bras grong khyer bzhir dga' bde myong la/ gnod pa de tsam gyis klad pa gshog pa'i sdug bsngal myong ngo*/ / zhes so/ / tshangs pa la yang 'di yod dam/ tshangs pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi skye ba rgyun mi 'chad par gyur cig ces smon lam btab pas/ btab pa bzhin skye ba rgyun ma chad snyam pas sems can thams cad kho'i bu yin bsams nas sems can thams cad la tshad sgom pa'o/ / phan btags lan lon gang yin pa| | grong khyer bzang po'i dpal du/ rgyal po lha gnas zhes pas/ bu stong yul so sor rgyal bran la btsud nas/ tha chung dge gnas zhes pa mi dang mi ma yin kun gyis bkur ba zhig yod pa skyed mos tshal na yod pa'i tshe/ gnod sbyin gcig pa gting nas 'thon ste/ mkhyen par mdzod gcig blon po dgra gcan blo ba ring bas yab bsad de rgyal por zhu na/ rgyal phran thams cad bsad nyid kyang gsod du 'ong bas myur du bros shig zer bas sngangs te/ 'bros pa'i lam du bu legs skyes zhes pa'i lo bdun pa de 'dug pa blangs pas btsun mo na re ji ltar rigs zer/ rgyu mtshan bsnyad pas bdag kyang 'chi ba zhu zer te phyin pas/ btab pas ring lam du song ste/ mi gcig gi zhag gcig gi rgyags la gsum gyis zos pas zad nas/ bu sdug 'di 'phangs pas/ btsun mo gsad la gsol snyam ste/

gting nas ral gri gzas pas/ bus thal mo sbyar te/ min par bdag 'gum du gsol zhes yang yang gsol te/ de'ang da lta bsad kyang rul nas phan mi thogs kyis/ gson po la gang ran bcad na ring du thub bo zhes pa bzhin byas te/ sha kun zad kyang da dung mi gtol bar shes te/ ral gris btub pa'i bar gyi sha dang*/ mig la sogs pa khyer te phyin pas bu na re bdag dbug pa cung zad rgyu ba 'di la'ang bag tsam byin la byon zer ba bzhin byas ste song ba dang*/ bus bdag gi lus kyi sha tshun chad pha ma la phul ba 'dis/ ma 'ongs pa na bdag gis sems can thams cad skyob byed sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig/ ces smos pas/ gnam sa drug tu g.yos te/ lha rnams kyang mngon shes kyis babs nas/ snying rjes ngu zhing me tog 'thor/ brgya byin gyis nyams sad pa'i phyir sprang por sprul nas de'i sha cung zad de yang blangs pas byin no/ / yang stag sogs gcan gzan gdug pa can mang por sprul nas/ mchong zhing*/ ngar sgras za bar brtsams pas/ da bdag la sha ni med/ rus pa dang chu rgyus dang rkang mar dang klad pa la sogs pa 'di dag gis khyed tshims nas ma 'ongs pa na chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par byed par gyur cig ces bsngos nas/ da bdag gi lus don yod par bya'o/ /snyam pa'i bsam pa brgya byin gyis shes te/ rang gzugs bstan pa khyod 'di lta bu'i sgyur rgyal lam tshangs sogs kyi 'dod byas pas/ bdag 'khor ba'i bde 'bras gang yang mi 'dod kyis/ bsod nams 'dis sems can thams cad skyob byed sangs rgyas thob par 'dod ces so/ / 'o na khyod sha tshun chad byin pa la mi 'gyod dam zer/ 'gyod pa sdug bsngal tsam med do zer/ de la dpang po su yod zer/ bdag la 'gyod pa med cing dga' sems yod na/ lus sngar bzhin gyur te/ mthar sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig/ 'gyod cing khro sems yod na da lta nyid du shi nas mnar med du ltung bar gyur cig ces brjod ma thag tu/

lus sngar bzhin gyur te gzi brjid dpal dang ldan par gyur te/ pha ma dang grong khyer de'i skye bo kun 'dus nas ngo mtshar du bsgrags shing*/ mgrin gcig tu/ byas shes drin du gzo ba'i mi/ /rang gi lus la'ang ma chags par/ / phan btags lan ldon gang yin pa/ / 'di 'dra kun gyis bsngags par 'os/ /zhes so/ / des nas yul de'i rgyal pos/ yab yum sras gsum pho brang du khrid de bkur sti sna tshogs byas nas/ rgyal bu de la thugs brtse bas g.yul bshams te/ sgra gcan bstan te yab sras gnyis ka sngar gyi rgyal sa btsud de rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs so/ / yang bi ha ta zhes pa'i grong khyer stongs shul gyi thang stong kyi khron par/ mi gcig /khra gcig /byi ba gcig/sbrul gcig ste bzhi lhung nas yun ring por/ grang skyes sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba na/ phyogs der mi gcig 'ongs pas mthong nas thabs sna tshogs kyis snying rjes bton pa na/ de bzhi na re/ khron pa gting zab 'di nas nged kyi srog byin pas drin lan bya'o zer/ mis yong srid/ dud 'gro khyed gsum la re dus mi yong zhes khyad du bsad pas/ phyis mi de phongs nas nags khrod du rngon pa la phyin pas/ sngar gyi khra dang phrad nas/ grogs po ci byed zer/ phongs nas rngon pa byed ces pas/ sngar gyi drin lan bya zer nas/ rgyal po'i btsun mo skra 'khrud pa'i bar la rgyan rnams khyer te byin no/ / mis nga la khras rgyan byin zhes rang gis khron pa nas bton pa'i mi de la smras pas/ rgyal pos grong khyer pa'i skye bo rnams la nga'i btsun mo'i rgyan sus khyer shes pa byung na bya dga' sbyin no smras pas/ mi ngan des sngar srog bton pa'i drin ni brjed/ drin lan bya'o zhes pa'i tshig ni rtswa bzhin spangs nas/ don de rgyal po la smras so/ / rgyal pos mi de bzung nas khri mon du bcug bza' btung srog zin tsam las lhags pa gdams te nyams thag pa'i tshe/

sngar gyi byi bas mthong bas bza' rgyu bskyal lo/ /sbrul gyis rgyal po'i lus la 'khyud pa dang*/ kha rlangs kyis skrangs te/ spra mkhan rnams la rtsis byas pas sbrul 'di ni btson de'i bsrung ma ste/ brtson 'di btang na sbrul 'di 'gro zer ba bzhin sngar gyi nor rnams kyang byin nas btang ngo*/ / dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs pa/ tshe dang ldan pa mo'u 'gal gyi bus sems can dmyal ba'i nang du phyin pa na/ sems can lus che ba/ kha nas me lce byung ste/ lcags kyi sa gzhi 'bar ba me lce gcig tu gyur pa'i steng du brgyangs nas/ lcags kyi phur pa 'bar bas thang sha bcad cing de'i lce la rmos do stong byung ste/ de rnams kyi rmig pa thams cad spu gri'i so 'dra ba me lce gcig tu gyur pa ste/ de dag gis phyogs gang du gom pa bor ba de'i phyogs de dang der kun du gcod cing gtub la/ gzhi des sdug bsngal drag po mi zad pa'i tshor ba nyams su myong ba gcig mthong ngo*/ / de nas bsam pa/ 'di lta bu rgyu ci las byung zhes snyam par bzhag kyang*/ dmyal ba nas dmyal ba kho nar yang yang skyes pa tsam las/ las cis skyes ma shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ bdag 'chag pa na 'di lta bu'i dmyal ba mthong lags pa/ las ci las gyur gsung du gsol/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na sangs rgyas bgrod pa ma nyams pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i tshe dge slong sde snod gsum pa rig pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa/ chos smra ba 'khor dang ldan pa zhig rgyal po'i pho brang zhig na rten zhing gnas te/ de de na mchod par bya ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de'i tshe dge slong dgra bcom pa sde snod gsum rig pa sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa zhig phyogs der song ba na/ de 'ba' zhig la skya bo rnams bkur bstir bya bar sems kyi/ sngar gyi sde snod gsum pa la ni ma yin no/

/ des bsams pa dge slong 'di 'dir ma 'ongs pa'i tshe bdag rnyed grags dang ldan pa la/ 'di 'ongs nas de lta ma yin te/ 'di med na bdag rnyed grags snga ma kho na bzhin du 'gyur pas/ bdag gis ci nas kyang 'di 'dir mi 'dug par bya'o/ / snyam te/ dge slong 'di ni tshul khrims 'chal ba'o/ /zhes sogs phyar ka btang bas/ skye bo kun kyang dgra bcom de la mi lta bar gyur te/ dgra bcom des kyang don de go nas gzhan du song ngo*/ /dge slong dag de ji mnyam du sems/ de'i tshe mdo sde gsum par gyur pa de dmyal ba de yin te/ sangs rgyas bgrod pa ma nyams pa'i ring nas/ da lta nga'i bar du sems can dmyal ba las shi 'phos shing yang dmyal ba 'ba' zhig tu skyes so/ / gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das sems can de sdug bsngal de las nam thar par 'gyur/ bka' stsal pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na sangs rgyas bla ma zhes bya ba 'jig rten du 'byung ste/ de'i tshe sems can dmyal ba las shi 'phos nas mi lus thob te/ de'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ dgra bcom pa mngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ / skur ba mang bar yang 'gyur te/ de gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang der bskur ba 'phrad par 'gyur te/ de kho nas skyo bar gyur nas phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ / 'on te gang zhig yid rab dang byed na/ gsang chen du/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'dod chags kyi dra ba shes rab kyi mtshon gyis dral na/ ma chags pa'i zhing dag par 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa'i tshe/ byang sems dga' byed yang dag 'jog las bzhengs te/ mnyan yod du bsod snyoms kyi phyir gshegs pa tshong dpon dpal gyi bu mo dpal yon can gyis mthong nas bsod snyoms thogs ta ེ phyin pas/ dga' byed zhi zhing dul ba byad gzugs mdzes pa la mig tshugs su bltas pas/ lhag par chags te/ dran pa nyams la/ dga' ba byed kyang tshul min gyi rtog pas myos kyang yud tsam na dran pa rnyed nas chags par bya byed la brtag pas/

chags 'gyur gyi chos gang yang ma dmigs te/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas/ ta la bdun srid du 'phags nas rgyal byed du 'phags pa dang*/ kun dga' bo la bka' bstsal pa/ dga' byed kyis 'dod chags kyi sems la brten nas bdud sde bcom zhing 'khor lo bskor zhes so/ / dpal yon can 'dod chags kyis gdungs te/ de nyid du 'greng bzhin du dus byas nas/ rtsa gsum du skyes ma thag tu/ rin chen gzhal yas khang dpag tshad bcu gnyis par zhabs 'bring pa lha'i bu mo khri byung ba dran pas shes te/ chags sems la 'di lta na/ de la dad sems kyis mchod pa bya'o snyam nas/ lha'i bu mo lnga brgya dang lhan cig me tog sogs kyis mchod cing*/ phyag 'tshal te/ lan bdun bskor nas tshigs su bcad pa du mas bstod do/ /de'i pha ma dag dga' byed kyis byad stem byas so zhes cho nges 'debs shing khro sems kyis bskur ba 'debs la/

bzhams dgos glengs nas sdig pa bshags te phyag 'tshal nas/ pha ma sogs dpal yon gyi nye du lnga brgya dga' byed la sems bskyed do/ / des na byang sems kyi spyod pa la dad par bya'o/ / rgyal sras rnams la do gal chen pos kyang*/ / skye rabs las/ ston pa ni sngon nags khrod dpal dang ldan pa zhig na gcig pur rgyu ba'i spre'u zhig tu gyur pa'i tshe/ phyogs der ba gtor ba 'tshol ba'i mi gcig lam 'chol te 'khyams pa gcig bkres pas g.yang kha'i gting du 'bras bu smin pa'i ljid kyis g.yang phyogs su dud pa gcig la 'dzegs pas/ shing rtser sleb la khad pa dang sgra dang bcas te chag nas/ g.yang du chu 'khyil ba gcig gi steng du lhung bas/ ma snad par langs te ltas pas gang nas kyang thar sa ma rnyed par smre sngags 'don pa spre'us gsan nas khyod thar dka' ba'i g.yang sa 'dir ci byed dris pa'i lan du/ sngar gyi lo rgyus gleng te/ thal mo sbyar nas bdag gi skyabs mdzad du gsol zhes pas/ sems dpa' des snying rjes dbugs phyung ste/ rdo ba mi'i ljid tsam la sbyangs nas mchongs te mi de steng du bton pas chad de/ rang nyid ngang rgyud bzang zhing mi de la drin gyis khyab pas/ gnod pa byas su dogs pa med par/ ngas rdo leb 'di'i steng du nyal gyis/ gcan gzan sogs gnod pa srungs shig byas te bag phab nas gnyid log pa la/ ngan sems skyes te lam rgyags bya bar 'dod nas/ spre mgo la rdo 'phangs kyang*/ kho nyams stobs chung zhing 'khyar bas rdo zur phog nas rto leb la 'phar ba'i sgras gnyid sad nas/ mchongs stabs su langs te bltas pas/ mi de skyengs shing skrag pas smra ma nus par 'dug pa la/ khong rang gnad pa'i sdug bsngal la mi gzigs par/ mi de la yi chad de/ snying rjes bltas nas/ khyod mir gyur kyang byas pa mi gzo bar 'di ltar byed pa/ da khyod la yid brtan du mi rung yang*/ khyod nyams nyes na mi rung gis byas te/

grong 'dabs su legs par bskyal lo/ / de nas mi de mthong chos kyis myur bar mdzes zin pa kun gyis spangs te/ 'brog dgon pa zhig na mi gzugs su ma shes par 'dug pa la/ yul de'i rgyal po ri dwags shor ba la/ shur ba'i gong bu rnag khrag gis sbags shing dri nga ba de mthong bas dngangs ste/ khyod 'dre'am/ nyi tshe ba ni ci dris pas/ mi la lags te/ 'di lta bu'i rgyu ni/ byams pa snying rings byas pa yi/ / me tog tsam gcig 'dir smin te/ / 'jig rten gzhan du gnag dka' ba'i/ / dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal slad kyis 'chi/ /zhes zer ro//de nas sems dpa' chen po de/ de la snying rje'i shugs drag po skyes pa la brten nas slar yang dge ba la brtson par gyur to/ / skye rabs las/ ston pa 'di ni rgyal po byams stobs su gyur pa na/ kun da'i dga' ston gyi shul du/ gnam sras kyi 'khor gnod sbyin lnga nyes pa 'ga'i phyir bskrad nas/ 'dzam bu gling du sems can gyi mdangs 'phrog ma nus par/ bram ze sprul nas nags khrod cig tu phyin te/ ba glang rdzi gcig gis/ rgyal po'i snyan pa brjod nas/ sgo drung du phyin nas bza' btung blangs pas/ dkar gsum byin yang zar ma nyan par rang gzugs bstan nas gson po'i sha khrag draun po 'tshal zer nas/ rgyal po nyid kyi sha khrag gnang bas tshim ste/ drin lan ci bzhed dris pas/ 'gro kun skyobs byed sangs rgyas 'dod gsung*/ de bdag cag gi yul yin yang khyed thugs dam la brtson par gda' bas myur du thob 'chi bas de thog mar bdag cag la dgongs shig zer bas/ chos kyi lam la 'di 'dra'i grogs gyur pa/ / byang chub thob nas rjed par ga la 'gyur/ / rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi la/ / thog ma nyid du khyed la bgo bar bya// zhes khas blangs pas/ lnga sde la thog mar chos ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig de'o// gnod sbyin rnams kyang srog mi gcod pa sogs dam bcas/

phyag 'tshal te mi snang bar gyur to/ /le'u dang po'o// // ka2 le'u gnyis pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ legs 'ong dpal skyes rgan zhugs dang*/ / lha phrug rdo rje ma sogs bzhi/ / rgan skyes srin phrug ne tso dang*/ / gro bzhin skyes dang byi ba gnyis/ / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*/ / nga rgyal phrag dog bco brgyad do/ / rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /zhes sogs skabs su tshogs bsags dgos te/ dper na/ khye'u legs 'ongs sam/ khyim bdag dpal skyes bzhin/ de'ang mnyan yod na khyim bdag phyug po gcig la bu med par/ sde pa drug gi ston pa la chos ston byas pas/ lo dus na bu gcig skyes pa legs 'ongs su btags so/ /de cher skyes pa'i tshe pha ma shi /bu yang shin tu rtsings pas rdzas thams cad rla ga go / ming yang nyes 'ongs su spos so/ / de nas khol mo gcig gis shing btus nas gso bzhin du/ khol mo rdung 'tshogs pas/ der khol mo yang yid byung nas/ ngas 'bad nas gsos kyang nga la sdang bas 'grogs pa'i thabs med kyis khyod 'di nas grong khyer gnyan yod du song la/ de nas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs kyis rab tu byung zhig zer nas/ dug po'i mtha' la dngul gyi pa ne gcig btags te btang ngo*/ / der khye'u nyes 'ongs kyis nyan thos shā ri'i bu la sogs pa la rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis ltas pas tshogs ma bsags par mthong nas ma gnang ngo*/ / de nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du phyin nas rab tu 'byung bar gnang ste/ khyod tshogs sogs shig gsung ste/ dug po'i mtha' la dngul gyi pa ne gcig btags te btang ngo*/ / dug po'i mtha' la dngul gyi pa ne 'dug pa'ang gzigs nas des tshong dpon gyi bu mo la ut+pa la nyos gsungs pa bzhin phyin pas/ bu mo'ang nyes 'ongs dge ba la zhugs pa la dga' nas ut+pa la khur gcig bkur btang ngo*/

/ bka' bstsal pa| dge 'dun thams cad kyi dbu la me tog re re tshugs shig gsungs pa bzhin btsugs so/ / dge 'dun rnams kyis nyes 'ongs kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir me tog la snoms shig gsungs pa bzhin bsnams pas/ nyes 'ongs tshogs rdzogs nas/ bshags pa byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ dge slong 'ongs pa legs so zhes brjod pas dge slong du gyur nas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /yang khyim bdag dpal skyes zhes pa ser sna dang ldan pa gcig la/ rgas khar bu lnga btsas nas de rnams la rdzas thams cad byin nas chung ma re'ang blangs so/ / der khyim bdag lo brgyad cu lon nas chung ma'ang shi / mig kyang mi bde nas/ mna' ma lnga'i bgor lhung nas re mos kyis gso ba la/ mna' ma rnams kyis rang rang gi khyo la tshod ma bzang po drangs/ rgad po la tshod ma ngan pa drangs pas/ khyim bdag na re bu la nga la tshod ma ngan no byas pas bu rnams kyis chung ma la/ khyim bdag rdzas thams cad gsog gsog pa yin pas/ bya na bzang po byin gcig byas pas/ chung ma rnams kyis phru ba zhabs gnyis par tshod ma bzang ngan gnyis gnyis byas te/ rgad po la ngan pa drangs so/ / yang rgad pos bu rnams la nga'i tshod ma ngan no smras pas/ bud med na re rgad po bcos pa yin zer/ bus kyang phru ba gcig tu thams cad 'dren gyi 'dug pas skyon med do smras/ nam zhig khyim bdag rid par gyur nas/ lag pas phru bar nyul bas zhabs gnyis par rtogs te/ shin tu yi mug nas 'khyam so/ /rdzas thams cad gsog gsog pa yin te phan med zer nas/ rgyal byed kyi tshal du phyin nas/ shā ri'i bu dang*/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu dang*/ 'od srung gi bar du'ang rim bzhin bdag rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyis tshogs ma bsags par gzigs nas ma gnang ngo*/ / der khyim bdag gis bsams pa/ 'dir rab tu 'byung ba'i skal ba med de/ slar ldog tu mna' mas bza' ba mi ster/

shin tu yi mug te 'chi bar bsams nas mgon med zas byin gyis kun dga' rwa ba'i them pa la sngas bcas te 'dug cing zas bcad pas/ zhag gsum na bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs rjes gzigs nas/ kun dga' bo la mkhyen bzhin du dris so/ / rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ 'dir bos gcig gsung ngo*/ nang du phyin pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong legs par 'ongs sam zhes gsungs pas/ rab tu byung ste dgra bcom par gyur to/ / 'khor rnams ngo mtshar du gyur nas zhus pa/ 'dir ser sna'i dbang gis sa bon med bzhin du 'di ltar 'gyur ba rgyu ci lags zhes so/ / bka' bstsal pa/ nga ni thams cad mkhyen par gyur pas/ sa dang bseg ma'i nang na nor bu phra mo ltar/ nyon mongs sdug pa'i nang na sa bon phra mo yod pa mthong ngo*/ / de'ang khyim bdag 'di skye ba snga ma rgyal po gcig gi shing thun te/ grong khyer der byon pa'i sgra thos nas/ shing thun dga' ste/ 'phags pa dang 'phrad 'dod pas nye lam nas grong khyer du 'ongs pa lam du stag mo bu skyes gcig dang phrad de bsad do// de 'chi ba'i tshe sangs rgyas zhes brjod pa dang bcas pas/ sa bon phra mo de lta bu yod pa ngas mthong ba de'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ / ༈ sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon rgan zhugs blun po zhig bsod snyoms la phyin pa la sbyin bdag mo zhig dad nas/ ras zung sbyar gcig phul nas chos zhus pas/ rgan zhugs kyis chos ma shes par/ nga mi shes pa sdug bsngal lo/ / zhes yang yang smras pas/ rgan mos rgyu mi shes pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung bar rtogs te bden pa mthong nas/ slob dpon gyis bdag 'khor ba las sgrol lo zhes sogs tshig gi gtang rag du ma brjod nas song ngo*/ / de'i tshe rkun po gcig blun po 'di la ras 'di la ras 'di brku bar bya snyam nas rjes su 'brang ste/ rgan zhugs nang du zhugs pa la/ ras byin gcig smras so/

/ rgan zhugs skrag pas phyir 'byung mi nus kyis/ lag pa gnyis g.yag shing bug nas yar thong zhig smras te btang ba na/ thag pas dam du btags nas/ rgan zhugs phyir byung ste/ gsum la skyabs 'gro re byed du bcug nas/ dbyug pa na nges re spel nas rgyab/ der 'theng gin phyin pa na/ mgron po na re khyod su ci ste 'theng zer/ kho bo rkun po zhig ste/ de bas kyang dge sbyong rkun chen zhig na/ des skyabs 'gro re dang dbyug pa re spel gyin brdungs/ sangs rgyas thugs shes mnga' bas skyabs 'gro gsum du bsdus/ skyabs 'gro bzhi pa srid na kho bo nges par srog dang 'bral nges so zer nas sangs rgyas la dad bzhin du zam 'og gcig tu zhugs so/ / der zam pa de la mi ma yin mang po 'gro ma nus te/ sngar bdag cag rnams kyis zam pa 'di la bde blag tu 'gro nus bzhin du/ da mi nus pa ni ci/ zam 'og gi mi de la khyod kyis rig pa ci shes dris pas/ skyabs 'gro gcig shes gzhan ni ga la zer/ de thams cad dad nas skyabs 'gro byed cing*/ rkun po de'ang rab tu byung nas 'bras bu thob bo/ /yang*/ lha'i bu mo nor bu dri ma med pa la 'chi ltas lnga byung te/ shi nas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling du phag mo'i mngal du skye'o zhes grag pas/ brgya byin gyis skyabs ma nus par/ sangs rgyas kyis skyabs 'gro phog pas/ de shi nas bram zer skyes/ de nas dga' ldan du skyes pa mngon shes kyis skyabs 'gros skyes pa shes te/ sangs rgyas la me tog gtor/ tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ / de dag ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste// mi yi lus ni spangs nas su/ / de nas lha yi lus 'thob bo/ / chos dang*/ dge 'dun la'ang 'gre'o/ / yang*/ rgyal po gsal rgyal la/ btsun mo du ma yod pa'i chen ma 'bar le la/ bu mo bongs thung*/ mdog nag / sha rtsub/ gang nas ltas kyang mi sdug ste/ rgyal po'i bla brjod pa gcig btsas pa'i ming rdo rje ma zhes btags so//

rgyal po de shin du ngo tsha yang btsun mo gnang chen gyi bu mo yin pas pho brang dgu rim gyi nang du sbed cing*/ tshad du byon nas khyim gyi dus la bab pa dang*/ rgyal pos blon po gcig la bka' bstsal pa/ thog mar cho ris che ba la da lta nor med nas 'khyams pa gcig nga'i spyan sngar khrid la shog gcig sgo ba bzhin/ phul ba dang*/ rgyal bos dben par mi de la gsang ste/ bka' bstsal pa/ nga la bu mo shin tu mi sdug pa gcig yod de/ khyod nor med kyang mi rigs mtho bas sbyin gyis longs shig byas pas/ mi des pus btsugs te/ rgyal pos bdag la mi phal pa zhig stsal na'ang blang 'tshal na/ gdung rigs bstsal ba ci ste mi blang byas pas/ mag pa la sgo ba/ nga'i bu mo 'di shin tu mi sdug pas/ khyed gzhan du 'gro ba'i tshe phugs su chug la lde mig rang gis chongs shig ces yo byad chog thang gcig dang byin nas byan mor bzhag go / des yo byad 'phel te/ blon po gzhan dang bud med gros byas te 'tshog par byas so/ /gzhan kun chad pa bzhin 'ongs pa na/ kho'i bud med med pas rogs po kun the tshom za nas/ yang na 'di la byad gzugs bzang la khyad par 'phags pa/ yang na ldog pas lta'o zer te/ kho bzi ba dang glo las lde mig brkus te lta bar bgros so/ / de'i tshe bud med des bsams pa/ bdag gis sngon las ci zhig byas pas tshe gang gis khyim mun khung dgu rim du bcug nas nyi zla zer tsam yang mi mthong ngo snyam yi mug nas/ de bas thams cad mkhyen pa la skyabs su gsol snyam ste/ ba spu langs 'chi ma 'brub cing*/ ston pa'i phyogs na phar lus stabs te/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal cing skyabs su mchi'o/ / bdag 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal las thar par mdzad du gsol zhes brjod pas/ ston pa de nyid du byon nas/ dbu mthong pas mgo bo skyon dang*/ sku rdzogs par mthong bas lus ngan pa thams cad dor nas mdzes sdug dpe zla med par gyur pa dang*/

grogs po kun ltar 'ongs pa shin tu mtshar ba 'di phangs pas ston mi nus nges so zer/ de nas khyo 'ongs pas mthong ste su yin dris pas/ nga khyod kyi khyim thab yin te/ rgyu mtshan de ltar byung bsnyad nas/ khyo la da ha cang skyo ches kyis nga yab la mjal bas khyod kyis zhus shig/ der zhus pas/ rgyal pos de skad ma zer bar mo la sgo chod la phyir 'byung du ma stair zer ba la/ sras mo ni sngar bzhin ma lags te da lta lha mi las kyang 'das so zhus pas dgyes te gnang nas/ 'khor bcas kyis sangs rgyas la mchod de rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ 'di skye ba snga ma la rgyal po gcig gi bu mo yin te/ des yab kyi mchod gnas rang rgyal mi sdug pa gcig yod pa la/ 'di'i mgo bo 'di dom mgo 'dra/ rna ba 'di bong bu'i/ mig ni spre'u'i/ sna ni phag pa'i/ so ni khyi'i/ lus 'di ni sbal pa'i zhes sogs yang yang brjod do// der rang rgyal des kyang nam mkha' la 'phags nas rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan pas/

bu mo shin tu 'gyod de rang rgyal de la bshags pas/ des kyang tshangs par gnas pa sogs rgyu mtshan rgyas par gsungs nas thams cad skyabs 'gro la bkod do/ /gzhan yang*/ dur khrod kyi mi min gyis mi tshugs pa/ bza' mi gnyis kyi ma gcig skyabs 'gro la dga' ba dur khrod du bskyal pa bzhin dang*/ 'brog srin za byed kyis ma tshugs pa'i pha bu bzhin dang*/ snying rje pad dkar las/ rgya mtshor tshong pas skyabs 'gro byas pa thob pa'i chu srin gru bshig mkhan gyis kyang 'bras bu thob pa bzhin zhes sogs 'dir rgyas par brjod par ga la nus te/ yi ge mang pas 'jigs pa'i phyir ro/ / spros pa la dga' na gzhan du gzigs shig/༈ nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang*/ rgyal po'i khab na tshong dpon phyug po gcig gi chung ma la bu chags nas bu snga ma de mngal las ma byung bar 'dug bzhin du/ phyis bu bcu byung yang bu dang po ni mngal na 'dug go / de nas re zhig na bud med na nas rim 'gro byas kyang ma phan par 'chir nye ba'i tshe/ khyim thab la smras pa/ bdag gum pa'i tshe blo g.yas rol mtshon gyis phye la/ khye'u dang po de phyung shig/ yang smras pa/ bsags pa kun ni tha mar 'dzad/ / mthon po rnams ni tha mar 'jig / 'dus pa rnams ni tha mar 'bral/ / gson pa rnams ni tha mar 'chi/ /zhes smras te shi'o/ / de sman pa mtsho byed kyis bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du khyer ta ེ/ gshar phyin pas/ don de rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du grags te ltad mo mi 'bum phrag du ma 'dus so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' bstsal pa/ kun dga' bo la/ dge slong rnams la bcom ldan 'das dur khrod du gshegs par bzhed kyis/ khyed cag las rmad du byung ba la lta 'dod pa gshegs shig bgos shig/ de nas nyan thos rnams kyis zhabs 'bring byas te byon nas/ mtsho byed kyis bud med de'i blo g.yas dral bas/ kun gyis mthong bar khye'u skra dkar zhing gnyer ma mang la rid pa rgan sha can gcig ma shi bar byung ngo*/

/byung ma thag de skye bo'i tshogs de la ltas te smras pa|kye ma pha ma'am mkhan slob rnams la tshig rtsub mo ma smra zhig /ji ltar zhe na| bdag ni ma'i lto ba dang long kha'i bar du lo drug cur 'dug pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong ngo zer nas/ mi smra bar 'dug go / bcom ldan 'das kyis de bka' bstsal pa khyod rgan po yin nam/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni rgan po lags so/ / bde bar gshegs pa bdag ni rgan po lags so/ / gzhi des rgan po skyes bu btags so/ / rgyu de las brtsams te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan pas sems can brgya phrag mang po skyo bar gyur nas 'bras bu thob bo/ / rgan po yang lo bcu'i bar du khyim na gnas te/ bdun cu pa la rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ / des kyang tshong pa lnga brgya rgya mtshor 'jigs pa las skyabs te/ dgra bcom pa la bkod do/ / dge slong rnams kyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das/ rgan po skyes 'di'i 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan gsung du gsol/ bka' bstsal pa sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la/ tshong dpon gyi bu gcig/ gnas brtan dgra bcom gcig la rab tu byung ngo*/ / de'i tshe der dus ston gcig byung nas/ gzhon nus gnas brtan de la da ni gshegs ran no zhes lan gsum du brjod kyang*/ da dung ltas kyis/ dge ba'i phyogs gyis shig ces yang yang brjod do/ / gzhon nu lto 'dun can des/ khyod lo drug cu'i bar du khyim nas ma byung zhig /nga ni song zin no zhes ngag rtsub smras pa'i las so/ / lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ / thams cad 'dren pa rnams la 'chags/ bram ze gcig rang gi pho brang na gnas pa na/ mi shin tu mi bsrun pa/ dman pa'i rigs/ bzhin mi sdug pa/ spre'u ldum pa'i cha byad lta bu/ 'gro na gzhogs 'gros su 'gro/ smra na ngu zhing smra/ za na skyug thabs su za ba| mi'i rigs min pa gcig la/

btsun mo rnal 'byor gnon pa bya ba/ shin tu mdzes shing lta na yid du 'ongs pa zhig yod pa/ khyo des rtag tu 'tshog cing brdung la/ dus nam zhig mos phyag ma byas pa la gsod du byung ba na/ bred de 'dar zhing bros pas/ sus kyang skyabs ma nus pa la/ bram ze de snying rje cher skyes nas de'i skyabs byas pas/ srin phrug de bram ze de mthong bas shin tu bred de/ a tsi'i mi lus gzi brjid can/ / 'di lta bu zhig ga na gnas/ kho bo bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ / dam pa'i gzugs la skyabs su mchi/ /zer ba la/ kye ma sems can ngo mtshar can/ / mi lus srin po'i gdong pa 'di/ / las ngan byas pas lus ngan thob/ / 'gyod drag skyes na bde ba'i don/ / zhes smras pas/ de'ang shin tu 'gyod pa drag po skyes te/ snying 'gas pa snyam/ mig 'bras phyung ba snyam lus 'jig pa snyam pa byung ste/ skra 'bal zhing mchi ma khrag tu 'dzag pa lus rengs te smras pa/ kye ma kyi hud las ngan rang la smin/ / su yis ma lan rang la yi re mug/ gang du las byas da lta smin gyur cig/ da lta nyid du sdug bsngal gnang gyur cig/ ces 'gyod gdung dang bcas te smras pas/ de nyid du lus mdzes pa/ ngag snyan pa/ yid du 'ong bar gyur nas/ sngar gyi cha byad spangs pas/ mi rnams na re/ btsun mo rnam par gnon pa'i dpal du bram ze byung ngo zer bas bram ze'i mtshan de ltar grags so/ / blo bur tshe la yid mi brtan/ khyim bdag ke du ta ma'i bu gzhon nu ne tsos/ sbrang tshang gi rnam 'gyur las mi rtag pa skyes te/ 'byor pa thams cad sbyin par btang nas pha dang gnyis ka rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ / mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas/ ded dpon stobs kyi sde zhes pa la/ bu mgo bo gdugs ltar 'dug pa sogs dang*/ rin po che'i rna cha rang chas su yod pa zhig skar ma gro zhun la btsas so/ / de'i ming 'dogs pa'i tshe/ rin chen de'i rin gcod du bcug pas sus kyang bcad ma nus pa la 'jig rten na bye ba ri zer bas/

de'i ming yang rna ba bye ba ri'am/ gro zhun skyes su btags so/ / de cher skyes pa'i tshe/ pha ded dpon gyi rigs yin pas/ ma la nor bu ldon du 'gro bar zhus ste/ tshong pa rnams la/ dril bsgrags nas/ rgya mtshor 'gro ba la/ mas tshong pa rnams la smras pa/ nga'i bu 'di sngon la ma btang phyi la ma bzhag par tshur 'ong dus kyang nga'i bu khrid la shog byas te/ 'khal ba yang glang po che sogs ma bskur bar/ gso sla dran pa dang ldan pa'i bong bu bskur btang ngo*/ / de nas rgya mtsho nas nor bu mang po nyes med du lon pa la/ rin 'di la 'di zin gyis rnam rtog yengs nas nam smad gnyid du song ba'i bar la tshong pa rnams song ste/ nyi ma shar ba gro zhun skyes kyi 'gram pa la phog pas gnyid sad de ltas pas grogs thams cad med do/ khos kyang bong bu la 'khal bkal te/ grogs ma snyegs su dogs nas bong bu brdungs pas bong bu rdzi 'tshubs te lam gtor bas/ 'khal bor te bkres pas/ lcags kyi khang pa gcig 'dug pa'i sgo na yar gro bzhin skyes la 'os pa'i bza' btung byin gcig byas pas de nas yi dwags mang po byung nas/ nged kyis lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bza' btung gi ming yang ma thos na/ khyod kyis nged la bza' btung byin cig zer/ khyed 'dir las cis skyes byas pas/ khyed 'dzam bu gling pa yid ches par dka' bas mi smra zer/ ngas mngon sum du mthong ba la yid mi ches rgyu med ci yod smros gcig/ de dag na re/ bdag cag ngag rtsub khro ldan zhing*/ / bdag cag ser snas 'jungs pa can/ / sbyin pa ci yang ma btang bas/ / da lta yi dwags 'jig rten lhags/ /gnyis pa smras pa/ nad med rgyags pas myos pa dang*/ / lang tsho longs spyod dregs pas myos/ / sbyin pa ci yang ma btang bas/ / da lta yi dwags 'jig rten lhags/ /de rnams skye ba snga ma grong khyer rdo 'jog na yod pa'i byis pa kha cig yin te/ rtsed mo'i phyir chu rnyog pas dge 'dun gyi chu len ma stobs par gro chag pa'i rnam smin no zer ro/

/ de nas gro zhun skyes kyis phyogs gcig na phar phyin pas nam sros pa dang*/ phyogs de na gzhal yas khang gcig na lha gcig 'dug pa la bza' btung blangs pas/ 'grangs ngoms su byin nas mtshan mo zad khar lha de na re ngan pa mig gis ma mthong ba la song gcig zer/ khos ngan pa ci yod dam snyam nas bsdad pas/ lha de sems can dmyal ba gcig tu gyur nas sreg cing 'dug go /yang mtshan mor song ba dang lhar gyur to/ khos lha de la mtshan mo lhar 'gyur la nyin mo dmyal bar 'gyur ba ci dris pas/ nga skye ba snga ma grong khyer rdo 'jog gi shan pa yin pa la/ 'phags pa ka ta ya nas nga la srog gcod spongs gsungs/ ngas mi nus byas pas/ khyod nyin mo srog gcod dam/ mtshan mo gcod gsungs/ ngas nyin mo gcod zhus pas/ 'o na mtshan mo srog mi gcod pa'i sdom pa longs gsungs nas blangs pa las de lta bu'i rgyu las 'di lta bu'o zer/ khyod grong khyer rdo 'jog du 'gro na nga'i bu shan pa zhig yod kyis shan pa 'phro chod la/ shan pa'i gri 'jog pa'i 'og na mar gser bum gang yod kyis thon la nga'i don du dge sbyong dang bram ze dang 'phags pa ka ta ya na la phul la nga'i ming nas thon la bsngo ba gyis shig dang*/ 'on kyang nga'i sdug bsngal 'di srab par 'gyur ro zer ro/ / yang phyogs gcig na phar phyin pa dang*/ nyin par gzhal yas khang gcig na lha cig 'dug pas/ bza' btung mang po byin nas nyi ma nub khar ngan pa mig gis ma mthong ba la song zer/ sngar bzhin bsdad pas/ dmyal bar song ba dang*/ yang lhar song ba sogs rgyu mtshan dris pas nga skye ba snga ma grong khyer rdo 'jog gi khyim bdag 'dod log spyod pa zhig yin te/ 'phags pa ka ta ya nas 'dod log spaungs gsung*/ ngas mi nus zhus pas/ nyin mo spyod dam/ mtshan mo spyod gsung*/ ngas mtshan mo spyod zhus pas/ 'o na nyin mo mi spyod pa'i sdom pa longs gsungs nas blangs pas rgyu mtshan 'gre'o//

khyod rdo mchog tu 'gro na nga'i bu med la me thab sbas pa'i 'og na gser bum gang yod kyis de thon la/ bdag nyid la'ang dus dus su bde bas tshim par byed pa dang*/ 'phags pa ka t+ya na chen po la bsod snyoms phul la/ nga'i ming nas thon la yon bsngo ba gyis shig dang*/ nga'i sdug bsngal 'di srab par 'gyur ro zhes so/ / yang phyogs gcig na phar phyin pas/ gzhal yas khang gcig na lha mo gcig la 'khor yi dwags bzhi 'dug go / bza' btung blangs pas mang po byin nas yi dwags 'di rnams la ma byin cig zer/ khos ma nyan par byin pas/ gcig la khro chu khol mar gyur/ gcig la me ma mur du gyur/ gcig la gra phub tu gyur/ gcig la me mdag tu gyur te sdug bsngal lo/ / der lha mo de na re da ci ru ma ster byas te/ byin pas phan na nga yang ster te mi phan par sdug bsngal rogs su 'gro zer ro/ khos 'di lta bu'i 'khor sogs rgyu mtshan dris pas/ khyed 'dzam bu gling pa yid ches par dka' bas mi smra zer/ ngas mngon sum du mthong bas yid ches kyi smros shig/ nged skye ba snga ma grong khyer rdo 'jog gi bza' tshang yin pa la/ 'di rnams nga'i khyo/ bu/ bu mo/ bran mo bzhi yin pas/ sngar mor las la song ste/ ngas g.yos byed kyin bsdad pas/ 'phags pa ka t+ya na byon pa la 'bras chan lhung bzed gang btsos te drangs pas/ kho pa'i lto ba 'phyid zer/ ngas khyod rnams rjes su yid rangs par byos shig dang*/ ngas 'phags pa ka t+ya na la bsod snyoms phul bas lto 'phyid pa yin gyis byas pas/ khyo na re de'i kha ru me mdag sbar gang mi bdug pa zer/ bu na re khro chu khol ma/ bu mo na re me ma mur/ bran mos gra phub mi bdug pa zer/ ngas smon lam ma dag pa btab te/ khyed rnams kyis 'phags pa yul khyad par can la ngag rtsub smras pa'i rnam smin ngas mthong bar gyur cig byas pa las 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan zer/ de na re khyod grong khyer rdo 'jog tu sdod par 'dod dam zer/

'dod byas pas/ der sngas ston la nyol zer nas nyal bas/ yi dwags bzhi pos stan gyi gra bzhi nas btegs nas rdo 'jog tu bskyal lo/ /gnyid sad nas bltas pas/ rdo 'jog tu slebs 'dug nas bsams pa/ 'phags pa ka ta ya na la rab tu 'byung bar zhu snyam nas zhus pas/ khyod rang gi pha ma ma shi bar yod pas/ pha ma la rab tu 'byung bar zhus las shog cig /dmyal ba yi dwags rnams kyi 'phrin yang gyis gsungs nas/ khos shan pa'i bu la 'phrin bzlas pas rdzun yin zer/ gser bum bstan pa ltar byung nas yid ches 'dug pa mtshar nas 'dzum byas pas gser gyi mche ba lhag byung ba dang*/ der gro zhun skyes su ngo shes nas/ khyod gro zhun skyes yin byas pas 'jig rten na de ltar grags zer/ 'o na khyod kyi pha ma yod pas 'phrad du song zer ro/ /'phrin gnyis pa byas pas kyang*/ pha ma la 'phrad du song gi bar gong bzhin no/ / gong du tshong pa rnams log pa'i tshe kho med de dris pas/ snga ma rnams na re phyi nas 'ong zer/ phyi ma na re sngon la song zer te/ shi snyam nas dge rtsa byas te/ kho'i don du 'di ltar byas so/ / zhes rdo ring la bris nas bu shi ba'i mya ngan gyis pha ma'i mig long ba/ kho phyin pas dga' ches nas ngus pas mchi mas ling thog dag ste mthong ngo*/ / der pha mas kyang rab tu 'byung bar gnang nas/ 'phags pa ka ta ya na la rab tu byung ste phyir mi 'ongs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ / nyin mtshan sdod pa yongs med par/ / mi zhig g.yang kha'i 'bras bu la chags te/ rtswa la 'jus pas/ byi ba dkar nag gnyis gis re mos su rtswa de bcad nas g.yang du lhung ngo*/ / zug ngu thams cad 'byin pa yi/ smri tis/ dga' bo sor phreng lam chung ba| |ka pin lha sbyin dug lnga'i dpe//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po 'dod chags kyi zug rngu 'byin tshul ni/ ston pa rgyal byed na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gcung mdzes dga'o/ / pu dha ri ka la chags nas de yid 'byung bas gdul ba'i phyir ser skyar byon pa la bsod snyoms 'bul ba pu dhas ma khegs par dpral bar tsan dan gyi thig le byas pa ma bskams par shog byas kyang*/

rgyal byed lta bar 'dod dam zhes khrid de phyag dar la btsud pa zin dus med nas ma tshor bar bros pa dang mjal nas/ rtsa gsum lta bar 'dod dam zhes khrid de/ der khang pa thams cad na lha pho mo zung du 'dug cing*/ gcig na mdzes ma gcig khye'u med par me tog gi phreng ba rgyud pa la rgyu mtshan dris pas/ mdzes dga' rab tu byung nas 'dir skye ba'i phreng ba'o zer/ der legs smon gyi rab tu byung ba'i tshe/ dmyal ba'i gnas lta 'dod dam zhes khrid de/ thams cad na 'tshod yang*/ gcig na sems can med par chu tshan skol ba'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/

gcung dga' bo mi yul na legs smon gyi sdom pa bsrung ba'i 'bras bu zad nas/ 'dir skye ba'i chu skol lo byas pas skrag nas nges 'byung gi tshul khrims bsrungs te bsgoms pas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /༈ zhe sdang gi zug rngu 'byin tshul ni/ sor 'phreng gi mdo las sangs rgyas dang mdzangs blun las phan par bzhed do/ / rgyal byed na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gsal rgyal gyi blon po zla ba la bu dge mtshan du mas spras pa skyes nas mtshan bstan pas/ mngal du byung tsam nas ma sdug bsngal gyis mi gdung bas/ khye'u mi gdung bar btags so/ / stobs mi stong thub/ yang rtsal bya 'phur yang zin/ mgyogs pa rta bas lhag pa gcig ste/ bram ze nor bzang can la rig byed bslabs pas/ nyin re la lobs lhag pa lobs te/ thams cad kyis khur zhing*/ yid bzhin bzang mo yang yang de'i byad gzugs la chags kyang*/ gleng pa'i go skabs ma byung ba'i tshe/ bram ze la lho phyogs na zla ba gsum yo byad sbyor ba yod par gshegs pas/ bzang mo la grogs slob ma gcig bzhag go smras pas/ dga' ste/ khyim gyi so tshis la'ang mkhas yid gtan du rung bas/ mi gdung ba bzhag par rigs so zer ba bzhin bzhag pas/ mos lus brgyan te/ kho mo khyod la chags kyang sngar skabs ma byung gi re ba bsgrubs shig byas kyang*/ khye'u sran gzugs te/ kho bo yang khyod yid du 'ongs kyang*/ bram ze'i chos lugs la/ slob dpon gi chung ma la log par zhugs na/ tshe 'di phyir brlag pas gsod kyang 'di byed mi phod byas pas/ mo ngo tsha nas khro sems kyis sgyu bya bar bsams te/ slob dpon 'ong khar gos dbral/ gdong brad/ sdug bsngal gyis gos te sa la nyal lo/ / slob dpon gyis rgyu mtshan dris pas/ gleng rin mi chog ces pas/ kho bo las snying nye ba yod dam ci nyes smros/ khyod can rtag tu sdod pa'i khye'u 'dis kho mo la nyal po sgugs pa/ ngas ma nyan pas 'di ltar byas so da 'di sod cig zer/

kho blon po chen po'i bu yin cing stobs shin tu che bas/ thub chod du mi rung*/ thabs kyis bsad do zer te/ khye'u can song nas khyod las dang po pa so tshis kyis nyon mongs par ma gyur tam/ kho bo ni khyod kyi drin dran pas gsang ba'i chos gzhan la ma bstan pa gcig yod pas khyod la bstan no zer/ khye'u pus btsugs te zhus pas/ khyod zhag bdun dge ba bsrungs te/ mi stong gi mgo bo chod la sor mo'i phreng ba rgyan du gyis shig des tshangs par skye'o zer ba la/ kho shes rab shin tu che bas slob dpon lhar skye ba'i rgyu ni de min na ji skad zer/ bden par smra zhing khro mi bya/ / slong la chung yang sbyin par bya/ / dngos po 'di gsum ldan gyur na/ / lha yi gnas su nges par skye/ /zer gyi/ srog bcad pas lha thob bo zhes ma gsungs byas pa/ bram ze na re khyod nga'i chos la the tshom za bas/ dam tshig nyams so zer/ der kho kha rog bsdad pas bzhin 'gyur bar rig nas/ bar der bram ze la pha rol gyi snying sgul ba'i ngan sngags yod pa btab pas/ zhe sdang skyes pa la/ ral gri la sngags btab te bskur btang bas/ zhag bdun gyi bar du mi dgu brgya go dgu bsad do/ /sor mo ji snyed pa rgyan du byas so/ / de thams cad kyis thos te rgyu 'grul chad do/ / ma'i bsam pa la 'dod khams kyi sems can zhag bdun zas ma myong na 'chi snyam nas zas khyer phyin pa dang*/ ma gsad par bsams te rgyugs pa dang*/ ma na re nga ni khyod shir dogs pas zas skyel gyis/ nga gsad na mtshams med 'ongs byas pas/ nga'i slob dpon gyi man ngag yin pas/ ma mi gsad pa thabs med do zer/ slob dpon ci zer/ 'dir ltar ro/ /'o na nga'i sor mo chod la khyer zhig /khyod la mtshams med kyang mi 'ong*/ sor mo yang tshang bas so/ / des mi phan pas bsad dgos zer bar der sangs rgyas kyis khong 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ kho'i mthong sar byon pa dang*/

ma gsod mi dgos btsun pa pha gi bsad pas chog par 'dug snyam nas/ ral gri khyer te rgyugs pa na/ sangs rgyas ga le gshegs kyang khos ma zin par/ btsun pa sdod gcig byas pas/ de ci la zer/ nga ni rtag tu sdod sdod pa yin/ khyod ni rtag tu 'gro ba yin gsung*/ kho dran pa rnyed de dge sbyong de skad bya ba ci la zer/ bka' stsal ba/ nga ni tshul khrims bsrungs pas lha dang mi'i nang du rtag tu sdod sdod pa'o/ /khyod ni slob dpon ngan pa'i man ngag la brten nas srog bcad pas ngan song du rtag tu 'gro 'gro ba'o gsungs/ skabs der 'gyod pa skyes te/ ral gri sa la skyur/ kha nas khrag skyugs te/ dge slong khyod la skyabs su mchi'o zer/ rab tu byung bar zhus nas/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang dge slong 'ongs pa legs so gsungs pas dge slong du gyur te man ngag phog nas bsgoms pas dgra bcom thob bo/ / de ltar gyur kyang da dung mi'i rgyu 'grul chad pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis/ mi gdung sor phreng can ni nga yin na/ ngas ni srog chags grog sbur gcig kyang gsod ma myong ngo gyis la sgra sgrogs shig gsungs pas/ bdag gis ni mi dgu brgya go dgu bsad na/ bdag la brdzun mi mchi'am zhus pas/ khyod so skye'i dus su bsad kyi/ 'phags par gyur nas gcig kyang ma bsad pa'i phyir brdzun mi 'ong gsungs pa bzhin bsgrags pas sor phreng can sangs rgyas kyis gdul snyam nas 'grub bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe gsal rgyal dpung bcas kyis sor phreng 'dul du yong bas/ rta gnyan yod du mgo bstan de 'gror ma 'dod pa la/ blon pos 'di na dge slong shin tu dbyangs snyan pa gcig yod pas so zer/ 'o na dpung bcas gnyan yod du sgyur zer ba bzhin bsgyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar de lta bu yod par gda' bas mjal cing phyag rten 'bul bar zhus pas/ phyag rten da lta phul/ de nas mjal snying 'dod pa srid byas pas/

ci gsung*/ phyag rten bya ba mjal nas 'bul ba las/ sngon la 'bul ba ga na'ang ma mchis so zer te/ ma phul/ de nas gzugs ngan pa mthong nas 'bul snying ma 'dod do/ / rgyal pos/ 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon 'od srung gi bstan pa la rgyal po ling shri bya bas mchod rten gcig bya bar 'dod nas rm-i lam du bram ze'i khye'u lngas mchod rten ni rin po che las byed dam zer ba rmis nas blon po bzhi la bgos nas/ gsum pos phyogs gsum 'byongs so/ / gcig gis rgyal po glen pa 'di tsam ga la 'byongs zer nas bzhag go / phyis kun log nas phyogs gcig kyang byas te rin chen las grub pa khyad par 'phags pa gcig byung rjes/ blon po le lo can des kyang da tsam ci 'dra zhes ltar phyin pas khyad par can de byung bas kho'ang dad nas gser gyi dril gcig btags pas/ ding sang tshe dang ldan pa snyan pa bzang ldan dang gang la 'byongs kyis skye ba lnga brgyar gzugs ngan no zhes sogs pa gsungs nas/ rgyal po 'khor bcas 'gro 'dod pa la/ mkhyen bzhin du dris pas/ sor phreng 'dul du zer/ 'dir dgra bcom gsungs pas/ 'o na mjal zer phyin pas/ sor phreng gi glo gog pas rgyal po rgyal lo/ / rgyu mtshan zhus pas sngon yang bred bred pa ste/ sngon bya shin tu gdug pa can de'i grib mas phog pa'i sems can thams cad kyang nyon mongs 'gro ba gcig ste/ bya de shing rtser babs nas skad grag pas shing grib la glang po che gcig yod pa rgyal lo/ / de lta bu'i bya dang glang chen ni 'di gnyis po zhes sogs gsung ngo*/ /༈ gti mug gi zug rngu ni/ bram ze gcig la bu byung ngo gcig shi nas/ phyis gcig byung ba gsos pa'i thabs su lam po cher khyer la dge sbyong dang phrad na smon nam/ kun tu rgyu dang 'phrad na shis pa brjod zer ba bzhin byas pas dge sbyong gis smon lam btab nas lam par btags/

yang gcig gis lam chung bar btags/ yang gcig gis lam phran par btags/ des lo gcig la sidhaṃ bud dha ma zin par rab tu byung nas lham gyi dri ma 'phyi ba dang phyag dar yang ma zin par yi mug ste lceb 'dod pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas chos bstan pas dgra bcom pa thob nas dge slong ma la chos ston par bskos pa na/ nged sde snod gsum shes pa'i dge slong ma la/ gti mug can gyi mthar thug lam phran lta bu bsko ba zer te brnyas pa la/ khri chen po brtsegs nas 'dir sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i dgra bcom zhig chos ston du 'ong zhes dril bsgrags pas/ mang du 'dus te khrel ba la rdzu 'phrul gyis khri la gshegs te chos rgya cher bstan pas skye bo du ma lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang 'dun par byas so/ / ༈ nga rgyal gyi zug rngu ni/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de'i rgyal po gsal rgyal byed do/ / lho phyogs gser pa'i rgyal po ka pi na'i rgyal tshab ka pi na chen pos so/ / de la rgyal phran stong phrag so drug go / de'i dmag gang babs par me tog rlung gis btab pa bzhin 'gro la/ gzhan gyis dpal thos na bzhin mdog dmar por 'gyur ba zhig yod la/ de'i tshong pas dbus kyi ras bzang po bzhi gser pa'i rgyal po la phul bas/ 'di lta bu'i ras bzang po gang nas 'ongs/ dbus nas so/ /yul dbus de gang*/ de'i rgyal po ci/ de nga la phyag dang bca' 'bul du ci'i phyir mi 'ong*/ da ste zhag bdun na nga la phyag 'tshal du ma byung na khyod kyis ming tsam yang med par bya'o/ / zhes gsal rgyal la bsrings pas/ skrag nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ nga bas rgyal po che ba gcig yod pas de la srings shig gis gsungs pa bzhin bsgo nas song ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sgyur rgyal du sprul/ mo'u 'gal la sogs blaun po dang*/ sna bdun dang*/ nye ba'i sna bdun sogs sprul/

kun dga' ra ba rin po che'i khang bzangs 'bos rim pa bdun gyi nang rin po che'i shing ljon pa rgyas pa sogs su sprul pa'i rgyal po/ pho nya bas mthong bas sngangs te/ bdag cag gi rgyal pos 'di la 'gran mi bzod mod/ 'on kyang yi ge dbul snyam du phul bas/ 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i rkang 'og tu bcug ste/ nga gling bzhi la dbang ba'i rgyal po yin/ glen pa khyod nga'i bka' thos nas 'gro 'chag za gsum na/ da ste zhag bdun na nga can ma slebs na khrims dang sbyor zhes bsrings pa thos pas/ bzhin mdog gyur te/ khri las langs nas ral gri bshams pa las 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i mthu dpal gleng bas 'gyod par gyur te/ drung du thal byung du 'gro mi rigs pas/ da dung lan gcig brtag go snyam nas/ pho nya mngags te/ nged phyag 'tshal du dmag dpung 'bum phrag bco brgyad/ rgyal phran stong so drug mchi na/ de dag rim gyis mchi'o/ /zhes pas/ rgyal phran phyed bcas pa shog gsungs pas/ rgyal phran khri stong dang bcas pa phyag 'tshal nas/ 'di'i dpal dang byad gzugs bdag pas lhag kyang*/ stobs ni bdag tsam mi phod snyam pa dang*/ 'phrul gyi rgyal pos/ blon po la/ nga'i gzhu 'di la byin cig ces pas/ ka pin gyis blangs ma theg go / de nas 'phrul gyi rgyal pos mthe'u chung gis brdungs te/ rgyud bsgrengs pas stong gsum g.yos so/ / de nas mda' zhig ltongs te 'phangs pas/ mda' lngar gyur te/ de dag gis rtse mo la 'od zer grangs med byung nas/ pad mo shing rta'i phang lo tsam re la sgyur rgyal sna bdun can re re byung nas sems can gyi don byas pas/ ka pin dga' mgu rangs te/ chos kyi mig rnam par dag go /rgyal phran rnams tshim ste/ de nas rdzu 'phrul bsdus te/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis bskor ba bstan te/ gser pa'i rgyal po rab tu byung bar zhus nas/ ston pas kyang tshur shog 'ongs pa legs zhes pas/

dge slong du gyur te bsgrubs pas/ dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /༈ phrag dog gi zug rngu ni/ ston pa bya rgod phung por bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sku gser ma'i bsnyun cung zad kyis bzung nas/ 'tsho byed kyis sman sna so gnyis mar dang sbyar te/ nyin re la srang so gnyis gnyis gsol bas/ lhas sbyin gyis thos ste phrag dog skyes nas/ don grub gang za'i sman de tsam nga la yang sbyor te byin cig zer ba bzhin sbyar nas nyin re la srang bzhi bzhi las lhag pa ma za zhig byas pas/ don grub ci tsam za zer/ sangs rgyas nyin re la srang so gnyis gnyis gsol/ 'o na kho bo la yang de ma byin cig zer/ sangs rgyas dang khyod gnyis mi 'dra ste/ khyod kyis de tsam zos na nges par nad du 'gyur byas pas/ zas ci tsam 'ju'i tshod kho bo rang la yod kyis/ don grub kyis 'ju na kho bo ci'i phyir mi 'ju/ don grub dang*/ pha ma'i rigs cho 'brang sogs gang yang*/ ma mnyam pa med na/ khyod kyis khyad cig shes sam zer ma nyan par srang so gnyis zos pas ma zhu bar rtsa kun tu zug nas/ lus 'gre ldog/ ngag smre sngags/ sems mya ngan gyis non pa la thugs rjes rgyang nas phyag brkyangs te/ mgo la byugs ma thag sman kun zhu ste/ nad las grol ba dang*/ phyag yin par shes te/ don grub kyi lag sngon de reg pas cham pa ma byung khar rje che/ phyin chad ye ma reg gyis shig zer ba la/ 'tsho byed kyis sngar yang nad las bkrol/ da dung na'ang byin brlabs zhu dgos mod byas pas/ nga nad pas ci byung yang don grub la re dus mi 'ong zer/ yang sang lhag ma gsol bar thos pas/ kho bo la yang byin zer/ khyod sngar lto nyen pas da gcig kyang bzar mi rung ngo byas kyang ma nyan par zos pas/ nang shugs su tshud de srog la thug pa/ kun dga' bos nu bo 'gum pa ma bzod nas byon par zhus pas/ sgra gcan 'dzin drung na 'dug da lta 'ong gis/ byas pas/ chags sdang can de kho mi 'ong*/

sgra gcan 'dzin gyis chog/ gzhan shi na'ang shi zer/ kun dga' bos rings par phyin te/ da ni 'gum pa la thug pas/ myur du brtse bar dgongs su gsol zhus pas/ rings par byon nas phyag spyi bor bzhag nas/ shin tu gus pa'i sgra gcan 'dzin dang shin tu sdang ba'i lha sbyin gnyis la byams pa'i sems su mnyam na/ lha sbyin gyi nad 'di da lta nyid du drag par gyur cig gsungs pas 'phral du drags pas/ kho na re/ don grub kyis kyang shes bya'i rtsal du sman rgyob cig shes kyin 'dug ste/ kho rang rgas kar rgyags rten 'dra la phan mod/ nga kun de la mi re'o zer/ de nas tshe'i dus byas/ dbyen sogs lnga'i sdig 'bras kyis mnar med du ltung ba/ kun dga' bos 'od srung gi spyo ba la brten nas dgra bcom thob ste/ mig gi mngon shes kyis bltas pas/ du kha ba gzigs nas ma bzod par sku gdung gcig bsnams te byon pas de dag gi sdug bsngal gzigs pas/ mnyam bzhag las g.yengs te/

ma mkhyen par dmyal srung la dris pas/ 'od srung mar me mdzad sogs su'i zer/ thub pa'i lha sbyin no byas pas/ de 'di na 'di ltar sdug bsngal lo zer/ 'di las nam thar dris pas/ bka' ltar mi byed sems dpa' ni/ / shin tu gti mug smad pa'i gnas/ / sdig 'bras mi bzad bskal bar ni/ / sdug bsngal yang brgyud thar skabs med/ /zer/ myur bar byon nas khyod sdug bsngal lam byas pas/ btsun pa shin tu sdug bsngal lo zer/ ston pa la log sgrub byas pa'i sdig 'bras yin gyis/ nyid la skyabs su song la myur du gshegs shig byas pas/ kho bo kun dga' bo 'di la kha col med pa/ thal mo ya med brdeb tu gar rung*/ nga sdig gsog mkhan yin na/ kho sdig bsags yul yin/ kho rang la yang shog gyis zer ro/ /de skad ma zer ston pa ni bde ba nas bde bar gshegs pa yin/ nyes skyon thams cad spangs pa la sngar yang log sgrub byas pas 'di ltar sdug bsngal/ de'ang byas na thar blags med kyis/ sku gdung 'di la skyabs su song la| 'gyod sems kyis gshegs na grol bar gsungs so byas pas/ kho bo/ kun dga' bo 'di la pho tshod ye mi 'dug /zer dgu bden par ma 'dzin/ smra tshad gtam du ma re/ sbang ma chu phyogs ma byed/ nga drung spun pas kho pha spun nye ba| dge sbyong g.yo sgyu can de'i rus gog la skyabs su song bya ba'i gtam gcig rang 'ong ba/ nga las ci la thug kyang*/ rgan zhugs rdzun rlabs can de'i rus dum la mgon skyabs re ba'i dus mi yong zer nas gtan 'khyams su song ngo*/ / mdo kha cig nas gshegs ste brtson pas grol bar bshad cing*/mdo kha cig nas ston pa'i che ba dbyung ba'i phyir sprul pa'i dge slong du byas pa'ang yod do// le'u gnyis pa'o// // ka3 le'u gsum pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ rgyal sras sa la'ang yi rang ngo*/ /sa dang des pa ye shes ldan/ / glang po gser mdog thams cad grol/

/ dbang med bde stobs mchog rnams brgyad do/ / gsal rgyal gyis gzhan phan gyi blos/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ nyi ma bdun du bsnyen bkur dang rim gro rgya cher byas pa'i nyi ma dang po la| rgyal po khyed kyi dge ba bsngo'am/ khyod pas dge ba brgya 'gyur gyis che ba zhig gi dge ba bsngo gsung*/ de ring bdag las che ba cang yod dam snyam nas/ bdag pas dge rlabs che ba de'i yon bsngo bar zhus pas/ sgo drung na sprang po sa da zhes pas/ rgyal po 'di gzhan phan gyi blos sangs rgyas 'khor bcas la bsnyen bkur mdzad pa ngo mtshar che snyam du theg chen gyi dge ba la yid rang khor yug tu byed pa de'i dge ba bsngos so/ / de bzhin du nyin drug gi bar du bsngos pas/ rgyal po mya ngan gyi phyag rgya bcas pa la/ de ci nongs/ 'di ltar ro zer/ blon po thabs mkhas shig na re/ mi dgyes mi 'tshal/ rgyal po'i bsngo ba 'grub pa'i thabs mchis kyis zer te/ sang thon ston la 'bras chan nyis 'gyur 'tshod du bcug ste/ 'dren dus phyed phyed pho la/ sprang po sdud pa kun brdungs shig ces pas/ sprang po kun 'khrugs nas yid rang shor te/ gzod rgyal po'i dge ba bsngos nas lung bstan thob bo/ / gzhan yang shing thun gcig gi chung mas/ drang srong gcig la 'bras tshod drangs pa la khyos yid rang byas pas nang du gter thon no/ / sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang*/ dkon brtsegs las/ zhi ba'i blo gros 'das pa'i dus na 'dzam gling 'dir mi rnams la nad sna tshogs byung nas gzer ma btub ste smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa na/ ston pa 'di de'i tshe rtsa gsum gyi brgya byin mig bzang su gyur pas mngon shes kyis 'di lta bu phan par mkhyen te/ myur bar 'dzam gling dbus ku ru zhes pa'i grong dang ha cang yang mi ring sar/ des pa zhes pa'i srogs chags su brdzus te skyes nas/ bar snang nas/ mi rnams la smras pa/

ku ru zhes bya'i grong khyer na/ / des pa zhes bya'i srog chags yod/ / de yi sha la su za ba/ / de ni nad rnams kun las thar/ /zhes pa ltar/ de'i sha zos ma thag nad las thar cing*/ tshe stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur te/ sha yang zad par ma gyur to/ /mi rnams na re sman dang sman pa'i sgo nas drin lan btang rag bgyi'o bka' stsol cig zer ba la/ bar snang la lha lus su 'dug nas/ kho bo rtsa gsum 'tsho byed des par bstan pa de/ nga la zas nor mchod pa mi dgos kyis/ mi dge bcu spongs la byams snying rje bskyed cig ces pas lus bde bar ma zad sems kyang bde ba'i rgyu byas pas bka' bzhin bgyi'o/ / zer ba bzhin bsgrubs pas thams cad byang chub thob bo/ / de yi nad g.yog byed par shog/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/ myur du sangs rgyas par 'dod pas/ chos smra ba na ba la rim gro bya'o/ / de'ang 'das pa'i dus na sangs rgyas smon lam khyad 'phags rgyal po 'jig rten du byon nas/ sangs rgyas pa'i nyin par sprul pa sna tshogs kyis sems can du ma theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu la bkod nas/ phyi dro mya ngan las 'das shing*/ dam pa'i chos lo bye ba stong du gnas te/ bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod pa'i tshe/ gling bzhi la dbang ba'i rgyal po ye shes stobs kyi slob dpon chos smra ba yan lag blo gros sam yang dag blo gros kyang zer/ 'brum bu me sbal nag pos zin nas sman pa kun gyis kyang spangs te/ 'gum pa la thug pa'i tshe/ rgyal po 'khor bcas ngu zhing mya ngan byed pa na/ rgyal po'i srung ma lha mo ye shes mchog gis/ rgyal po yab sras kyi rmi lam du/ 'di la mi'i gson khrag gis byugs shing gson sha'i snag khu byin na sos so zhes bstan to/ /rgyal pos thams cad bsogs te/ spro ba dris pas gcig kyang ma byung bar/ rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes ldan lo bco lnga lon pa des bdag gi lus don yod par bya'o/

/ snyam ste/ rang gi gnas su song ste/ rtsa bo che kha phye nas khrag gis khyab par byugs te/ sha bcad nas snag khur byas pa drangs pas dge slong nad las grol te chos bstan pas srog chags du ma phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu la bkod do/ / rgyal pos bu mo la khyod kyis sman de dag gang nas rnyed dris pas/ lha mos lung bstan pa la/ su'ang spro ba ma byung bas/ bdag gis lus btang ba la gso zhes so/ / 'o na khyod rang lus la zug gzer skyed pa la 'gyod pa med dam dris pas/ de 'das na chos kyang nub la 'gro kun mdongs par 'gyur bas/ bdag gi don de tsam grub pa la ga la 'gyod zer/ mi 'gyod pa'i dpang por su yod dris pas/ gal te 'gyod na da lta 'gum pa dang*/ mi 'gyod na bdag lus sngar bzhin du gyur cig ces pas/ lus sngar bzhin du gyur nas rgyal po 'khor bcas yi rang ngo*/ / gzhon nu/ nga nyid de'i tshe ye shes ldan no/ /dge slong mar me mdzad do/ /rgyal po ni byams pa'o/ / lha mo ni mi 'khrugs pa'o/ / zhes so/ / bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur/ /ston pa ni sngar rtsi shing du 'bab chu sogs kyis mdzes pa/ mya ngam gyi thang gis bskor bas grong dang thag ring ba zhig na/ glang chen zhig tu gyur te/ re zhig mthar rgyu ba na/ smre sngags kyi smra zhig thos te snying rjes ltar phyin pas/ rtswa chu sogs kyi bsgribs g.yogs med pa'i mya ngam gyi thang de la mi rid stobs zad mang po zhig 'dug pas/ glang chen gangs ri 'gro zhes pa lta bu de mthong te 'jigs yang bkres ngal gyis 'bros ma nus pa'i tshe/ des khyed nga la skrag mi dgos zhes dbugs phyung ste/ drung du phyin nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ glang po mi skad smra bas sems rtas te phyag byas nas smras pa/ bdag cag rgyal po mi srun pas yid dang mi mthun pa cung zad kyi rkyen gyis spyugs na/ da bdag cag rnams sdug bsngal 'di las skyabs su gsol zer/

khyed du yod dris pas/ stong las gum pa'i lhag ma bdun brgya tsam mo/ /snying rjes 'di dag thar pa'i skabs gzhan med bdag gi lus btang snyam nas/ sna sbrul mgo ltar phyar te smras pa/ ri bo pha gi'i 'gram na chu gtsang gis gang pa'i mtsho 'gram na/ ri nas lhung ba'i glang po'i ro zhig yod kyis de'i shas lam rgyags dang rgyu mas chu snod byas te lam 'di nas phyin na thar ro zhes smras nas/ lam gzhan nas rings par song nas/ ri'i khar 'dzegs te/ bdag gis nyams thag pa'i skye bo 'di rnams bsgral ba'i bsod nams kyis sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs su gyur cig ces smon te/ rang gi sdug bsngal la mi lta bar de dag skyabs pa'i phyir mchongs so/ / de'i ro de dag gis mthong nas sngar gyi de dang 'dra ste de'i nye ba zhig go zer/ kha cig sa g.yos sogs kyis ltas dang sbyar na 'ong*/ 'o skol gyi don du nyid rang lhung bas/ 'di'i sha za mi phod pas mchod sbyin du sreg zer ro/ kha cig khong rang gi thugs dgongs bzhin byas na ngos drin sobs zer zhing thams cad ma mdzangs ma shi ba'i bu bzhin mya ngan byed do/ / der khong rang zer ba bzhin byas te/ mya ngan de las thar nas glang po'i rus pa bsdus nas sku gdung byas nas bla ma bzhin dus mchod la brtson par gyur to/ / zas dang skom gyi char phab ste/ /sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na rgyal po gser mdog gi yul du lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bab ces ltas mkhan gyis bstan pas/ yod dgu khod mnyam pa ste brtsis kyang 'phral skyes mang pos zos pas lo bcu gcig las ma thub pa na/ rgyal po nyid la 'bras chan bre'u gang lus pa/ rang rgyal zhig gis tshogs rdzogs par mkhyen nas bsod snyoms la byon pas rgyal pos/ da nges par 'chi snyam la/ 'di ni gser mdog gi sbyin pa'i tha ma yin te 'khor rnams yi rang byos shig ces smon lam btab ste phul bas/

de'i mod la 'dzam gling kun tu zas gos sogs ci 'dod pa'i char babs so/ / de'i tshe rgyal po ni nga nyid do gsungs so/ /༈ phangs pa med par btang bar bya/ / thams cad sgrol sbyin pa la dpa' ches nas glang po'i mchog bram ze la byin pas shi pi ba rnams khros te/ ri bo 'bang khar spyugs pa'i tshe'ang shing rta dang gzhon nu gnyis dang*/ btsun mo'ang byin pas/ shi pi ba rnams kyang yid rang nas slar gyi rgyal srid la btsud pa sogs te/ mdor na/ skyes rabs las/ tshong dpon gnyis dang ri bong dang*/ thams cad sgrol dang mchod sbyin no/ /zhes sogs sbyin pa las brtsams pa bcu po 'dir yang*/ sbyin pa'i skabs su rgyas bsdus ci rigs su bshad do/ / ༈ mi zad gter yang 'di yin no/ / sngon byung 'das pa'i dus na/wā rā ṇa sī na/ rgyal po dbang chen sde la chos dang 'jig rten gyi srid phun sum tshogs pa'i tshe/ nyi 'og gi rgyal pos dpung bshams te wā rā ṇa sīr yul btab nas 'dug go / dbang chen sdes 'khor rnams la/ nga tsho gcig gi 'tsho ba tsam gi phyir sdig byed mi phod kyis/ khyed rnams nyi 'og gi rgyal po la phyag tshol cig gsungs pa bzhin byas te dbang chen sde rang nyid nags su song ste rtsa ba dang 'bras bu za zhing 'dug go / de'i tshe bram ze dbul po zhig dbang chen sdes ci 'dod ster bar thos nas phyin pa na/ rgyal pos nga chings la nyi 'og gi rgyal po'i drung du khyer zhig khyod la ci 'dod ster ro smras pas/ bram ze na re ngas ni khyod 'ching mi phod do zer yang*/ rang nyid kyi bcings nas byin te/ bram zes nyi 'og gi rgyal po la smras pa/ 'di ni lha'i dgra lags te/ bdag gis bzung ste mchis so/ / nyi 'og rgyal pos bsams par/ 'di stobs che ba/ bram ze nyams chung 'dis bcing ga la nus/ 'di rang gis rang bcings nas bram ze 'di la byin nges so snyam nas/ bram ze la 'di ji ltar bcings drang por smros shig ces pas/

bram zes kyang drang por smras pas/ nyi 'og ngo mtshar nas bzod pas gsol te/ rgyal srid slar phul nas rang gi yul du song ngo*/ / bram ze'ang nor gyis tshim par byas te/ thams cad dge ba bcu la bkod do/ / dge slong dag nga nyid de'i tshe rgyal po dbang chen sder gyur to zhes so/ /༈ dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las/ /rgyal po stobs mchog gis rgya mtsho bsrubs pas/ nyi zla dang*/ dug bum dang*/ chang zhes pa'i bud med dang*/ bud med bum pa gang sogs byung ba bzhin no/ / le'u gsum pa'o/ / // ka4 le'u bzhi pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ sngags kyis rmongs par byas pa bzhin/ bden pa mthong ba gzugs can snying po la/ sgyu ma mkhan dge bzhin gyis sgyu ma'i gzigs mo zhig kyang 'bul/ bka' phabs shig kyang zhu byas pas/ rgyal po na re/ ngas chos thams cad sgyu mar bltas shing mthong zer/ 'o na bdag gis sang sgyu ma zhig sprul gyis de ltar mkhyen par mdzod cig byas te/ rgyal po ci la mnyes phag tu dris pas/ rta bzang po la'o zer/ des cha lugs bsgyur te/ sgyu sngags kyis rmongs par byas pa'i rta bzang po zhig sprul te khyer phyin nas mjal bar zhus pas rin gyis zer/ rta mchog 'gro ba'i tshe na shes pas/ nga rang gis brtag dgos zer/ 'di ni thul dka'o zhus pas/ ngas rta rgod gang yang mi thul ba med pa gsungs nas bzhon pas ring du khyer te/ yul mtha' zhig tu skyur bas rta ma zin par rmos pa zhig 'dug pa la bza' btung blangs pas/ glang ma shor bar rmaus ded gyis shig /blang ngo zer ro/ / rmos pas shor nas drud de/ srog la thug pa tsam du sdug bsngal/ kho na re/ gang nas gang du 'gro zer ba la rgyu mtshan bshad pas/ da 'gro khungs med na nga'i bu mo sbyin gyis sdod zer te bsdad pas bu sring gnyis byung ste/ gyos sgyug gnyis shi ba'i ro rim bzhin bskyal/ de nas chung ma'ang shi ba'i ro skyel ba la bu sring gis 'jus nas ngu rkyen gyis rgyal pos kyang ngus te nga bsod nams che nas rgyal por/

chung nas 'di lta zhes smre ba la/ dge bzhin gyis se gol gtogs te/ rgyal po ci nongs zhes pas/ rgyal po shu na sku rid par song ste 'dug go / der thams cad sgyu mar gzigs nas/ bdag la sdang zhing*/ rmos pa pha bur zhen pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu lags mod ces pas/ rgyal po skyengs te lan med par gyur to/ / le'u bzhi pa'o/ / // ka5 le'u lnga pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ stag dang seng ge glang chen dred/ /sngon wā rā ṇa sīr/ rin chen go cha la/ btsun mo lnga brgya yod kyang bu med par mya ngan gyi phyag rgyas nyal ba'i rmi lam du lhas bstan pa/ phyi rol na drang srong lcags mdog dang gser gyi mdog can gnyis yod kyis/ gser mdog la bur gsol ba thob cig ces rmis nas/ dge slong don phu bu glang po'i mchog/ la bu dge tshul ut+pal mig/ la ba pu dbyer su ta pa/ / tshong dpon gser yig de dpon dang*/ /sgur chung ma te bcu gsum mo/

/ gsol ba btab pa khas blangs pas/ gcig gis kyang ngo*/ / de gnyis shi nas chen chun gyi mngal du zhugs pa zhag bdun gyi rim pa bur shes te rim gro skyed de zla ba tshang nas btsas pa mtshan mkhan la bstan pas dge don sdig don du btags te/ gtsug lag thams cad la mkhas par bslabs shing*/ cher skyes nas skyed mos tshal ltar phyin pas/ 'bangs thams cad bya ba so sos nyams thag pa dris pas/ pha mes rigs rgyud nas/ so nam na bzhis rang yang 'tshong zhing*/ rgyal po'i bca'ang 'bul zer bas de dag la snying rje bzhin du nags su byon pas/ yengs te gcig pur gol ba'i lam na/ chu bran cig 'dug pa yid du 'ong nas smras pa/ phu chu'i rgyun sgra rnga ltar snyan pa khyod/ / gang nas 'ongs shing gang du 'gro/ / ku co ma che ji ltar rings/ / yud tsam 'dug la gtam gsum thong*/ / zhes pa'i lan du/ ngas/ da nang skye med gangs dkar gyi steng nas 'ongs/ / do nub 'gag med rgya mtsho'i klong du 'gro/ / ku co bdag med stong pa'i rang sgra yin/ / mi sdod 'dus byas 'jig pa'i dpe ru rings/ zer bas/ 'di ni sprul pa'i 'bab chu'o snyam nas/ yang smras pa/ nga yang dge don rgyal po'i bu/ / srog dang bcas pa'i dpal yang g.yo/ / rigs ldan byang chub sgrub rnams kyis/ / lam gyi dang po gang la bslab/ /ces pa'i lan du/ khyod sngon bram ze 'phrin gyur tshe/ / skyob ba mar me mdzad dpal gyis/ / lam gyi dang po sbyin pa zhes/ / rgya cher gsungs pa bsnyel lam ci/ /zhes bskul te/ sngar gyi sdug phongs gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis mi dga' nas/ ngu bzhin du yab kyi drung du phyag byas te/ bdag 'chag pa na/ bran 'bangs thams cad lto'i phyir sdig sdug sna tshogs kyis nyams thag pa 'di dag bskyab pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa gtong gi yo byad stsal du gsol/ zhes pas yab na re/ ngas nor mdzod thams cad khyod kho na'i ched du bzung ba yin gyis/ ci bde bar byin cig/
