ces pa'i lung thob nas/ thams cad du ci 'dod pa sbyin pa la zhugs so/ / de nas mdzod bsrungs kyis mdzod phyed zad do byas pas zad kyang bla zer/ da ni sum gnyis zad do byas pas/ ngas bu'i ngo mi bzlogs kyis/ khyod kyis thabs legs kyis khog cig gi lung thob nas/ mdzod sgo btsud de gzhan du phyin pas/ 'dis 'di mi nus kyis/ yab kyi lung thob par nges la/ spyir yang bus pha'i mdzod stong par byar mi rigs la/ da nor gyis sems can la phan thogs pa'i thabs dris pas/ zhing*/ tshong*/ 'brog/ gling zhes so so nas zer ba'i phyi ma yid la babs nas/ yab la zhus pas/ khyod sbyin pa byed 'dod na/ khyim na ci 'dod yod thams cad byin la/ nyam nga ba'i gnas rgya mtshor 'gror mi gnang ngo zer te/ 'dod pa ma grub par zas bcad de nyal ba la/ thams cad kyis gros btab kyang ma nyan par/ zhag drug lon nas/ da ni do nub ma zos na 'chi bas/ de bas rgya mtsho nas ldog kyang srid do zhes bgros te gnang bas/ ded dpon dge dpal la zhus pas ma nyan par/ rgyal pos bsngags pas/ bdag lo brgya nyi shu lon zhing*/ mig rna yang med pas mi nus mod/ 'on kyang rgyal po'i bka' bcag tu mi rung ngo zhes khas blangs so/ / der sdig don yang 'gran nas/ tshong pa lnga brgya dang bcas pa chas te/ pha mas bskyal nas/ thag pa bdun rim gyis btul nas/ rlung 'dod phyogs nas langs te/ stobs po che'i mda' bzhin song nas/ rin chen gling du slebs te/ bzang ngan dang mang nyung dang*/ lci yang sogs kyi tshad bstan nas sdig don la 'di dag 'go thon cig byas nas/ khong rang ded dpon dang gnyis yid bzhin btsal ba'i phyir gzings chung zhig tu zhugs te song ba yang zhig nas/ rkyal bas ded dpon chad de/ ri dkar/ sngo/ ser/ sna lnga'am/ de dag gser dngul baiḍūr+ya'i ri'o/ / gser ri de'i mdun na gser gyi bye ma zhig yod kyis der ngal bsos shig zer nas/ da nga 'chi bas/

khyed gser ri 'di'i g.yas nas phyin pa na/ lam gyi gsang stong nas/ stag seng sbrul srin sogs bza' ba'i bsam pa 'ong ste/ de dag la byams pa'i blos song zhig/ de dag dul nas pha ma'i 'du shes kyis gnas so/ / de nas rin chen bdun gyi mkhar zhig yod do/ / de'i sgo rdos brdungs pas/ lha mo lnga brgyas so so nas nor bu 'bul lo// de nas lha mo lhag par gzugs bzang ba zhig gis nor bu sngon po zhig phul te/ de yid bzhin yin pas/ de ma thob de thob ma thag ma shor bar bzung la/ chags zhen med par sems can la byams brtse'i sems kyis dbang po'i sgo sdoms la myur du bros shig/ de ci'i phyir na/ yid bzhin shin tu dkon pas/ klu dag phrag dog cing 'dod pa srid pas so/ / zer nas tshe'i dus byas so/ / de nas de'i dus bu la bskor ba byas te bye ma la sbas nas/ ded dpon gyi ngag bzhin phyin pas/ de bzhin du thob nas nor bu'i mthus de ma thag tu slebs nas sdig don dang 'phrad de/ tshong pa rnams dris pas/ gzings nya mid kyis bcom nas/ ngas ro la 'jus pa gcig pur thon pa'o/ / tshong pa snying rje te/ khyod thon pa'i legs so byas pas/ nor med par gson kyang ci rung zer/ de'i mya ngan mi dgos nga la yid bzhin yod kyis zhes bstan pas phrag dog skyes pa'i tshe/ dge don gyis nga dub pas gnyid log gis/ khyed kyis nga dang nor bu la gnod pa bsrungs shig ces pas/ glags rnyed de mig tu tsher ma btsugs nas nor bu khyer te bros pas/ de bsad kyis dogs nas/ chom rkun byung ngo nor bu khyer la bros shig byas pas/ lhas chom rkun sdig don nyid zer bas/ yi mug nas bros pas/ dred gnas su song ste/ za 'dod de/ drung du phyin pas bu bzhin gyur nas tsher ma bton nas li shi'i ri 'dabs su bskyal bas/ glang khyu'i brdzi ba khyu mchog gis bskyabs te mig la ldag pas zug ngu med par byas so/

/ de nas glang rdzis gsos pas/ de'ang skyo bar shes te/ li shi'i grong 'dabs su bskyal pas/ rol mo dang legs bshad kyis kun dga' bar byas nas sprang po lnga brgya yang sos so/ /de nas rgyal pos skyed mos tshal bsrung bar bskos pas mig med pas so zer mig med kyang bla'i/ skye shing la g.yer kha btags te/ the gus 'then la bsrungs shig ces pas thams cad 'dus te/ rgyal po'i bu mo yang bdag ni 'di dang zas lhan cig za zer ba la/ sprang po dang lhan cig zos nas rgyal pos chad pa yong byas kyang ma nyan par/ dgong mo'ang bos kyang bdag 'di'i khyim thab tu 'dug pas nang du mi 'ong zer/ khyod ni dge don la byin tshar na/ sprang po la dga' ba smyos sam zhes bkag kyang ma khegs par gnyis ka khab tu blangs te bzhag go / der bu mo gzhan du song ba la/ khyod skyes pa gzhan dang*/ spyugs so byas pas/ khyod sprang long zhig la ngas gtam khyad du bsad de dga' bar byas pa la khyod snyon 'debs pa mi rigs mod/ 'on kyang nga skyes pa gzhan la rdul tsam zhig kyang sems pa yod na bdag kyang long zhig/ de med na khyod kyi mig gcig gis mthong bar gyur cig ces pas/ mig gnyis gsal bar gyur pa dang*/ khyod kyis nga su yin shes sam/ shes te sprang po dmu long ngo*/ rin chen go cha'i bu dge don thos sam/ de nga yin no/ / de la dpang po su yod zer ba la| de nga yin na bdag gi mig ya gcig gis kyang mthong bar gyur cig byas pas/ mig gnyis ka 'gran pa bzhin gyur to/ / der bu mos rgyal po la glengs te/ bzod par gsol nas/ rgyang grags gcig skyed de/ gdod rgya mtsho nas 'khor ba skad byas te bsus nas/ bu mo yang byin te/ yo byad thams cad kyis bskur ro/ / sdig don yul du slebs nas/ dge don dang*/ tshong pa thams cad shi'o zhes pas thams cad rgyal ste/ sangs pa dang*/ dge don chung ngu'i rtser grogs ngang pa dkar po'i mgul du yi ge btags te rgya mtsho'i bar du btsal bas der rnyed nas/

sdig don gyis 'di ltar byas so zhes pa'i yi ge lan bskur bas/ sdig don khri mon du bcug ste de/ li shi la nga'i bu g.yog dang bcas te ma bskyal na/ nga da dung bcas der 'ong zhes bsrings pas/ skyug nas rta glang lnga brgya nor gyis mnan te/ bu mo g.yog dang bcas pa bskyal pas/ yab yum gyis bsu ba la phyag byas nas/ sdig don dris pas/ khri mon na yod de/ de btang du mi rung zer/ 'o na bdag kyang nang du mi mchi'o/ / zhes pas/ btang nas nu bo la bsnyun sman de lhag par byams so/ / gleng langs te nor bu lam du sbas pa btsal kyang ma rnyed par dge don gyis phyin pas nor bus rgyang grags gcig bsu de rnyed pa la/ 'di nor bu yin yang dag na/ bdag gi pha ma'i mig gsal ba dang*/ khang khri na bza' gdugs sogs thams cad rin chen las grub pa dang*/ sngar sbyin gtong gis zad pa'i mdzod kun lhag par yang 'byor par gyur cig byas pa bzhin gyur te/ der dus bzang po la gos gtsang gyon nas khrus byas te/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la btags te yid bzhin yin yang dag na/ thams cad du ci 'dod 'bab par gyur cig ces pas/ rlung gis mi gtsang ba phyags te/ char gyis mnan nas/ zas gos 'bru dbyig sogs 'dod dgu babs te/ thams cad gang gis kyang 'bral ba med pa'i tshe/ ngas lus srog la ma bltas par 'bral 'bras 'dzam gling kun phongs pa rgyun chad pas/ thams cad kyis sdig bcu spongs/ dge bcu bsgrubs shig ces/ bkar btags te/ de bzhin bsgrubs pas/ shi ba thams cad kyang lhar skyes so/ / spong ba'i sems ni thob pa la/ mi pha bu gnyis yod pa gnyis ka dge slong byas pa na/ pha shin tu dka' thub la gnas pas/ dro yol na mi gsol bas/ de lta na pha rgud par dwogs nas/ 'grogs te phyin pa'i tshe myur bar bskul kyang*/ pha 'gros zhan pa la/ bus rgyab nas phul bas/ mgo rdo la thug ste shi yang*/ bu de rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes pa ni theg chen pas sems gtso bos so/

/ khro ba'i sems 'di gcig bcom na/ / rgyal po gtsug na rin po ches/ / glang po'i mchog bram ze la byin pa rgyal phran cig la btsongs te/ des nyid dmag drangs pas/ tshe 'di'i phyir sdig mi nus gsung ngo*/ rgyal srid kyang de la byin no/ / sems gsal cig skyed 'bras bu yang*/ /ma bu gnyis chus khyer ba na byang sems gsal por skyes pas shi 'phos nas tshangs par skyes so/ / bud med khrod na gnas kyang rung*/ /ston pa 'das nas ring po ma lon pa'i tshe/ yul ang gha dha na khrims lnga bsrung ba'i bram ze zhi dpal ces pa rnam thos kyi bu ltar 'byor pa gcig la/ mchod gnas gser mchog zhes pa sde snod gsum mkhyen cing*/ bslab gsum 'dzin pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa de/ nyin re bzhin gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren pa la/ lam du tsha drang gi nyon mongs shing*/ dge sbyong gi bar du gyur pas/ phyin chad skyes par zhus so/ / yul de'i khyim bdag gi bu gcig bstan pa la dad nas/ ston pa dam pa la brten par 'dod nas/ dge slong de la zhus pas/ de'i lha mig dag pas gzigs pa na/tshul khrims kyi snyan grags phyogs bcur rgyas te/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa zhig 'byung bar shes nas/ dge tshul du byas ste lha mchog ces btags so/ / dge bsnyen gyi khyim gang gi mi kun mdza' bos ston mo la bos te/ de'i bu mo bde dpal zhes pa lo bcu drug lon pa de khyim bsrung du bcug go / de na de dag gis mi rgyud tshun chad kyi mchod gnas bram ze g.yon can na gu le zhes pa/ de dag la phrag dog pas skur ba gdab pa'i skabs rnyed de/ gser mchog can phyin nas/ dge bsnyen brel bas gdugs tshod blang bar rigs so zhes bskul bas/ long med na za spyod pa mi rigs kyis/ khyod bag yod par gyis la zas longs shig ces pas/ lha mchog gi bka' bzhin bgyi'o/ / zhes mkhan po'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te song bas/

sgo brdung ba la/ bu mos su yin dris pas/ bdag mkhan pos bsod snyoms len du btang byas pas/ bu mo dga' ste bdag gi bsam pa grub mod/ 'on kyang 'di gnyen po goms shing*/ tshul khrims la gces spras che bas/ glags rnyed dka' bas brtag go snyam nas/ bu mos sdig pa'i gzugs shig byas/ bran mo lha rten gyi phag tu sbas te/ sdig gzugs 'di la skrag na bden pa ma mthong nges kyis/ khyod kyi tshul khrims ma dag pa de thong la/ bu mo dang lhan cig bde ba'i ro myangs pas gnyen po'i stobs 'phel te/ slar blangs nas bsrungs na myur du grol lo zhes lhas bstan pa'i tshul du smros shig byas te/ sdig gzugs skyur bas sngangs pa na/ bran mos smras pa'i rjes su 'jam pos gleng ste/ khyim 'di'ang rnam thos kyi dpal ltar 'byor kyang bdag la ming po med pas/ khyod kyis bdag po mdzod cig/ bdag gis khol mo bgyid do/ / de min na'ang*/ lhas bstan pa bzhin de ring bdag gi re ba bsgrubs la/ slar blangs te bsrungs na stobs che bar thob kyis/ phyin chad lhag par yang zhabs thog go zhes pas/ dge tshul 'di snyam du/ kye ma/ 'di'i 'dod chags kyi mes bdag gi tshul khrims kyi shing sreg go / bros te bltas na sgro skur sna tshogs kyis bram ze dag gis 'dod pa'ang grub la/ bsdad na ni sangs rgyas kyi rigs sun phyung ste bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bcag par gyur gyi/ de bas srog chad pa bla'i/ bcas pa nyams na mi rung ngo snyam nas/ bu mo la khyod kyis sgo chod cig / kho bos cho ga cung zad cig bya'o/ / zhes khang phugs su song ste/ chos gos gdang bu la gzar nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ bdag dkon mchogamakhan po sogs spong ba min gyis/ tshul khrims mi spang ba'i slad du/ lus spangs pas khrims 'bras dal 'byor thob nas/ gzhon nu la rab tu byung ste/ lam goms 'bras sangs rgyas myur du thob par rgyur cig/ ces smos nas/

spu gris mgul ba bcad de tshe 'phos so/ / bu mos/ thogs te bos kyang ma byung bar nang du phyin pa dang*/ tshe 'phos pa mthong ste nas sngangs te/ 'dod chags kyi me zhi/ mya ngan gyi mtsho rdol/ 'gyel te rgyal ba'i tshe/ phas 'khor te sgo brdung kyang ma thos par grong rgyud de 'ongs pas/ bu mo rgyal ba mthong nas chu gtor dris pas/ drang por smras nas ngo tsha zhing*/ dge tshul gyis rkyal ka byas so zhes skur ba btab nas dmyal bar skyes/ 'on kyang*/ khong sku tshe'i bar chad kyi sdig gis chog snyam nas/ drang por smras pas/ pha mgo smad de/ 'dus byas thams cad gyi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa yin mod/ mya ngan ma byed ces te/ phugs su ltas pas de'i ro khrag gis sbags kyang mdangs ma yal bar mthong nas/ e ma ho/ lus srog la'ang mi gzigs par tshul khrims bsrung ba ngo mtshar che/

zhes bstod de phyag 'tshal nas/ de'i rgyal khrims kyis tshul ldan khyim du grongs na gser gyi dong tse stong gi chad pa yod pa khyer nas/ rgyal po la/ bdag gis cung zad nongs kyis/ dong tshe 'di dag bzhes shig byas pas/ yul 'di na drang zhing chos la dad pa ni khyod kho na yin na| nyes pa dag cing srid de byas pas/ bu mo la smad de/ dge tshul la bstod nas/ drang por zhus pas/ bu mo la smad du ci yod/ 'ching ba las ma grol ba kun gyi chos nyid yin no mod/ dge tshul lus srog la ma gzigs par tshul khrims bsrungs pa ni/ 'jig rten na dkon no/ / de la khyod la nyes pa gar yod/ dong tse khyo rang khyer gcig/ nga de'i rus pa la mchod dad cig la 'gro'o/ / zhes gser rnga brdungs te/ zhabs 'bring ba sum cu dang bcas pas/ rus pa la phyag 'tshal te bstod nas/ rus pa rin chen shing rta las spyan drangs te/ spos dang tsan dan gyis bsregs shing mchod pas/ sa g.yos te me tog gi char babs/ bu mo de kun gyi mthong sar bzhag nas/ nga'i chab 'og tsam na 'di las gzugs bzang ba med na/ de la'ang ma chags par tshul khrims kyi phyir sku srog gtong pa ni shin tu yang ngo mtshar ro/ / zhes/ slob dpon yang spyan drangs te chos bstan pas thams cad kyis tshul khrims la gces spras byas nas byang chub tu sems skyed do/ / srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces/ /yul ka shi ka'i rgyal po tshangs byin gyis/ gdol pa lnga la/ khyed song la/ ri kha ba can gyi drung nas/ glang po che ut+pa la'i mig ces bya ba yod pa'i mche ba longs shig bsgo bas/ rngon pas chos gos gyon nas/ dge sbyong gi cha lugs la mchan du dug mda' sbas pas bsad kyang*/ glang pos cha lus la gus pa dang bkur sti byas pa'i phyir/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba snod du 'gyur tam/ ma gyur kyang*/ de la 'tsho ba sogs byed pa de ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la 'tsho ba'o/

/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /༈ slob dpon lwa ba pas/ u rgyan du spyod pa la phyin pas/ phyi pa'i rnal 'byor mas lag pa la yid kyis ut+pal bris pa/ rjes su nang pa'i rnal 'byor mas mthong ste khyod la phyi pas glags 'tshol bas/ lha sgoms zhes pa bzhin bsgoms kyang*/ me ri rdo ra sogs skyed rim gyis thub pa mi 'dra nas/ stong par bsgoms pas / la ba logs su bor ba rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis bgos nas zos pa la/ sang rgyal po la zhus te/ rnal 'byor pa sems stobs che ba bas/ blon po rnams kyi chung ma tsher lcag gis brabs pa na/ lwa ba mtho re bskungs so/ / gong ba nas mtho gang ma tshang ba rgyal po'i btsun mo che ba gser thod can gyis bskungs te bsgrigs pas tshang ba lta bu'o/ mkhan po rjes su bstan pa dang*/ rgyal byed kyi tshal na 'phags pa ka t+ya na ya bzhugs pas/ pu dbyi ra'i rgyal po 'byor ldan de la mi rtag pa'i chos bshad pas dad nas rab tu byung ngo*/ / de dgon pa zhig na sems srung zhing sgom pa'i drung du/ rgyal po gzhan zhig ri dwags bshor ba'i btsun mos chos zhus pa la phrag dog skyes nas/ pu dbyi ra tsher lcag gis brabs pas bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pas/ sems 'khrugs te/ ka t+ya na'i drung du phyin nas rgyu mtshan bshad de/ kho mos sdom pa dbul lo/ / nga'i dpung bzhi po blangs te rgyal po 'di brlag par byed do zer ba la/ mi rtag pa'i chos bshad kyang ma nyan pa na do nub nga'i gam du nyol la sang sdom pa phul zhig byas pas/ de'i nub mkhan pos byin rlabs kyis/ kho'i rmi lam du/ rang gi dpung bzhi blangs nas rgal bas pham nas/ pu dbyi ra rang nyid kyang rtul po'i lag tu shor ba rmis nas/ sad de skrag nas/ mkhan pos skyabs su gsol zhes rmi lam bzlas pas/ mkhan po na re mang bas nyung ba rgyal ba yod/ / zhes sogs chos bshad pas sdom pa dbul bshol te/ rtse gcig tu sgom pa mkhan po'i drin no/

/ sangs rgyas chu zla/ su da pa'i bu la/ dam pa rnams dang lan gcig tsam/ / ji ltar 'dod par phrad kyang rung*/ / 'dris par bya bar mi dgos par/ / rab tu brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes sogs chos sho lo ka gsum bshad nas dad de/ dam bca' bzhi 'bul lo zhes pa la/ bden pa'i brtul zhugs longs la srog chags gsod pa spongs/ /skye bo btson du bzung ba 'di rnams btang bar gyis// dpa' bo khyod kyis mi sha za ba thong*/ /dam pa'i nang nas 'di bzhi byin par gyis/ /zhes sogs kyis btul nas/ slar kho rang gi rgyal srid la btsud pa'ang mkhan po bsten pa'i phan yon no/ / yon tan shes par rig par bya/ / med la yon tan sgrog pa ni/ / dam pa rnams la skur 'debs 'dra/ /ston pa 'di/ rgyal po bsod 'phel gyi blon po dpal 'phel du gyur pa na/ tshong dpon rgyal po'i drung du song shul du sgyug mo bu mo la phrad pa'i tshe/ khyod kyi khyim thab de spyod tshul ci 'dra/ bu mo khyim thab la sdod pa ngo tsha bas mgo smad de bcom skyungs nas/ de lta bu'i spyod tshul ni rab tu byung ba la'ang ma mchis so zhes pas/ ma rgas shing rna ba mi gsang bas/ rab tu byung zhes pa'i sgra tsam gcig thos te/ bdag gis mag pa rab tu byung zhes ngus pas/ 'o na ma bdag gi mya ngan sel du 'ongs so snyam nas/ bu mos kyang ngus/ nang mi khyim mtshes kun 'dus te ngu ba/ tshong dpon gyis ci nyes snyam nas g.yog gcig bltar btang bas/ jo bo 'byor pa'i khyim spangs te rab tu byung zhes thos pas/ mya ngan byed zer/ khong rnams re ba ma grub par khyim du mchi ba g.yar ngo tsha zer te/ rings par rgyal po'i drung du log ste rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ khyod la mi bde ba gang yod gsal gyis/ de skad ma zer zhig/ byas pas/ khyed lta bu la brten pa la mi bde ba gar mchi/ thams cad bdag la rab tu byung ba re ba la/ de ma grub par khyim du mchi ba ngo tsha zer/ 'jig rten pa'i mu gcor gyi tshig tsam la brten nas nged thams cad yal bar 'dor ba mi rigs so zer kyang*/

nan gyis zhus pas gnang ste/ nye 'brel thabs sna tshogs kyis bzlog pa'i tshig rnams bags kyis bris nas nags su song ngo*/ / des na/ dge bshes ston pa/ dge slong sogs brjod na de'i spyod tshul la 'bad do/ / yon tan dang ni phan thogs shing*/ /ston pa mnyan yod na 'khor brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang thabs gcig bzhugs so/ / de'i tshe khyim bdag la gcig gi chung ma la khye'u mdzes shing lta na sdug pa khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa gcig skyes pa de/ shis sam mi shis snyam nas khu tshur kha phye bas gser gyi dong tse re re byung ngo*/ / pha ma gnyis rab tu dga' ste/ dong tse blangs te yang khu tshur 'chang ngo*/ / mtshan mkhan la bstan pas mtshan rab tu bzang ste/ ming yang gser yig tu btags so/ / de'i khu tshur phye res kyis gser gyi dong tse re byung bas/ pha ma'i bang mdzod thams cad gang yang da dung zad pa med do/ / de cher skyes nas pha ma la rab tu byung bar zhus nas/ dge slong du gyur pa'i tshe yang*/ phyag gar 'tshal par gser gyi dong tse byung bar gyur te/ de nas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /kun dga' bos ston pa la/ dge slong gser yig 'dis sngon las ci bgyis te 'di lta bu'i tshul lags zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa bskal ba dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi sngon rol du/ sangs rgyas gser thub 'jig rten du byung ba de 'khor bcas/ khyim bdag rigs gnyis kyis spyan drangs te 'byor pa phul bas/ de'i tshe shing thun dbul po gcig kyang dad nas/ nyin ring btus pa'i shing btsongs pas gser gyi dong tse gnyis rnyed de/ khyim bdag gi sgo drung du bcom ldan 'das byon pa la/ gzhan dga' ba dang gus pa'i sgo nas phul bas/ ston pas kyang brtse bar dgongs nas bzhes te smon lam btab bo// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ / gzhan yang*/ nag po pa'i dkyil chog las/ skye bo phal pa stong phrag gnyis/ /bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang mnyam/

/bram ze gtsang ma stong phrag gnyis/ /dge slong gcig la rab tu sbyar/ /dge slong stong phrag gnyis dag ni// rdul med pa ni gcig dang mnyam/ /rdul med stong phrag gnyis dag ni/ /ye shes ldan pa gcig dang sbyar/ /ye shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis/ /slob dpon gcig dang mnyam par brtag/ces sogs kyi bar du gsungs so/ /phan 'dogs pa'i zhing ni mdza' bo bu sogs bshad zin to/ /rdul gyi zhing pur pa'i mdo la sogs pa bzhin/ yang gal te yod na dge 'dun mchod/ /yang na byis pa'i ston mo bya/ /mgon mo rnams la byin pa ni/ / bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces so/ /༈ bkag pa rnams kyang de la gnang*/ /ded dpon snying rje che ldan des/ / sems can gyi dbul ba bskyab pa'i phyir rgya mtshor 'gro nus pa su yod ces dril bsgrags te/ tshong pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig chas pas/ 'phongs rtsal la goms pa'i chom rkun bha tsi zhes pa gcig kyang tshong pa'i cha lugs kyis zhugs te/ don grub na tshong pa rnams rgya mtshor pho la/ nor rnams kho bos bya'o/ / snyam du sems skyed do/ / der gzings nor dbyig gis gang ste/ 'dzam gling du 'khor khar chom rkun des da ni dus la bab bo snyam pa'i tshe/ rgya mtsho'i lhas/ ded dpon gyi rmi lam du/ 'di na bha tsi zhes pa bong che ba/ ngam gnag pa/ mig dmar ba/ stobs rgyas pa gcig 'dug pa des sems skyed pa myur du brtsams pas/ de bzlog pa'i thabs la myur du 'bod gcig /ma bzlog na tshong pa 'di rnams phyir mi ldog pa kho na yin pas/ bha tsi dmyal ba mtha' med du ltung ngo*/ / zhes rmi ba sad nas/ der rlung log ste/ zhag bdun sdod pa'i tshe bsams pa/ smras na tshong pa rnams kyi stobs shugs kyis bsad de/ tshong pa dmyal bar ltung*/ gzhan na tshong pa srog dang 'bral zhing bha rtsi dmyal bar ltung*/ bha tsi gsad na bdag rang dmyal bar ltung ste/ gang ltar yang dmyal ba'i gnas las ma 'das pas/

bdag gis tshong pa'i srog bsrung zhing*/ bha tsi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyab pa'i phyir/ bskal ba 'bum du dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bdag gis bzod par bya'o/ / snyam du snying rje'i blos/ kho rang gi seng ldeng gi mdung phrogs te kho rang la bsnun pas/ nga'i skal ba 'bum gyi 'khor ba phyir bsnyil la/ tshong pa rnams 'dzam gling du bde bar phyin nas dge ba la bkod cing*/ bha tsi lhar skyes so/ /༈ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad/ /rnal 'byor ma sgur chung mas stan dma' ba la 'dug ste/ rgyal po'i btsun mo gser khri mthon po la 'dug pa du ma la chos yang yang bshad kyang*/ dngos grub rdul tsam yang ma rnyed de/ slob dpon gyi drung du phyin nas nga'i slob ma la yon tan mi 'byung ba ci zhus pas/ ma gus pa'i nyes pa ste/ btsun mo rnams khri las phob cig zer ba bzhin btsun mo rnams kyis rang rang gi rigs kyi nga rgyal bcom nas khri las babs te stan dma' ba la 'dug/ sgur chung ma gser khri la bzhag ste chos mnyan nas dngos grub rnyed do/ / le'u lnga pa'o// // ka6 le'u drug pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ drang srong dang*/ rgyal gdam pa'i go ra ba/ rma bya tsher ma ut+pal mdog / lha sbyin gser 'bum ma he dang*/ / dkon gnyer glang lug mang nus sogs/ / ser thub lnga sde zhi dge dang*/ / rgyal po zla 'od byan lag dang*/ / gtum po dang ni nyi shu'o// ༈ khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ ༈ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mu stegs mang po mtsho ma pham la khrus byed du song ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang bcas pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la ngang pa khyu lding ba bzhin du gshegs pa/ bal yul gyi thad du slebs pa na/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi skra spu las byas pa'i mchod rten de la dge slong gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal ba mthong nas/ de'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni ci tsam zhes bstan pa/

'khor rnams kyi zhus pa'i tshe/ bka' stsal pa/ kho rang 'dug sa nas/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thugs pa'i bar gyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ / zhes so/ / der mtsho drung du/ tshul shing la bris pa rnams kyi nang nas/ gnas brtan 'od srung ma tshang ba la/ mchog gnyis sbron du btang bas/ 'gror ma nyan pa la/ rdzun 'phrul gyis khrid par brtsams pas/ sgul bar yang ma nus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'od srung gi ting nge 'dzin bshig ste bkug go / der sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyis khrus byas te/ slar gshegs pa na/ bal yul gyi thad du slebs pa na/ sngar gyi dge slong de grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa gcig dang 'thab cing*/ khong khro drag po'i sgo nas man ji phar 'phen tshur 'phen byed pa mthong nas/ zhus pa/ 'di'i sdig pa'i tshad ni ji tsam lags/ bka' stsal pa/ sngar gyi rgyal por skye ba'i las bcom nas/ gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar gyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dmyal bar skye'o/ / gsungs nas mnyan yod du gshegs so/ / bka' bzlog dad dang karna pa/ /lha rnams pham pa'i tshe/ lha chen dbang phyug dpa' bas dka' thub las bzlog nas g.yul du 'jug pa'i thabs su/ de 'dod yon la sred pas/ lha rnams tshogs te sha son mo re bsdus nas/ lha mo dbu ma zhes pa'i gzugs byad shin tu mdzes pa gcig sprul nas/ dbang chen la phul te/ dka' thub las bzhengs nas g.yul du 'jug par zhus pas/ dka' thub las bzhengs kyang*/ 'dod pas g.yengs te g.yul du 'jug tu ma 'dod par/ de dbral ba'i phyir me lhas sbyor mtshams nas me sbar bas/ khong 'khrugs te sa bon brabs nas rgyab pa/ thal nas rgya mtshor lhung ba lan tshar chags te/ lhas sbyin lan tsha mi za ba'i rgyu de'o/ / der dbang chen 'khrugs nas drag por gyur te/ dbu ma yang gyed nas/ lha'i bu stobs 'phel gyis rang lus bsregs te/

dbu ma mchod pas mnyes nas/ dbang chen mgu bar byas te g.yul du zhugs nas lha rnams rgyal bar byas pas/ ding sang yang dbu ma mnyes pa'i thabs su rang lus sreg pa bzod par byed do/ / karna pa ni bod skad drongs nag pa ste/ kho sgrub pa byed pa'i nye 'khor du/ nyi zla gzas zin pa'i tshe/ bsam gtan pa gnyis khon cung zad kyis mgo bo gcod res byas te shi ba/ nag po'i mngon shes kyis tshangs par skyes pa mthong nas/ der de lta bus skye'o zhes khos smras pas/ de nga sang yang de'i ched du mgo bo gcod res kyis sdug bsngal bzod par bya'o/ /sogs khongs nas/ lha chen rgyal ba dam pa dka' thub kyi gnas na 'dug pa'i nye 'khor du/ nang pa'i rang rgyal zhig yo byad cung zad kyi phyir mi rgod kyis bshus nas shing la bcings te shi ba/ rgyal ba dam pa'i mngon shes kyis gang du'ang skye ba ma mthong bar/

des/ de lta bus shi na skye med du grol zhes grags pas/ deng sang yang gcer bu pa'i dka' spyad de lta bu bzod par byed do/ / goms na sla bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gso thigs su/ go ra ba bzhin zhes pas/ tshangs byin gyis blon po go ra ba'i mal la bde bar gnyid myangs par bltas pas/ 'bol bar nas rta rnga gcig byung ba thos pas/ de lta bu'i tshor rtog ni rgya byin la'ang med do zhes/ slob 'dabs nas phyung nas/ rang khyim du bu smad kyis bskul nas shing 'tshong ba na brag rong nas rkang rjen du tsher khur khur te glu len pa/ rgyal pos gsan te/ khyod dang po rta rnga la smre sngags 'don/ da lta tsher khur 'og nas glu len pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ dang po rgyal po'i sku drin gyis bskyabs pas blon 'bangs thams cad kyis khur te/ dar 'bol bdun brtsegs kyis steng du 'jam 'khril gsum phrug gyon nas zhim mngar gzhan gyis snyod kyang lang yod kyis skyid du tshor ba'ang ma byung*/ da lta bu smad kyis brnyas/ ri rogs rnams kyis kyang gshe zhing*/ brag rong nas tsher ma khur te tshigs ma za yang*/ ngan goms kyis sdug tu tshor ba'ang ma mchis pas/ skyid sdug thams cad lus kyis min par sems goms pa'i shugs po zhes zhus pas/ drang po zhig go zhes/ slar blon por btsud do/ / khro ba de bzhin skye bar 'gyur/ / wā ra ṇa sīr/ dge slong bsod snyoms pa gcig 'ongs pas/ khyim bdag cig nor bu zhig skems shing*/ drung nas rma bya zhig kyang 'dug go / dge slong gi zla ba dmar po'i 'od nor bu la phog pas dmar por song ba/ rma byas shar bsams te zos so/ / khyim bdag gis bsod snyoms blangs te/ 'ongs pa na nor bu med de/ dge slong la btsugs pas/ ngas ma khyer tsam las rma byas zos pa ma smras so/ / kho khros te gos la mdud pa byed pa na/ dge slong gis kyang gos la mdud pa byas so/ / der khyim bdag gis rma bya la rtog pa phog te shi ba'i tshe/

nor bu rma byas zos pa bshad do/ / sngar mi smra ba ni khyod kyis rma bya gsad kyis dwogs pas so/ kho na re khyod la'ang zhe sdang yod de/ nga mdud pa byed tshe/ khyed kyang byed pas so zer/ nga sems ma 'gyur mod/ khyod kyis nga gsod pas/ spyod lam bsdam pa'i phyir mdud pa byas pa'o/ / byas pas/ khyim bdag dad de nor bu yon du phul nas sems bskyed do/ / de nas/ lwa ba/ nor bu/ rma bya gsum las/ khyim bdag la zhe sdang skye ba rten 'brel yin mod/ ༈ tsher ma la sogs gnod pa byed/ /ma ga dha'i na len+d+ra na/ lha khang chen po bcu bzhi/ phran sum brgya yod pa la/ kha che bden pa'i byang chub ces pa mgron po zhig gis khyim zhig tu nyal bas/ gzhi ba zhig gis nyal du ma bcug pa la/ zhe sdang skyes nas 'di thams cad yul nas phyung la/ nga gcig pus yul 'di bzung snyam nas rang gi lha la re ba cher byas so/ / de lha rmi ba'i phyir tsher phung chen po zhig gi steng du nyal te sdug bsngal bar byas so/ / der shin tu rid par gyur te/ nam zhig lha rmi lam du byung nas khyod ci 'dod zer/ nga yul ma ga dha ri 'dod byas/ de nas sems bskyed pa sogs yul khyad par can mang po yod pas phyung na sdig 'ong zer/ sdig 'ong yang 'dod byas pas/ 'o na yul khyer la sdig ma byed zer ro/ / der gnyid sad nas tsher gseb nas langs te/ ma ga dhar/ rgyal po'i drung du phyin nas/ dge 'dun 'di rnams yo byad thams cad rang gi g.yog la bgos nas dge ba mi byed pas/ 'di thams cad phyung la ngas bzung ngo*/ / zhes smras pas/ rgyal pos kyang de bzhin gnang ste/ lha'i nus pas rang nyidablon po chen po'i khrims bcas te mnga' thang ni shin tu che'o/ / nam zhig de 'chi nad kyis zin pa na/ g.yog rgya gar bas snabs snod gzhan bstsal g.yog pen dha bas snabs lag pas blangs pas/ nga'i blon srid/ da ni pen dha ngos la sbyin bsam/ g.yog gnyis pos nged gnyis su la ster dris pas/

khyed gnyis rgyal po'i drung du song la dris shig zer ro/ /der pen dhas gos gsar pa sbas te hrul po gyon/ rgya gar bas sar pa gon phyin nas sdug bsngal byung*/ pen dhas gos gsar pa brjes te go gnas/ rgyal po la nged kyi blon po shi bas/ blon srid nged gnyis su la ster byas pas/ rgyal po na re/ rgya gar ba khyod rang gi gos kyang ga dar mi nus na blon po ga la 'ong zer te/ pen dha ba la byin nas da lta des bzung skad do/ / bdag sdug nyid kyang gsod byed pa/ /nyo chang pa zhig bzi ste nam phyed na 'ongs pa la/ chung ma bu skyes te sgo 'byed ma nus pas/ khong khros te sgo bcag nas khyod bu shos la zo zhig/ de min gsod zer bas/ chung ma rang srog la chags nas/ bu bshas te zos so/ / der ya mtshan che bar gyur te/ rgyu mtshan ni skye ba snga ma rgyal po gcig gi chen mar gyur kyang bu med nas/ chun la bu gcig btsas pa'i tshangs bug tu khab bcug ste bsad pas/ chun ma na re/ nga'i bu khyod kyis bsad zer/ mos ma bsad/ bsad na phyi ma rang gi bu bsad nas rang gis za bar gyur cig/ bu la la spyang gis za zhing*/ la la chur khyer bar gyur cig/ gson po la dur du yang yang 'jug par gyur cig/ sogs brjod pa'i las te/ rgyas par dge slong ma ut+pa la'i mdog gi rnam thar sogs las shes so/ / bzod pas bdag sdig mang du 'byang*/ / sngon tshe lo dpag med kyi dus na/ grong khyer sum stong gis rim pa bzhin bskor ba'i rgyal pos sbyin pa dang tshul khrims ni rdzogs par mdzad pa na/ gnod byed med pas nga la bzod pa sgom du med do/ /da 'khor rnams kyi nang nas/ nga la su snying brtse ba gcig gis nga la ci gnod gyis shig nga bzod pa sgom zhes pas/ de'i tshe mi zhig la rim pa tha ma'i sgo gnyer gtad pa lo stong thub ste/ rim pa gnyis pa'ang gtad pas/ lo stong stong du sgo gnyer thub pas mthar rgyal po nyid kyi pho brang yang gnyer byas pa des/

rgyal po la phan na/ ngas gang gnod bya zer te/ byas pas bzod phyin rdzogs te/ de ni lhas byin no/ / bdag gi rnyed pa 'dir 'dor gyis/ / rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ kha che'i btsun pa zhig la gser bum pa gang yod la/ de 'chi ba'i tshe 'gro mi nus bzhin du phyin nas gser de la shin tu chags nas chab khung du bskyur ro/ / de'i ro dur khrod du bskyal te/ gser btsal bas ma rnyed do/ / phyis rigs ngan gyis lud 'don pa na rtog rtse then gyis byung ba de bltas pas/ gser bum la sbal pa zhig 'khril 'dug pa/ phral bas ma phrel bar/ sbal pa btubs nas gser khyer ro/ / der rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su mgar ba zhig la gser bag tsam zhig gsang nas btsongs pas/ mgar ba 'khus nas bshad pas/ dge 'dun gyis rigs ngan bskyigs te gser phrogs so/ / thams cad las la rag las na/ /tshong pa mang po'i gzings zhig ste/ mi bdun/ ma he dang brgyad thon pa ltogs te/ 'dzan ma 'bi ris/ ma he'i sha ran tsam re gson po re la bcad cing zos/ mi bdun pos de mi gtsang bas/ ltogs pa rung ngo zer te rtsa ba sogs zos so/ / der yul du sleb pa dang*/ ma he'i sha zad de/ shi ma thag zhe sdang gis/ yul de'i rdzing du chu srin du skyes nas mi skad du nga ro chen po bton pas/ chu len sogs rgyun chad de/ nga ni mi gcig min pa la mi gnod kyis/ ma skrag zer ro/ /nam zhig 'dzan ma bhi ris khrus byed du phyin pas/ chu srin gyis bzung nas/ mgo nas til tsam re bcad cing zos te/ yun ring du sdug bsngal lo/ /༈ dmyal ba bral na cis ma legs/ lho phyogs a mo gha pa sha'i gtsug lag khang gi dkon gnyer/ rgyal po sa ཾ ga pha la'i blon po lhar bcas kyis/ tsan dan gor shi ba'i sgor rgyab nas bzhogs te btsongs pas/ khyim thab bde ldan gyis/ sku tshab gyis la sdig pa sbyong*/ min na sdig can gcig bde bar mi gnas/ zer ba bzhin byas pas/

dag rtags cung zad kyis brod pa skyes te/ nyin mtshan zas gnyid mi dran par 'bad pas/ rgyab thams cad rmar song ste/ zug gzer ma bzod par khyim thab bos te/ 'thon byas pas/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mthong chos su 'dren pa yin gyis 'bod cig byas pas/ nam zhig sku rgyab dreg pa can zhig bstan nas zhal phyir gzigs pa mthong ste/ sdig mi 'dag 'dug/ snyam nas yi chad de nyal ba/ khyim thab 'tsho ba skyel bas mthong nas/ de ka snga ltas yin gyi longs la sgrubs zer ba bzhin byas pas/ nang zhig mi reng dkar po 'ga' byung nas/ sgo bshig ste/ brag phreng zhig na mar rgyab zad zad drud de shi la khad pa zhig chu 'gram zhig tu skyur nas/ khrag gis bor te brgyal ba sangs pa dang*/ nam mkhar lha lnga byon nas/ gal te mi yi sdug bsngal gyis/ /dmyal ba bral na ci ma legs/ /bde ldan zhing du myur song nas/ /ring por mi thogs mngon 'tshang rgya/ /zhes dbugs phyung*/ lung bstan pa| mi snang bar gyur pa dang*/ byin rlabs kyis chu de las dngos grub kyi shing tog gnyis byung ba gcig zos pas/ rma drag ste 'phral du lha lus su gyur/ gcig khyim thab la drin lan du bzhag go / 'tsho ba skyel du phyin pas sgo hral hrul du zhig nas/ drud pa'i khrag lam nas phyin pas/ lha zhig 'dug pa la dris pas/ de ka nga yin 'di ltar byung byas te/ shing tog gcig byin pas/ zos ma thag lha lus su gyur nas/ bde ldan du song ste/ sgrub g.yog rtogs pa myur bar gyur to/ / mthong dang ma mthong nyams par 'gyur/ /ston pa bzhugs dus su/ lung pa phu na mi dbul po zhig la nor du lug gcig yod pa gsod grabs byas pa na/ lug na re/ nga ma gsod rngan pa sbyin zer/ ci sbyin/ mdo na mi phyug po zhig la nor glang gcig yod kyis/ khyod kyi glang dang*/ nga'i lug kha su drag 'gran gyis/ nga'i glang drag zer na/ gser srang bcu'i rgyal tshugs zer ba bzhin byas pas/

lug na re/ nga la bre dang srang khol zer/ bkal nas dmangs mang pos dpang po byas te/ gang rgyal bas gser thob par byas pas/ bre srang khrog zer bas/ glang bros te rgyal thob pa/ der 'jig rten pa/ 'bas 'bu ded zer/ ston pa la rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ lug de snga ma mi phyug po zhig yin kyang*/ sbyin sogs ma byas par/ 'di phyi gnyis la mthong gi las nyams par byas/ glang des kyang*/ de la bu lon blangs pa ma bcal bas so gsung ngo*/ /bam po gnyis pa/ rgyan sogs chang yang bsten dgos so/ / bum pa'i skye rabs sogs brjod do/ / mdor na/ brgya byin/ bram ze/ nyan thos byed ma/ legs par pha rol phyin dang nya/ bya dang*/ bum pa/ phyug po'i bu/ dka' thub can dang*/ tsho dpon no/ / zhes sogs tshul khrims las brtsams pa bcu po dang*/ byang chub ngang pa byang chub che/ /spre'u ri dwags sha ram bha/ /ru ru phro rgyal bzod par smra/ / tshangs dang glang chen dge ba bcu/ /zhes pa/ bzod pa las brtsams pa bcu po dang*/ sū da pa dang lcags khyim dang*/ /ma he dang ni shing rta mo/ /brtson 'grus las brtsams pa bzhi po rnams/ 'dir yang phar phyin drug gi skabs su/ skabs dang gang 'brel rgyas bsdus ci rigs su brjod par bya'o/ /༈ khyim du gter ni byung ba ltar/ /mnyan yod na bu mo sa ga zhes pa zhig btsas ma thag/ khyim gyi gra bzhir khraun pa re rdol ba'i nang nas ci 'dod thams cad 'byung ngo*/ / de cher skyes nas khyim thab byas pas/ bu gsum skyes so/ / de nas dge bsnyen ma sa ga de/ rdzas yo byad thams cad la gnyer mel tshe mi byed 'dug pa la bu na re/ ma'i yo byad gsor mi 'gro'am zer/ mi gtor ro zer/ de ci/ ngas ni skye ba sngon ma la ma byin len spangs pas so zer/ de rtag pa'i phyir bu gsum gros byas nas/ ma'i sor gdub phra gsum yod pa/ phra gcig gis dug thub/ gcig gis rims thub/ gcig gis thog thub pa de/ chu+u bo gha ga la skyur btang ngo*/

/ der bu na re/ ma'i sor gdub gar song byas pas/ nam zhig 'ong gis zer/ de nas nya pa rnams kyis dka' dka' nas gha ga las nya gcig zin pa de/ dge bsnyen ma sa gas nyan thos zos tsam na/ de'i mgo bo'i nang nas/ sngar gyi sor gdub byung ba bu la bstan pas sdod yid ches so// ༈ 'di la thog mar bdar 'os te/ ston pa thog mar lnga sde la chos ston/ de nas 'od srung spun stong la chos ston pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ ngas sngon khas blangs pas so/ /ji ltar na/ wā ra ṇa sīr rgyal po rtsod 'byung 'khor bcas/ nags na drang srong bzod pa can 'khor lnga dang bcas pa'i phyogs su song te/ rgyal po mnal sad nas btsun mo rnams btsal bas drang srong gi mdun na 'dug pa la/ phrag dog skyes te/ tshad med sogs ci thob ma thob na dben pa skyabs med du bud med dang lhan cig ci byed/ bzod pa sgom mo/ / bzod mi bzod lta'o/ / zer te/ ral gris rkang lag bzhi rim gyis bcad kyang bzod pa ma nyams par/ 'khor rnams 'phur te sa g.yos so/ / da dung bzod par ci shes/ de la ji mi snyam pa bden na/ khrag 'o ma dang*/ rkang lag sngar bzhin gyur cig/ ces pas/ sngar bzhin gyur nas rgyal po 'gyod de/ bag med pas nongs pa bgyis pa bzod par gsol gyis/ brtse bar dgongs shig ces pa'i lan du/ khyod kyis phrag dog gis nga'i rkang lag bcad pa bzhin du/ nga sangs rgyas pa na/ shes rab kyi mtshon gyis/ khyod kyi nyon mongs kyi rkang lag bcad par bya'o/ / zhes pas/ drang srong la 'gyod tshangs byas te/ rgyun du pho brang du mchod pas/ phyogs de'i kun tu rgyu stong gi phrag dog gis rdul bshang gci gtor ba yang bzod par byas te/ nga sangs rgyas pa na/ chos kyi bdud rtsis de dag gi nyon mongs kyi dri ma bkru bar bya'o/ / zhes khas blangs pa'i drang srong yin la/ rtsod 'byung dhi n+ya'o/ / blon po bzhi ni rlangs pa sogs so/ / kun du rgyu stong ni 'od srung spun stong ngo*/

/ de dag gis bzod phyin rdzogs par byas pa'i drin lan no zhes so/ /༈ gang zhig sku stong gnang med 'jug pas/ /sngon 'dzam gling mu ges nyen pa bskyab pa'i phyir/ ded dpon zhi dge gnyis phun sum grogs por byas pa 'bral ma phod par gnyis ka rgya mtshor zhugs pas 'dod gling du phyin nas nor gyis tshim pa'i tshe/ rlung log nas rnga yab tu khyer te/ srin mos bzung nas/ ded dpon gzugs bzang bas bzhag ste/ tshong pa rnams za bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ dge ba 'jam dbyangs yin te shes rab che bas/ sngar gyi gzings gling mthar bskyal te/ tshong pa bros so zhes bsgrags pas/ gzings bor te bros sam zhes 'tshol du khrid pa'i shul du/ zhi ba spyan ras gzigs yin te snying rje che bas/

tshong pa rnams gzings nang du bcug te/ 'dod rlung dang sdongs btang bas/ tshong pa rnams na re/ ded dpon zhi ba la gor byon/ dge ba min pa ma lus pas mtshar te/ zer ba la/ grogs po dam pa bor nas bdag nyid thar pas ci zhig bya/ de bas grogs po'i mdun du shi na bla'o/ / zhes smras te/ tshong pa dag sdod bros nges po la gor byon zhes ded dpon srin mo dang bcas la smras pas/ 'dzam bu gling pa'i khye'u 'di drang po zhig go zhes yid phebs pa'i tshe/ srin mo gcig na re tshong pa gzhan la zin nas/ khyed do nub za bar bgros kyis/ rkyal pa 'di dag re re la bzhon la/ la gor bros shig zer nas bros pas/ lam ring bas rkyal pa zags te 'chir nye ba na/ dge ba shes rab che bas/ da rkyal res kyis gshegs so zhes zhi ba skyon te ring zhig nas/ zhi bas yang brjes te/ 'ongs pas/ zhi ba'ang ched de bsam pa/ lam ring bas 'tsho ba'ang med par gnyis ka chad 'chi bas/ bdag gis sems bskyed pa'i rang srog bcad de mnar med du skyes kyang bla'o/ / chos kyi yang po 'di thon na sems can gyi mgon du 'gyur bas/ rgya mtsho ni ro dang zhag du mi 'grogs snyam nas spu ྄gris rtsa bo che bcad pas myur du thar thon nas/ da bzhengs byas pas ldang rgyu ma byung bar grongs par shes te smre sngags bton pa klus thos te 'chi sos kyi sman bskus pas bzhengs nas/ rgya mtsho'i sbu ba byugs pas dkar po rgyan med du'o// klus sems can bskyab pa dang*/ khyad par du klu'i nad zhi bar gsol zhus pas/ nga'i ming thos pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ khyad par du klu'i nad zhi bar gsol zhus pas/ nga'i ming thos pas sems can gyi sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ khyad par du klu'i nad zhi nas/ klu'ang sems can su la'ang 'tshe bar ma gyur cig/ ces mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas seng ge sgra'o/ / gang phyir rang gi sku la'ang mi gzigs par/

/ston pa 'di sngon/ lho phyogs pho brang 'tsho ba bzang po zhes pa na/ 'dzam gling la dbang pa'i rgyal po zla 'od ces pa/ rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong*/ grong khyer 'bum phrag bco brgyad/ btsun mo nyi khri lnga brgya sogs yod par sku 'khrungs pa na/ da lta'i 'byor pa'ang sngon gyi dge 'bras yin pas/ phyi ma'i rgyur da lta bsod nams bsag par bya'o/ / snyam nas gser rnga rdung ste/ 'gro ba kun la ci 'dod sbyin no/ / zhes bsgrags te/ thams cad la tshim par byin pa/ de'i snyan pas sa steng khyab pa/ mtha'i rgyal phran bhi ma se nas ma bzod par/ dge sbyong dang bram ze kun la bsnyen bkur te/ nga'i mya ngan sol cig ces so/ / mya ngan ci zla 'od kyi snyan pas nga'i ming tsam yang med par byas pas/ de srog dang 'bral ba'i thabs la 'bod cig / ces pas thams cad sngangs te/ de 'dra ni thos su'ang mi rung ngo zhes thams cad kyis so/ / der kho 'khrugs te/ zla 'od kyi mgo bo longs na rgyal srid phyed dang bu mo ster zer ro/ / der bram ze lo'u du chas khas blangs te/ sgo drung du phyin pas/ sgo srung kyi lhas nang du ma btang ba la/ gtsang ma'i lha rdzas sbyin phyin rdzogs par shes nas/ rmi lam du khyed kyi sbyin gnas dam pa ni sgo drung na sdod do/ / zhes bstan pa sad nas blon po zla chen la khyod song la nang du 'ong ba su'ang ma bkag/ ces bzlas pas/ lhas lung bstan nas/ 'di phrag dog gis/ rgyal po'i dbu slong bas btang du mi rung ngo zer kyang*/ de ltar na'ang rgyal po'i bka' bcag tu mi rung ngo*/ / zhes btang bas/ rgyal pos bsu ste/ gser dngul sogs ci 'dod dris pas/ phyi yo byad kyis sbyin phyin mi rdzogs kyis/ / nang sku lus btang ba sbyin pa'i mchog lags pas/ dbu stsal du gsol zhes pas dgyes te/ da ste zhag bdun na sbyin no/ / zhes pas/ zla chen sngangs te gser gyi mgo bo lnga brgya byin nas brid kyang ma nyan/

rgyal phran btsun mo sras bcas kun gyis nor gzhan sna tshogs kyis blus kyang ma nyan te/ thams cad drung du lhags mchi ma 'brubs te smras pa/ bram ze zhig gi phyir bdag cag mgon dang bral bar mi mdzad par zhus pas/ ngas lus 'di sngar don med du ji snyed cig chud gzan gyis/ da res myur du 'jig pa'i lus 'di bram ze la byin nas sangs rgyas su bsngos pas sangs rgyas thob pa na khyed rnams kyi mgon bya'o/ / zhes tshig 'jam por smras te/ bram ze la da ni mgo bo blang ba'i dus la bab bo/ / zhes pas/ blon po zla chen thabs gang gis kyang mi bzlogs par shes nas snying gas te shi'o/ / bram ze na re 'khor 'di tsam gyi dbus su bdag gis dbu gcod par ga la nus/ zhe nas gnang na rgyab kyi skyed mos tshal du gshegs 'tshal zer te/ phyin pa dang*/ kho na re/ rgyal po ni sku gzhon la stobs rtsal che ba gyad dang mnyam pas/ sku zug ma bzod do/ / de 'gyod srid kyis/ dbu shing la btags te dgum mo zer te/ shing brtan po zhig la dam du btags nas/ bram ze la pus btsugs te khyod kyis chod la nga'i lag tu zhog cig/ sbyin pa lag gis btang ngo gsung*/ bram zes ral gri gzas pa dang*/ shing gi lha mos thal lcags bsnun nas 'gyel ba dang/ shing gi lha la bka' bstsal pa/ ngas sngar mgo bo dgu brgya go dgu byin nas 'dis stong du tshang ste sbyin phyin rdzogs nas sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i bar chad ma byed ces pas/ shing gi lha yang mchi ma 'brub bzhin du bram ze'i stobs skyed de/ langs nas dbu bcad de phyag tu btang ba dang*/ sbyin pa chen por gyur pa 'di yis ni/ / 'gro ba'i nang nas rang byung sangs rgyas te/ / sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ / skye bo'i tshogs rnams bdag gis sgrol bar shog/ces gsungs nas bram ze'i lag tu btad pas/ sa g.yos/ me tog gi char babs/ nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od du gyur pas/

se na 'gyod de snying gas nas shi ba thos te/ bram ze re ba ma grub par snying gas te shi nas/ gnyis ka'ang bar do med par mda' bzhin dmyal bar song ngo*/ / rgyal po'i 'khor mya ngan gyis shi ba rnams lhar skyes so/ / dper na rgyal po'i mi 'ga' zhig/ ka na dha zhes pa'i rgyal po shin tu stobs che ba zhig yod pa'i 'khor bram ze zhig/ rgyal phran cig gi yul du phyin nas/ bram zes nya zhig nyos thos te khyim du song ba'i bar du nya de bya glag gis khyer ro/ / der bram ze rang gi rgyal po snyems pas/ rgyal phran blon po dang bcas pa'i gseb tu phyin nas/ ngas nya nyos pa khyed kyi yul gyi bya glag gis khyer bas/ da nga la bya glag zung la byin cig zer/ der rgyal blon rnams na re/ bya glag nged kyis mi rnyed pas/ nya rin sbyin byas pas/ bram ze na re/ ci nas kyang bya glag 'dod zer te ma nyan pa la| rgyal po ka na dha bskyod pa'i dgos pa'i mig rgyang ring po bram ze de gcig pu thub kyang brnyas pa ma byas par/ rgyal blon de rnams kyis/ bram ze de la nya'i rin mang du byin no/ /༈ de ltar dmangs kyis rgyal gtum bzhin/ /sngon rgyal po chen po zhig la btsun mo du ma yod pa'i/ chen mas sdig pa zhig brten pa la bu gcig btsas pa|cher skyes shing sdig la dga' zhing gnyid mi 'ongs par mi za'o/ / des rgyal srid kyang bzung ste/ ming yang rgyal po gtum po rab snang zhes bya'o/ / de gnyid mi 'ongs pas gtam zla re/ 'bangs rnams kyis re mos su bkral 'jog pa gsod do/ / nam zhig na/ sa 'dzin pa zhes pa'i mi zhig la re mos bab ste phyin pa na de'ang gnyid du song ngo*/ / rgyal pos khyod su yin 'dri ba na ma thos la/ skad cher dris pas gnyid sad de bdag lags so zhes lan byas pas/ khyod da ji skad mi 'byin pas bsad do/ / zer ba la/ bdag 'jig rten sems dpa' la zhugs pas lan no/ / de ci dris pas/

'jig rten srang bcu gzhal te/ srang gcig 'phri nas bcal yang*/ da dung srang bcu mchis pas so/ / de gang yin dris pas/ mngon du 'gyur lags kyis/ bya zhig la srang bcu byung ba/ sgro spu srang gcig 'phri nas bcal yang srang bcu 'byung bas/ 'di la rgyu mtshan ci yod zer/ sgros btegs pa'i slad du'o/ / zhes pas/ rgyal po dga' ste/ de ma bsad par/ nub phyi ma rnams kyang nyal bas/ sngar gyi de bzhin la/ lan tsha chu/ byed ma chu/ mar zho rnams bre re re/ sres kyang bre re re shong ba sogs bstan pas/ sa 'dzin pa/ khyod ni mkhas pa'o/ /gsung*/ lha'i bka' drin lags mod zer/ nga la gnyid mi yong ba la rgyu mtshan ci yod gsung*/ lha mi 'jigs pa rtsol zhig/ sbyin no/ khyod ni sdig pa'i bu lags pa'i slad du'o/ / yum la nga su'i bu yin drang por smros shig byas pas/ mi 'jigs pa rtsol zhig/ sbyin no/ /yab dang phrad dka' nas/ kho mo zla mtshan dang ldan pa na sdig pa gcig dang phrad de/ 'di skyes pa yin nas/ bdag la 'dod pa brten nus na ci ma rung snyam nas mtshan mar bcug pas so/ / zhig zhus pa na ngo tsha zhing*/ sa 'dzin pa de la ni dngos po chog thang gcig byin nas/ yul gzhan du thabs kyis bskrad do/ / 'tsho byed kyis yul dbus kyi chang mar dang sbyar te/ byin pas gnyid du song shul du bros pa la/ gnyid sad de mar gyi sgregs pa byung bas/ nga la mar byin 'dug pas 'tsho byed ded la sod zer/ 'khor rnams na re/ lha la mnal 'ong ba'i thabs bgyis pa bzhin byung ba drin tshor lags na/ de gsad par ga la 'os zhes sogs kyi thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas mgu bar byed do/ / le'u drug pa'o/ / // ka7 le'u bdun pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ bu mo phyug mo khra dang ni/ / yi dwags srin bu blo brtan dang*/ / yungs mar bkang ba'i snod dang bdun/ / de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa/ /rgyal po kri kri la bu mo shin tu mdzes pa bdun yod pa de rnams shin tu bstan pa la dad de/

rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa thob pa/ yab kyis/ ston pa la 'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ sngon phyi'i rgya mtsho'i nang na mchod rten bzhi yod pa la/ shing lo la gnas pa'i srin bu bdun rlung gis ded pa'i shugs ky-is skor ba gcig byung bas/ rigs ngan gyi bu mo bdun du skyes/ de rnams rang gi rigs dang longs spyod la skyo nas shing btsongs te/ sbyin sogs byas pas/ rgyal po'i sras mor gyur te chos la dad par gyur to/ /sogs gsungs so/ /cho ga shin tu 'jam po yis/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag phyug po ser sna can rdul tsam mi sbyin pa zhig yod pa la/ 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bus 'dul du byon nas/ nyi ma bdun du sbyin pa'i gtam 'ba' zhig byas te/ bsod snyoms blangs pas kho khros te bsod snyoms mi ster bar/ khyod la lab rgyu gcig pu de ka min pa med dam zer/ bcom ldan 'das la rgyu mtshan gsol pas/ nga kho na'i gdul bya yin gsungs nas byon pas/ khyim bdag sog ma'i bya ba byed pa la ba blangs pas sog ma zhig byin pa la dga' ba'i tshul gyis sbyin lan sogs byas pas/ phyis ldum rwar lo ma byin pa la sngar bzhin yon gyi khyad par bshad pas/ de 'dra zhig la de lta na/ sang 'khor bcas chos ston la spyan drangs/ de nas rim bzhin/ rdzas thams cad zad par ston pa 'khor bcas la mchod do/ / mthar lus la'ang zhen pa med de/ ras snum can gyis lus dkris te mar mer phul te rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob po/ /༈ rim gyis rang gi sha yang gtong*/ /sngon bskal ba grangs med pa'i sngon rol na/ 'dzam gling 'dir yul de ba dha na zhes par/ rgyal po shing byi zhes pa/ 'byor pa dang*/ byams snying rje tshad med pa zhig byung ngo*/ / de'i tshe brgya byin la 'chi ltas byung ba/ rgyal po des skyabs nus zhes bi shwa kar mas smras nas/ rgyal po de nyams sad pa'i phyir/ bi shwa kar mas phug ron dang*/

brgya byin gyis khrar sprul nas ded pas/ phug ron bzung la ma reg pa de rgyal po'i nang du zhugs pa dang*/ khras kyang rgyal po'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ phug ron 'di ni bdag gi zas lags kyis/ tshur myur du byin cig byas pas/ 'di ni nga la skyabs pas/ khyod la sbyin pa'i thabs med do/ / 'o na kho'i skyabs byas nas/ bdag gi skyabs mi mdzad dam bdag ni ltogs te shi la khad do zer/ khyod sha gzhan zhig gis blus na 'dod dam byas pas/ 'phral du bsad pa'i sha khrag dron mo byung na 'dod do zer/ rang gi brla nas phug ron tsam zhig bcad de byin pas/ khra na re srang la bsgrin 'tshal lo/ / zer te bcad pas brla gnyis ka dang gnag pa thams cad kyis kyang ma khyer nas brgyal ba'i tshe gnam sa yang drug tu g.yos so/ / brgya byin rang gzugs bstan nas/ rgyal po 'di lta bu'i dka' spyad kyis 'bras bu ci bzhed 'jig rten gyi bde 'bras gang yang mi 'dod kyis/ sems can thams cad skyob byed sangs rgyas 'dod zer ro/ / 'o na sku lus la zug zer 'di lta bu skyed pa la 'gyod pa med dam zer/ med do zer/ de la dpang po su yod ces pas/ ngas dang po phug ron blu bar khas blangs pa nas/ da lta'i bar du 'gyod pa rdul tsam med na bdag lus sngon bzhin gyur cig ces pas sngar bzhin gyur to/ / ༈ phongs pa 'di 'dra byung gyur na/ /tshe dang ldan pa mo'u 'gal/ yi dwags kyi gnas su song ba na/ yi dwags kha khab mig tsam pa rang gi skras g.yogs pa/ lto ba ri tsam lus la me 'bar bas nyams thag nas skad 'byin pa/ bshang gci za yang de yang bde blag tu mi rnyed pa zhig mthong nas/ las cis khyod 'dir skyes dris pas/ nyi ma shar ba'i tshe sgron me mi dgos kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la don 'di zhus shig/ bdag gi las kyi rnam par smin pa ston par 'gyur ro/ / zhes zer ba bzhin zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon rang rgyal zhig gis bu ram shing gi khu blangs pas/

khyim bdag des 'phags pa la phul cig ces g.yog la bsgos pas/ g.yog des lhung bzed thong zhig zer nas/ bshang gcis phag tu bkang ste/ steng du bu ram gyi khu ba'i lbu ba blugs nas byin pas/ las des 'di lta bu'o/ /zhes gang po'i rtogs brjod las so/ /༈ sdug bsngal mtshon gyis rnam par 'joms/ /bcom ldan 'das bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa na/ grong khyer gyi mi gtsang ba'i lteng ka zhig gi nang na/ srin bu sbrul 'dra ba la/ rkang pa ni bzhi yod pa bar 'ga' ni phyir 'byung*/ bar 'ga' ni chu'i steng du 'byung mod/ der lo mang por/ sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong ba der/ 'khor bcas byon nas/ bka' bstsal pa/ khyed cag legs par nyon la yid la zung zhig/ 'di'i sngon gyi rgyu bshad par bya'o/ / sngon sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs kyi bstan pa la/ dge slong stong phrag bcu bzhi dgon pa zhig na gnas pa la/

tshong pa lnga brgyas rin po che'i dam pa zhig bsod snyoms kyi zong du phul ba bzhes nas zhal ta byed pa'i dge slong zhig la gtad do/ / phyis bsod snyoms kyis brel nas/ zhal ta ba la tshong pas phul ba'i rin chen 'on cig/ bsod snyoms su btsong ngo zhes pas/ zhal ta ba khros te/ khyod skyugs pa za sam/ rin chen btsongs pas kho bo gcig pu la byin du zad kyis/ khyed kun la ma byin no/ / zer bas/ dge 'dun kyang so sor gyes so/ / de'i rgyus lus zhig ste tshe 'phos nas mtshams med pa'i dmyal ba chen por lhung ste/ ngan skyugs kyi nang du bskal ba dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du 'gre 'gre ba'o/ / de las thar nas/ da lta 'dir na ngan skyugs kyi khung bur skyes nas lo mang po lon yang da dung ma thar te/ 'di lta ste/ sngon 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyis kyang*/ dge 'dun 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs nas/ nye gnas rnams la 'di'i las bstan te/ de nas sangs rgyas thams cad skyob kyis kyang de bzhin du bstan to/ / de nas tshe 'phos nas phyis yang dmyal bar skyes te/ lo khrag khrig grangs med pa zhig lon nas/ phyir yang khung bu 'dir skye'o/ / de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gis kyang de bzhin du bstan to/ / gser thub dang*/ 'od srung gis kyang de bzhin du bstan to/ / de bzhin du sangs rgyas stong po kun nye gnas dang bcas te/ 'dir gshegs nas/ srin bu 'di sngon las cir gyur pa'i rgyu ston par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dge slong rnams spu langs te/ lus ngag yid gsum shin tu srung ba la/ btson par gyur to/ /zhes mdzangs blun las so/ / ༈ ngan 'gror nga rgyal gyis khrid cing*/ /slob dpon dbyig gnyen la rang dang mnyam pa'i slob ma bzhi yod pa'i/ dang po blo gros brtan pa ni/ nub phyogs bram ze rab bstan gyi grong na/ slob dpon 'bru mar gyi bcing ba byas te/

gzhung 'bum sde gya bzhi'i nang re la 'bum phrag bcu gnyis zhal thon mdzad de/ zhag bdun na tshar ba/ bram ze'i bus rdzogs par thos te/ dad bzhin du tshe'i dus byas nas/ yang de'i bur skyes te/ na len+d+rar rab tu byung nas/ blo gros brtan par grags so/ / sngar slob dpon la gsan pa'i bag chags sad de mkhas par gyur pa'i tshe/ nyi ma'i dngos grub kyis bsregs pa'i mdo mang po zhig 'dus kyang*/ zab rgyas mngon pa dang*/ dkon brtsegs sogs ma rnyed par/ tshangs byin gyis bsnyen bkur byas te/ 'di dag thugs la sdud nus pa byung nas/ paṇa chen kun gyi'ang gtsug gi nor bur khur ro/ / zhes pas/ thams cad slob dpon la lta ba'i tshe/ bzhengs nas/ bdag blo phyogs gcig bzhag pa dang*/ / 'gro blo phyogs gcig bzhag pa gnyis/ / gal te de la ljid rung na/ / srang la bcal na bdag blo lci/ / zhes so/ / 'o na dbyig gnyen zhes pa'i lan du/ dbyig gnyen gzhung lugs rgya mtsho yi/ / pha rol son yang tshul ma shes/ / chang bum gang gi mya ngan gyis/ / sangs rgyas bstan la dal por mnal/ /gsung nas bstud pas/ so dgu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon la smad pas/ sku tshe'i bar chad du gyur te/ nga rgyal gyis dmyal bar khrid nas btsos te/ dbyug pas bsngogs pa na zug gzer ma bzod par dbyug tho la 'jus pas/ phyag tshig ste/ tshig bar mnyam pa la dbyug pa mi tsha ba/ nga'i bdag 'dzin gyis lan snyam nas/ gnas lugs la spyad pas/ chos thams cad bdag med du rtogs te/ 'dzam bu gling du thon nas/ yang smras pa/ nga yi nga rgyal lcags dang 'dra/ / nga yi shes rab gru dang 'dra/ / lcags kyis rgya mtshor bying ba yang*/ / gru yis steng du thon la ltos/ /zhes so/ /yang*/ phag sogs dman pa'i gnas bdun brgyud pa'i tshe/ paṇ+ḍi tas mdun gyi phag mo'i lto ba nas/ / nga ni sngon gyi ma ti s+thi ra ste/ / nga rgyal dbang gis phag mo'i mngal du skyes/ / 'di ru ma bzhag rgyal po'i khab tu khyer/

/ shi nas dga' ldan lha gnas skye 'gyur gyis/ / gsungs pa lta bu ste/ mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis ngan 'gror gshegs kyang myur du grol rkyen byed de/ 'o skol rmongs pa'i nga rgyal gyis gtan 'khyams byed pas/ gnyen po sgom pa gces so/ / yungs mar bkang pa'i snod bskur la/ / ༈ gtum po rab snang gis lho phyogs su g.yul las rgyal ba'i sdig sbyong la/ ka t+ya na spyan drangs/ rtsed 'jo ba du mas bsu ste/ de dag gang mkhas par gda' zhus pas/ lta long med pas ma mthong gsungs pas/ yid ma ches pa la/ khyod kyi chab 'og na chad pa phog pa yod zer ba/ lam stegs 'dred pa'i steng nas 'bru mar gyis bkang ba'i snod bskur te/ ral gri thogs pas drung du bsdad nas/ thigs gcig bo na gsod do/ /ma bo na chad pa las thar par bya'o/ / zhes rtsed 'jo ba mang pos skor te/ de dag gang mkhas par 'dug dris pas/ ltas te bo na srog dang bral dwogs kyis 'jigs nas/ lta skabs ma mchis lags zer ba la/ de ni tshe 'di'i srog dang bral dgos tsam yin gyi/ 'dir bag med kyi nyes pas reg na/ gtan gyi phan bde'i srog dang 'bral bas/ brtul zhugs can gyis lhag par yang sgrim 'tshal lo gsungs pas/ rgyal po lhag par dad do/ / le'u bdun pa'o/ / // ka8 le'u brgyad pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ ༈ gtsang 'byor chu smad nya ba dang*/ / legs dkar shan pa lcags khyim dang*/ / byi po rta dbyangs dge tshul dang*/ / zla mdzes seng ge lha chen dang*/ / rgyal 'byung dgra rgyal spyi bo skyes/ / des pa paṇa chung sgom dad dang*/ / sems skyed klu sgrub nyi shu'o/ ༈ shi ba'i 'og tu 'jigs pa skye/ ston pa kun dga' bo dang bcas pa/ rgyal khab tu bsod snyoms la byon pa'i tshe/ skye bo thams cad kyi bshang gci 'dor sa'i grogs po gting rings kyi chab btsog de'i nang na/ srin bu mi'i gzugs 'dra ba la rkang lag mang ba zhig/ ston pa la ltas nas mchi ma 'dzag go

/ 'khor gyis gsol ba/ 'di'i las ci/ der skyes nas ji srid cig lon lags zhugs pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na/ khyim bdag cig gis dge 'dun la mar dang*/ 'bru mar dag phul te/ dge slong mgron po zhig kyang 'ongs pa la/ gtsang sbyor bas mkhyen nas/ khyod ni mgron po/ nged ni bza' tshang yin no zhes/ de la skal ba ma byin no/ / mgron pos/ yon bdag gis dge 'dun la phul gyis/ kho bo dge 'dun yin pas byin cig zer ba la/ zhal ta ba khros te/ khyod bshang gci mi za bar nga la 'bru mar dag 'dod dam zhes tshig ngan smras pas/ las des bskal ba bye ba dgu bcu'i/ bar du rgyun du chab btsog pa 'di'i nang du skyes so/ / de'i phyir khyed rnams kyang ngag gi las bsrung zhing sdoms shig ces drin bsab las gsungs so/ /༈ de dang de sdongs stong gyur du/ /tshong dpon 'byor ldan bza' mi gnyis la|rgyu skar chu smad la bu gcig btsas pa/ nye dus chu smad ces ming du btags so/ / de cher skyes te pha shi nas khyim gyi bdag por gyur to/ / ma la rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas/ nga shi ba'i 'og tu rab tu byung zhig ces so/ / bus ji snyed pa thams cad ma la phul te/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dang bkren pa rnams la byin cig/ zhes bsgo'o/ / ma ni shin tu 'jungs pas/ bus byin pa thams cad sbas te/ kho mos byin no/ / zhes bu rdzun gyis bslu bar yang byed la/ dge sbyong slong pa mthong na ni khyed ni yi dwags su skyes pa bzhin khyim thams cad yang yang ci'i phyir nyul zer ro/ / de shi nas yi dwags su skyes te/ bus sbyin pa dag byin nas sdod rab tu byung ste/ dgra bcom pa thob nas/ gaṅgā'i 'gram na 'dug pa'i drung du/ ma yi dwags mo 'jigs su rung ba de lhags te/ bu bdag gis ni lo nyer lnga'i bar du chu'i bag kyang ma mthong na kha zas lta ci smos/ kho mo la chu stsol cig zer ro/ / chu smad kyis smras pa/

yum khyod mir gyur pa na ngas sbyin pa dag byed du ma bcug gam/ bu bdag ser snas non nas/ rdzas thams cad sbas te sbyin pa cung zad kyang ma byas kyi/ da bdag gi don du/ sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun la bshos gsol nas bdag gi ming gis yon bsngos shig/ 'on kyang bdag yi dwags kyi skye gnas 'di nas thar srid do zer/ chu smad kyis smras pa| de ltar bgyid pas/ khyod rang yang gral dpon gyi mdun du 'dug cig/ bu bdag ni gcer bur 'dug pa 'di ngo tsha'o/ / yum khyod gang gi tshe sdig pa byed pa de'i tshe ngo mi tsha na/ da lta ci'i phyir ngo tsha 'dod na de bzhin bya'o zer/ chu smad kyis/ nye du rnams kyi khyim khyim du dad pa dris nas/ phyi nyin gdugs tshod drangs pa'i/ gral dpon gyi drung du yi dwags mo'ang 'dug pa srog chags 'bum phrag du mas mthong nas/ skyo ba skyes pa de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan pas thams cad bden pa mthong bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sbyin pa 'di'i bsod nams gang*/ / de ni yi dwags phyi bzhin song*/ / yi dwags 'jig rten rab 'jigs las/ / de ni myur du thar gyur cig/ ces pas/ yi dwags mo de yang shi 'phos nas/ yi dwags rdzu 'phrul chen mor skyes so/ / chu smad kyis/ yum da ni mthu yod kyis sbyin pa thong zhig/ bu mi nus so/ /lan mang du bcos pas/ ras zung gcig sbyin pa/ chu smad kyis dge 'dun la phul ba/ dge slong zhig gis nyan thos te/ gdang bu la bkal ba/ yi dwags mos/ mtshan mo 'ongs te brkus so/ / yang chu smad kyis bkug pa/ lan gsum du brkus so/ / der dge slong des kyang ras de gshags nas phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi stan la blan pas/ de nas rku ma nus so/ / zhes snying rje pad dkar las so/ / ༈ sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /gzugs can snying pos/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje thabs su ldan pa yin lags na/ mu stegs kyi ston pa drug po 'di lam rnal ma la ci'i phyir mi sbyor zhus pas/

bka' bstsal pa/ rgyal po khyod kyis 'bangs thams cad thul lam gsung*/ thul lo zhus pas/ 'o na rigs ngan nya ba de thul cig gsung*/ der rgyal pos nya ba bos nas khyod la longs spyod mang po sbyin no/ / nya shor ba spaungs shig byas pas ma nyan no/ / der rgyal pos/ 'khor rnams la 'di ma bsad par nya ba mi yong na gsod ces sdigs shig gsungs pas/ nya ba na re/ nga'i bu smad sbron cig tshig gsum smra'o zer/ skyed 'ong snyam nas bu smad sbran pas/ 'u cag nya shor ba'i rigs su nges shing dpral ba na mtshan ma'ang yod pas/ lus dang srog gi phyir yang nya ba las ma log cig zer ro/ / der nya pa'ang ma bsad de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can mos pa sna tshogs pas de nyid ngas kyang thul bar dka'o gsungs pas/ rgyal po gdod yid ches so/ /༈ gang phyir byis pa rang don ni/ / legs dkar ston pa'i gzim g.yog byed pa na/ ma gzims par nye gnas nyal du med pas/ kho/ gcer bu can 'gro ring ste/ go tam/ myur du nyol/ ba gu la 'ong ngo zer/ bka' bstsal pa/ klu skyong khyod snying las chung ngur gyis shig dang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ de pa la/ rdzi bar nus pa su yang med de/ 'on kyang khyed kyi ston pa gcer bu pa sdug bsngal 'gyur ni/ zhag bdun na ma zhu ba'i nad kyis dus byas te/ mi gtsang ba'i srin bu dang*/ dmyal sogs su skye bar 'dug go gsungs pas/ kho ma bzod par rings par song ste/ go tam gyi mngon shes rdugs su gzhug gi / zhag bdun zas chod cig zer/ bdun nas zos pas dus byas te/ srin bur skyes nas/ smre sngags dang bcas ste/ go tam thams cad mkhyen par 'dug go / 'u rang zhag drug la bdun du 'khrul te/ 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong nas dmyal ba mtha' med du 'khyams par 'dug go / log lam dang sdig grogs spongs/ go tam la bzod par gsol la/ skyabs su song zhig byas pas/ ston pa 'di la rtag med pa/

de la bzod par gsol na re ba skye mod/ nga las ji la thug kyang go tam la 'dud dus mi yong*/ mi che chung la 'chi ba yin gyis/ smre sngags ma byed par sdug sems skyed cig zer te/ drung du song nas/ khyod kyi mngon shes rdugs so zer/ 'o na dmyal sogs su brgyud de lhung zer ba gsungs pas/ kho skyengs te 'khrugs nas/ nga'i ston pa la skyon sna tshogs brjod pa khyod kyi g.yog mi byed zer te song nas/ kun tu rgyu ston pa'i skyon brjod byed pa'i nang du song ste/ khyod la rgyus med pa yin kho la 'di 'dra 'di 'dra'i skyon mang po yod zer ba la/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus phyin nas/ ston pa nyes skyon thams cad dang bral ba la sgro skur byas na ngan 'gror sdug bsngal myong gi / de lta bu ma zer byas pas/ khyod kyi thos pa'i grangs pas/ ngas mthong ba'i grangs mang*/ 'jim pa rlon pa chu phyogs mi dgos g.yo sgyu'i rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyis sbyin bdag gi mgo bo bskor nas dad rdzas sna tshogs zos pas ngan 'gror 'gro na khyed rang dpon slob 'gro mod/ nga ston pa gcer bu ba lta bus rjes su bzung ba la/ ngan 'gror 'gro don med do zer te/ phyir la tsog tu song te/ 'brum bu me dbal nag pos lus dum bu chad de/ smre sngags dang bcas nas mnar med du song ngo*/ / des nas sdig grogs spangs te dam pa la brten par bya'o/ /༈ sdug bsngal bskal gzhan mi len na/ / shan pa zhig la bu mdzes pa zhig skyes pa lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe/ gnyen 'dun rnams na re/ khyod shan pa'i rigs yin pas srog bcad la nged rnams gso dgos byas pas/ bus/ rigs de ltar yin yang*/ nga ni sdig la mi 'jug ste/ ngan song gis 'jigs pas so zer/ gnyen rnams na re/ khyod kyis shan pa byos shig dang*/ sdig pa ni yu bu spyi yis bgor ro/ / zhes pa la/ bus kyang cung zad cig bsams nas/ mdun na rang gi grogs po zhig 'dug pa la/

nga la nad cig yod pas rgyab tu khu tshur zhig rgyob byas pa bzhin brgyab pas/ bu na re/ nga na bas/ khyed rnams na'am zer/ khyod la brgyab pas nged ci la na zer/ de bzhin du ngas shan pa byas pa'i rnam smin nga rang gis myong dgos kyis/ khyed la bgor gar btub zer te/ spang zhing chos bsgrubs pas 'bras bu thob bo/ / ༈ de srid du ni nags su song*/ / ston pa 'di sngon rgyal po zhig gi sras su gyur pa na/ sras snga ma mang du shi bas gdon gyis nyen par bzung nas/ lcags kyi khang pa rin chen gyis spras par bcug ste/ gdon gyis mi tshugs pa'i bsrung ba du ma byas te cher skyes nas/ rig pa'i gnas mang du lobs te/ re zhig rang gi yul der ku mu da'i dga' ston byung ba la/ lta ba'i phyir shing rta'i mchog la bzhon nas zhabs 'bring ba du mas bskor te phyin pa na/

glu dang bzhad gad dang*/ rol mo mkhan sogs skye bo 'bum phrag du ma dga' dga' ltar 'dug pa gzigs kyang*/ mi rtag pa'i 'du shes la goms pas skyo bar gyur te/ ku mu da yi dpal 'di yang*/ / dran par bya ba nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes/ pha la rab tu 'byung bar zhus pas/ pha glang po che dug mda' phog pa bzhin du sdug bsngal bar gyur te/ ngas nyes pa'am/ 'bangs kyis nyes pa ma byas par glo bur du cis te nags su 'gro/ bu na re/ bdag la gnod pa byed pa su zhig mchis/ / bdag ni rtag par 'chi bas 'jigs pa'i phyir/ / rab tu 'byung ngo*/ / zhes pa dpe du ma'i sgo nas zhus pas/ pha na re/ 'chi bdag gi dgra'o/ / de bcos su mi rung na/ nags su phyin kyang cis phan zer bas/ 'chi bar nges kyang chos pa dga' zhing 'chi/ khyim gyi nang na 'gyod bzhin 'chi ba'i phyir/ / rab tu byung nas nags su bsgoms pas bsam gtan gyi sems thob ste/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes so/ / mos pa bzhin du 'gal ba'i kyang*/ / spyan ras gzigs so skye'i dus na/ chung ma byi kho na byas mi thub pa/ grogs po 'jam dpal can phyin nas bzlas pas/ 'jam dpal ni de tsam na shes rab che bas/ khyod nyal khar/ chung ma sgren mor phyung ste skra shig la/ lag tu gri kyog po ring ba zhig bskur la/ ha ha zhes rtag tu zer du chug cig zer ba bzhin nub re bzhin de ltar byed du bcug pas/ chung ma goms so/ / der spyan ras gzigs kyi tshong la phyin pa'i shul du/ chung mas grogs po bkug nas nyal khar mos sgren mor sngar bzhin byas pas/ byi po bred de bros so/ / de nas tshong log pa'i lam du/ byi po dang phrad de/ gcig gis gcig ngo ma shes yul 'di na mi snyan pa med dam dris pas/ byi po na re/ yul 'di na bud med 'di 'dra ba zhig nub mo nyal khar spyod pa 'di 'dra byed pa zhig kho bos mthong ngo zer/ sdod byi po yin par shes te/ khy-im du phyin nas chung ma dang mgo 'jug rnol nas nyal lo/

/ sang khyod kyi yongs nas 'di 'dra ba'i gtam byung ngo*/ / zhes chung ma'i mtshang bzlas pas/ ngas khyod la nges par mngon shes yod snyam nas/ phyis byi mi shor ro/ / ༈ sprin bral nyi zer gyis phye ba'i/ / mnyan yod na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas chos gsungs pa na/ bya rog cig gis phrag pa g.yas su bya thal g.yogs te song ngo*/ / 'khor rnams kyis 'di ci'i ltas zhes zhus pas/ nga mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu/ bram ze rta dbyangs zhes pas nga'i bstan pa rgud par byed pa'i ltas so/ / de cis 'dul zhus pas/ de la dbang phyug gis mngal skyes thams cad kyis mi thub pa'i dngos grub byin nas 'ong bas/ rdzus skyes shig yod na des 'dul gsung*/ der 'khor de'i nang nas zhig langs te/ de'i tshe bdag brdzus skyes su 'gyur la/ de'i gnyen por gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ / der dus phyis bya rog de rta dbyangs su skyes pa dang*/ mnyam du sing ga la'i gling du me tog pad ma zhig 'khrungs so sprin dang bral ba'i nyi mas kha phye ba'i nang nas mi zhig skyes pa ming yang ar+ya de bar btags so/ / de shin tu mdzes mod khyad par du'ang spyan legs pa des rab tu byung nas skyes thob kyi shes rab dang ldan te/ slob dpon klu sgrub la chos nyan cing dpal gyi ri la bzhugs so/ / de tsa na bi ta ra'i gtsug lag ni mu stegs pas dbang byed do/ / dge 'dun rnams ma dga' nas/ rdo sku'i mgon po la gsol ba btab pas/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas bya rog cig byung ba'i ske ru/ na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag ni mu stegs pas dbang byed do/ / zhes pa'i yi ge btags btang bas/ bya rog gis 'phags pa yab sras kyi drung du babs te/ yi ge gzigs nas/ yab sras gnyis gcig gis rta dbyangs kyi gzhung bzung nas rtsod pas/ ar+ya de ba ma thub nas/ der ar+yas/ shing khur gyi nang du chos gos rnams sbas te/ na len+d+rar byon nas/ nga ni 'phags pa lha'o/

/ zhes pas dge 'dun dga'o/ / der tsha ba gsol zhing bzhugs pa'i dus la rta dbyangs 'ongs nas/ dkar tshod 'thung ngam nag tshod 'thung zer bas/ 'phags pas dkar po gsol byas pas kho dpyad pa skyes te/ sngar med pa'i mgo ni gang nas 'ongs zer/ ske las so zer/ mig te lam las so zer/ 'o na lam rang la dris zhes sogs byung kyang*/ sang rtsod pa'i dus btab bo/ / mu stegs la/ sring mo/ ne tso/ rdo rgyus/ kho rang dang bzhi yod/ 'phags pas/ de'i nub byi la la ne tso'i gzugs bsnyad do/ / sang rtsod pa'i sa gzhi mar nag gis byugs dge bsnyen zhig gcer bur phyung nas 'phongs dang dbang po la me tog gis brgyan/ mu stegs kyi bla re la bre la cam lham chur bcug pa gcig btags so/ / sang gnyis ka seng khri la 'dug ste rtsod pa na/ mu stegs na re/ nga mi dgos rdo rgyus 'dis lan thob zer/ sngon du btang bas/ mar nag gi gzhi la brir ma btub bo/ / der ne tso btang nas mdun du sgra sbyor ba na/ 'phags pas byi la btang ste 'phur te song ngo*/ / sring mo btang bas/ 'phags pas dge bsnyen gcer bu btang bas ngo tsha nas bros so/ / der mu stegs kho rang na re/ khyed sangs rgyas pa ne tso la byi la gtong ba snying rje med do zer/ nga'i mas/ sdig bshags byed cing yod/ khyod kyi sdig la mas sdig bshags pas ci la phan zer/ byi las ne tso bsad pa nga la ci la gnod/ kho la smra ba'i thabs med de/ 'phags pa la mig gsum bltas pas/ 'phags pas/ brgya byin mig stong ldan kyang de nyid mthong ba med/ / de bzhin rta dbyangs mig gsum gyis ni ci zhig mthong*/ / ar+ya de ba mig gcig gis ni thams cad mthong*/ / de bas mig gsum bstan pa'i dgos pa ci zhig yod/ / ces smras te/ rkang pa sa la brdabs pas rkang mthil thams cad mig gis gang bas mu stegs la bstan pas/ des der skyengs pas mig nam mkha' la bltas pas/ cag lham gyi chu thigs khar lhung bas lha mnal nas smra ma shes der yi mug ste lce la spu gri btab ste lcebs so/

/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni dar bar byas so/ /༈ dur khrod dag tu bor ba'i lus/ / ta ra be'i gtsug lag khang na/ dge tshul shin tu 'dod chags che ba zhig yod pa/ bud med kyi reg bya la chags te/ cha lugs sgyur bar byed pa'i skabs su/ shā ri'i bus/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du khrid de/ bud med kyi ro bam pa dang sngos pa dang*/ keng rus su 'dug pa| sogs rim bzhin bstan nas 'di lta bu'i chos can no/ / zhes chos du ma bstan yang ma nyan/ de nas bud med kyi rul pa'i mngal na srin bu mang po 'dug pa bstan nas 'di lta bu la su zhig chags zhes mi gtsang ba'i chos du ma gsungs pas/ dge tshul na re/ srin bu 'di kun re dga' na zhes ma nyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/ nga kho na'i gdul bya'o/ / zhes btul bas/ ston pas thul lo/ /༈ de nas me tog zla mdzes kyi/ sngon sangs rgyas mngon 'phags rin chen rgyal po 'jig rten du byon nas/ sems can dpag tu med pa byang chub la bkod de/ mya ngan las 'das nas bstan pa'ang nub tu nye ba na/ pho brang rin chen ldan du/ rgyal po dpa' byin zhes pa/ bu stong*/ bu mo lnga brgya/ btsun mo brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pa zhig byung ngo*/ / de'i tshe bstan pa nyams pas nag phyogs kha rgyal te/ yul der mug nag sogs mi shis pa du ma byung ba/ de nas byang sems bdun stong yod pa'i nyes par bzung ste bskrad pa/ pho brang dang ha cang yang mi ring ba na/ kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod ces pa na/ chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes bzhugs pa de la brten nas/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan zhing rnal 'byor la brtson par gyur to/ / de nas zla mdzes gcig pur yang dag 'jog la bzhugs te/ lha mig dag pas gzigs pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing sna tshogs nas byang sems mang po 'dir skyes pas/ de dag la chos bstan na rang gi srog gi bar chad du 'gyur kyang*/ sems can rnams byang chub la phyir mi ldaug la|

ma bstan na bar chad du mi 'gyur mod*/ sems can rnams log par ltung par gzigs te/ ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas 'khor byang sems rnams la smras pa/ kho bo ni grong khyer du chos ston du 'gro'o zhes pas/ byang sems rnams na re/ khyod ni mdzes sdug cing yid 'ong la/ grong khyer 'di ni/ dam pa'i chos spaung zhing 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa log pa'i nga rgyal can mang pos gang nas/ rgyal po la sogs pa phrag dog can gyis khyed kyi srog phral na mi rung ngo*// zhes pas/ kho bos srog bsrungs nas bstan pa bsrung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes song nas bza' btung yid la mi byed par/ nyin mo chos bstan nas srog chags bye ba brgya stong mang po phyir mi ldog pa la bkod de/ mtshan mo bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gyi drung du 'greng bzhin du mnyam par bzhag go/ de ltar zhag drug 'das nas kyang zas kyi bya ba ma byas par/ nyi ma bdun pa la rin chen ldan du byon pas/ rgyal po rin chen shing rta la bzhon nas/ bu mo brgyad brgyas rin chen tha gus drangs te/ rgyal rigs bram ze sogs du mas zhabs 'bring du byas nas/ bu mo dang btsun mo rnams kyang rin chen gyi khyogs su bteg ste mdun nas 'gro ba de dag gis/ dge slong de mthong ba tsam gyis dad de/ rang rang gi bzhon pa las babs nas phyag 'tshal nas/ chos bstan pas phyir mi ldog pa la bkod do/ / der rgyal po 'di snyam du/ kye ma/ 'di dag thams cad ni dge slong 'di'i dbang du gyur nas/ kho bo la rgyab kyis phyogs so snyam mo/ / rgyal po'i lam na/ dge slong 'dug pa de'i mig tu sdug bsngal song bas/ kye ma dge slong 'dis bdag gi btsun mo la zhen sems kyis bltas nas/ mig gis kyang brda byas so snyam phrag dog lhag par skyes nas/ dge slong 'di gsod nus pa su yod ces dris pas ma byung bar/ rang gi bu stong la dge slong 'di srog dang phrol cig/

zhes pas/ bu rnams kyis kyang slar bzlog pas/ kye ma bu dag kyang bka' mi nyan na gzhan lta cis smos/ bdag gcig pu gnyis su med par bzhag na/ da dge slong 'di gsod pa su yod dam snyam du sems khong du chud pa'i tshe/ rgyal po dang ha cang yang mi ring ba na/ gshed ma dga' byed ces pa 'dug pa la/ khyod la bya dga' cher byin no/ / dge slong 'di srog dang bral nus sam byas pas/ de dga' nas/ lha rngo thogs so go zhes zer nas/ de la mtshon bskur te/ 'dis nga'i btsun mo can phyin pas rkang pa gcig chod cig/ brda zhig byas pas lag pa gnyis chod cig/ chags sems kyis bltas pas mig gnyis kyang skam pas phyung zhig/ sna dang rna ba yang chod cig ces sku lus dum bu brgyad du bcad pas khrag 'o mar 'bab cing*/ bcad 'phro la shis ltas brgyad dang*/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyang snang ngo*/ / 'od zer du ma yang phyogs bcur bskor nas sku nyid la thim mo/ / der 'dus pa'i skye bo/ / thams cad kyang brgyal ba sangs nas pho brang du song ngo*/ / rgyal po'ang mi dga' bzhin du zhag bdun nags su 'khyams nas/ slar pho brang du 'gro ba'i lam na/ de 'dug pa shi nas zhag bdun lon yang*/ sku lus kyi mdog ma 'gyur zhing*/ mtshan ltas bzang po rnams kyang mthong nas/ 'di ni bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par nges na/ bdag gis mnar med du skye ba'i las byas so/ / snyam pa dang*/ nam mkha' las/ lha'i bu brgyad khri yang dbyangs gcig tu/ de de bzhin te/ las des ni khyod myur du mnar med pa'i dmyal bar bsreg par 'gyur ro/ / zhes pas/ rgyal po ba spu 'khrugs te/ smre sngags bton nas 'gyod sems drag pos bshags te/ sku gdung rin chen khyogs la spyan drangs nas/ tsan dan dang*/ a ka ru dang*/ 'bru mar sogs kyis bsregs te/ sku gdung la rin po che'i mchod rten byas nas/ drung du sdig pa bshags te/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba rgyal srid kyi 'dod yon spangs nas tshul khrims bzung ste/

gso sbyong la gnas kyang*/ lus zhig ma thag mnar med du lhung ngo*/ / mthar sdig pa bshags te/ 'dod yon spangs nas tshul bzhin sems pa'i 'bras bu g.yung drung gi sku thob pa yin no/ / zhes so/ / ༈ de nyid med na mi dgar 'gyur/ / rgyal po su da pa de/ sngar seng ge'i ming thos pa tsam gyis 'jigs pa la/ phyis ri dwags bshor du phyin pa na/ seng ge mo gcig dang bza' mir gyur nas/ de nas seng ge mo med dus mi dga' ba bzhin no/ ༈ pha dang ma yang gsod byed cing*/ / ston pa 'das nas lo nyis brgya na/ lho phyogs bha ru nar/ bram ze lha bzang zhes pa rnam thos kyi bu ltar 'byor kyang*/ bu med par lha la gsol ba btab pas/ zla ba bcu na khye'u zhig btsas pa lha chen du btags te/ de'i btsas ston gyi phyir pha rgya mtshor lo mang du thogs nas/ bu de skyed drag pas myur du lang tsho la bab ste/ ma dang 'byar/ mas khyod nga dang lhan cig sdod 'dod na pha gsad dgos byas pas/ bus lam du pha gsad kyang ma rang bzhin gyis g.yem la dga' bas skyes pa gzhan bsten pas/ bu 'khrugs te ma yang bsad/ mchod gnas dgra bcom la chos mnyan pa'i tshe/ las 'bras kyi chos bstan te/ mi dge ba'i nang nas mtshams med kho na lci'o/ / zhes pas/ kho'i rang gnong gis/ 'di'i mngon shes kyis tshor nges so snyam nas dgra bcom kyang bsad de yi mug pas longs spyod thams cad su 'dod pa la byin nas/ dbus su 'khyams nas/ 'tsho ba slong ba'i phyir/ btsun gzugs byas nas/ bas mtha' gcig tu bsdad pas/ shing thun dang ba rdzi sogs kyis mthong nas chos zhus pas/ mchod gnas dgra bcom pa la thos pa bag re bzlas pas/ de dag gis kho'i snyan pa brjod de/ 'khor 'bum phrag du ma 'dus nas/ kha gsag dang*/ g.yo sgyu'i 'bul nor byung ba thams cad slar yang de dag la 'gyed pas/ thams cad dad nas dgra bcom du khas blangs so// mi chos bla ma'i rdzun rlabs can de'i drung du thams cad 'dus nas/

spyil po'i dbus nor byung ba thams cad du sgom byed pa'i tshul du bsdad de bsams pas/ 'dod log gi phyir pha ma dgra bcom bsad nas/ rdzun gyis skye bo mang po'i mgo bskor bas/ 'gro ba ni dmyal ba las med na snyam pa'i yi mug ste/ kye ma/ sdug bsngal lo zhes smras pa'i smre sngags/ mkhan bu rnams kyis thos te/ dgra bcom sdug bsngal las grol ba yin na/ ci'i phyir smre zhes pas/ ngas ni bden bzhi bos pa'o/ / zer/ 'khor rnams kyis chos dris pas/ nga rang yang the tshom za zer/ dgra bcom pa la'ang yid gnyis mchis sam zer/ shin tu'ang yod de/ the tshom thams cad spangs pa ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig go zer/

rdzu 'phrul ston par zhus pas/ da nang tho rangs nyams zer/ dgra bcom la'ang nyams pa mchis sam byas pas/ yod de/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa zhes pas so/ / 'dod yon brten pas/ dgra bcom la yang 'dod chags yod dam ces pas/ lus sems ma bsrungs na yod zer/ de bsrung dgos sam byas pas/ dgos te/ rjes su bsrung pa'i chos can gyi dgra bcom pa zhes gsungs pas so zer/ der 'chi khar sa'i bar 'thongs phye nas lus de nyid kyis mnar med du song ngo*/ /༈ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor brkus nas/ / na len+d+ra'i byang phyogs na/ su khyen grong zhes pa sa phug dang bcas pa zhig na/ byis pa mang po rtse ba'i dbus su/ rlung tshub 'khyil ba/ mi 'phro ba zhig byung ba la/ byis pa rnams kyis rdo rub byas pas/ byis pa zos dus su 'bog pa zhig la btab nas/ rkang pa phyed ka log tu 'gro zhing*/ lpags pa'i skyi shig shig byas te/ kha nas me lce nyug cing*/ saṃskṛ ta'i skad du thams cad la 'bar ro/ / de'i nye 'khor na byams pa sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yod pas des gsan nas byis pa 'di 'dras kyang saṃskṛ ta'i skad shes pa ngo mtshar che'o/ / snyam nas nyan du phyin pas/ de la mi 'bar bar 'dug nas rgyu mtshan dris pas 'di rnams sdang sems kyis nyan pas 'bar la/ khyod dang sems kyis nyan pas mi 'bar ba yin zer/ 'o na 'dir las gang gis skyes dris pas/ btsun gzhon 'di rnams thon zhig /khyod byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig 'dug pas drang por bshad do zer te/ ston pas/ nga na len+d+ra'i mkhan po rgyal 'byung yin te/ nga rang bdag po yin snyam nas/ dge 'dun gyi 'bras snyigs bre phyed thub chod du bcad pas/ da lta lto sreg pa'i yi dwags su skyes nas/ rtag tu nang khrol thams cad 'bar mes sreg pa'i me lce kha sna nas nyug pa yin/ sde snod bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang du mchil lham ma phud par phyin pas/

rkang pa phyi ka log tu 'chu ba dang*/ nga'i 'du khang gi thub sku la sgron me phul bas sku mnye byas te/ sbyin pa 'tshab pa ma grub par/ lhags pa'i skyi shig pa'i rdul rtag tu yod pas dkor 'di 'jigs/ dkon mchog gsum la dge 'dun gyi dkor 'di kho na lci bar 'dug go zer/ 'di las dag lo stong phrag bco lnga na thar te/ de nas mnar med du 'gro dgos pa 'dug pa zer/ 'di la bshags thabs med dam byas pas/ las 'bras la khyad bsod byas pas ye med zer/ dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'dzems na phan yon che ste/ nga'i nye gnas dpal yon bya ba/ dge 'dun la srog pas gces shing yo byad la dug pas 'jigs pa zhig yod de/ kho 'chi khar 'ja' 'od dang rol mo dang bcas nas/ lha dang chos skyong gis bsus nas song*/ kho da tsam 'khor ba las grol te 'chi gsung*/ 'o na btsun gzhon rnams gdon pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ de thams cad nga'i mkhan bu yin te/ thos na nga ngo tsha/ khong rnams yi mug nas 'gro zer/ de nas dar tsam zhig dran med song*/ yang lab pa la/ da ci nas gar phyin dris pas/ phu ya gi na rnal 'byor pa zhig 'dug pa'i dge sbyor gyi bar chad la phyin zer/ khyed mkhan po sde snod gsum shes pa zhig de 'dra byed pa zhan byas pas/ bden te nga'i shes pa la rang dbang med zer/ yang*/ sad kyang byis pa de la btab nas lus thams cad drod du byas te/ kha sna nas ni me lce nyug cing*/ thams cad la 'bar ba la/ sngar gyi rnal 'byor pa de spyan drangs te/ kho bo'i dmigs pa gcig byas pas/ kho rgod cing*/ gtum po'i skye rim la bstan pa thob pas 'jig rten gyi nus mthu can su la'ang mi 'jigs zer/ 'o na kho can 'ongs pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ ngas zas bag re rnyed kyang zos na/ lto'i me la shing bsnan pa bzhin 'gyur gin 'dug nas/ sngar 'dris kyi bag chags kyis/ kho ltogs pa la ster du 'ongs pa yin te/ kho'i las ngan sad rkyen byed kyin 'dug pa zer/
