de dag gi rgyu mtshan dris pas/ nga mkhan po byed dus su/ kho na len+d+rar brda sprod slob tu 'ongs nas/ brtul zhugs dang mi ldan par/ dge 'dun gyi tshul dang chu shing la dpyad pa'i mthong chos so zer/ des mdzad dam dris pas/ myong 'og btsugs kyis/ rnam smin/ phyi ma yi dwags su 'gro zer/ de la bshags thabs yod dam dris pas/ dge 'dun rang la bsnyen bkur byas te/ spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags nas 'dag go zer/ rnal 'byor pas de la dmigs pa'i byams pa yud tsam skyes pas/ thal mo sbyar te/ ma yang byon bdog gam zer nas 'chi ma phral byas te/ song nas phyin chad der ma 'khor ro/ /der de bzhin du tshogs su mthol te/ glaing bas der 'dus tsho khong gi mkhan bu yin par 'dug nas thams cad cho nges so/ / des na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge 'dun gyi rdzas la sha bu'i 'du shes bzhag par bya'o/ / zhes pa'i don to/ / ༈ rmongs rnams sdug bsngal mi zad len/ khyim bya'i lha khang na dge 'dun gyi gnas gzhi zhig yod pa las/ der skyes bu lnga brgya tsam gyis dge 'dun gsol ba'i 'bab chu rnyogs so/ / der 'bras btsor ma btub nas dge 'dun gyi chos ston chag go / de ni byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rnam rgyal bzhugs pa la| dge 'dun rnams kyi tshogs dpon byas pas/ rdo rje gdan na skar ma sa ga'i mchod pa la blta ru gshegs zer ba bzhin phyin pa'i lam du bye rlung chen po zhig na bud med kyi skad cig gnya' tser gyis drag nas bltas pas/ yi dwags mo chen mo zhig la bu lnga brgya skyes nas 'dug pa gzigs so/ / der yi dwags mo na re/ byang chub sems dpa' bdag cag la zas skom byin cig zer/ byang chub sems dpa' 'gyur mgul de nas chu blud pas gre bar ma song bar/ khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas byin pas tshim par gyur ro/ / der yi dwags mo na re/ khyed rdo rje gdan du gshegs na 'phrin cig gsungs shig/

nga'i khyo zas 'tshol du song nas zla ba drug lon te/ zas khyer la myur du shog/ nga ni shi la khad na zer ro/ / gsungs shig /de ngas ngo mi shes byas pas/ mig ya gcig med pa/ rna ba ya gcig med pa/ lag pa dang rkang pa'ang ya re med pa zhig bdog go zer/ de ngas mi mthong byas pas/ rdzas 'di bcangs pas mthong zer te rdzas shig bskur ro/ / der byang chub sems dpa' gdan du byon nas sny-ing rje'i bsam pas/ yi dwags mo'i 'phrin ma brjed de/ lho ngos gshin rje'i lha khang du phyin nas bltas pas/ 'dre thams cad gong bu gcig tu 'dus nas 'dug/ sa bslang bas/ thams cad langs pa'i yi dwags mo'i khyo byung ba gzigs te/ 'phrin bzlas pas/ yi dwags na re/ ngas zla ba drug gi bar du zla zas btsal yang ma rnyed/ da lta mi gcig gis lud pa bor ba thob pas/ 'dre thams cad 'dus te brdungs nas sdug bsngal ba gzigs so/ mchil ma de yang da ni bskams 'dug na zer/ byang chub sems dpas ngas zas skom sbyin gyis khyer la song byas pas/ yi dwags gzhan gyis 'phrog zer/ der byang chub sems dpas zas skom bum pa gnyis la/ khro bo mi g.yo ba'i sngags kyis srung ba byas nas bskur bas/ bu smad gyi gam du phyin nas zos pas tshim par gyur te/ de nas skar ma sa ga'i dus mchod thos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'khor bcas kyis slar bhang ga lar byon pa'i lam du sngar gyi yi dwags rnams dang 'phrad de/ phyag 'tshal nas/ der yang zas skom byin no/ / byang chub sems dpas khyed du yod dris pas/ lnga brgya'o zer 'dir las cis skyes byas pas/ khyed 'dzam bu gling pa yid ches par dka' bas mi smra zer/ ngas mngon sum du mthong bas yid ches so byas pas/ nged rnams kyis khyim bya'i lha khang gi dge 'dun gyi chu rnyogs te/ chos ston bcag pas so zer/ nged 'di las thar pa'i thabs mnga'am zer/ byang chub sems dpas thabs yod kyis sems rtse gcig tu gyis la/

yi ge drug pa bzlos shig gsungs pa bzhin/ yi dwags rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du byas pas/ de ma thag tu tshe 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes so/ /༈ bsam pa nyams pa'ang skye bar 'gyur/ / bskal ba dang po'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir/ rgyal po bsnyen pa'i spyi bo'i lba ba las khye'u mdzes pa zhig byung ba| mtshan mkhan gyis gling bzhi la dbang bar lung bstan nas/ spyi bo skyes su btags te/ yab 'das pa dang rgyal tshab zhus pas/ nga la rgyal po'i dbang thang zhig yod na/ de dag 'bad med du 'byung bar gyur cig ces pas/ 'dzam gling kun du ci 'dod babs pas/ blon po rnams la/ 'di su'i mthu dris pas/ rgyal po'i yon tan dang sems can gyi bsod nams so zer bas/ nga'am/ sems can su'i yin par 'bab par gyur cig ces pas/ gzhan du 'bab 'phro chad nas pho brang nyid du zhag bdun babs te/ 'dzam gling du lo khri phrag mang po bde ba spyad pa dang*/ rgyal po nyid kyis gzigs pa'i gnod sbyin lha gnas kyis/ 'di bas kyang lus 'phags pa gling na 'byor pa che bas/ der gshegs par dgyes pa tsam gyis 'khor lo nam mkha' la 'phags te/ rgyal phran rnams kyis bsus nas/ der lo stong phrag du ma dga' bde spyad pa dang*/ yang lha gnas kyis/ ba glang spyod dang*/ sgra mi snyan dang*/ ris bzhir yang sngar bzhin spyad do/ / yang rtsa gsum du bskul te/ sna bdun 'phags pas/ de ma thag tu/ rgyal po 'khor bcas nam mkha' la 'gro bas/ rta glang gi rtswa chus ri rab kyi khong seng na drang srong lnga brgya yod pa'i lus la phog na/ 'di ci zhig rtog pa dang*/ drang srong blo dang ldan pa zhig na re/ spyi bo skyes sum cu rtsa gsum du song*/ zer gyis/ de'i rta glang gi bshang gci'o zer nas/ bshang gci phog pas khros nas/ drang srong de dag gis ting nge 'dzin gyis bcings pas/ rgyal po dpung bcas kyis 'gro bar ma nus par/ rgyal pos kyang de ltar shes nas/

nga la rgyal po'i dbang thang yod na/ drang srong de dag nga la phyag 'tshal te/ nga'i zhabs 'bring la 'byung bar gyur cig ces pas/ de ma thag tu thams cad byung nas zhabs 'bring byas te byon pa mthong nas lha rnams sngangs te/ sgo thams cad bcad nas btang ba sum rim bcug go / der spyi bo skyes kyis dung bus/ gzhu rgyud bsgrengs pas/ sgo thams cad rang bye nas/ brgya byin gyis ma bzod par rings par bsu ste/ stan phyer bstabs nas/ lha'i dbang po drug gi bar du dga' bde spyad pa'i/ lha dbang tha ma byang sems 'od srung gi tshe/ lha min gyi dmag gis pham par byas te/ lha dbang bros pa na/ spyi bo skyes kyis dung bus/ gzhu rgyud bsgrengs pas/ lha min chu nang du byer bas nga rgyal skyes te/ 'dir dbang po gnyis mi dgos pas/ 'di bsad la nga 'ba' zhig gis bya'o/ / snyam pa'i ngan sems skyes ma thag tu pho brang rnying pa'i sgo drung du lhung nas de'u rer shi'o/ / der mi rnams lhags te su yin zhes 'dri'o/ / sngar gyi blon rgan gling skyong zhes pas ngo shes te/ 'jig rten pa dag 'dri na ji ltar lan gdab par bya zhes dris pa'i lan du/ gling bzhi/ lha gnas gnyis kyis 'dod pas chog ma shes par bsam ngan skyes te rtsa gsum nas lhung nas/ 'dzam gling du tshe'i dus byas te/ mnar med du song ngo zhes lan thob cig zer nas 'gyod bzhin du tshe'i dus byas so/ / de lta bu'i 'byor pa de ni sngon sran 'tshong du gyur pa na/ sangs rgyas pa ru sha la sran ma phyed dang lnga dad gus kyis gtor ba'i 'bras bu'o/ / ༈ de yi phun tshogs zad mi shes/ / mnyan yod dang ha cang yang mi ring ba na| sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa la bya ba byas pa des pa zhes pa zhig yod pa des/ gsal rgyal chog mi shes shing 'dod pa la brkam pas/ khyim bdag lnga brgya'i bdog pa phrogs nas mi kun bzung ba de gdul ba'i phyir/ phyags dar khrod nas rin chen 'dzam gling gi nor thams cad pas dga' ba zhig rnyed pa dang*/

su dbul ba la ster ro zhes pas/ der tshogs pa'i mul sprang sogs la mi ster bar/ khyod pas ches dbul ba gsal rgyal la ster zer ba thos nas/ nga la gter mdzod 'di rnyed cig yod na/ dbul ba'i rgyu mtshan ci dris pa'i lan du/ rin chen gter mchog dpag med kyang*/ / chog mi shes shing brkam pa khyod/ / 'jig rten 'di na ches dbul lo/ / byas pas/ de la dpang po su yod zer/ chos kyi rje'o/ / ngas spyan drang ngo zer ba la/ mi dgos 'byon par 'gyur gyis zer te/ kun mkhyen rgyal po kun gzigs pas/ / bdag gis bsam pa mkhyen mdzod la/ / byang chub bdag gi drung bzhud cig/ ces pas byon nas/ rgyal pos zhus pas/ des pa bden te/ khyod ni zhes sogs 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs gsungs pas/ khyim bdag nor dang bcas pa btang nas/ rang gi rgyal srid kyang spangs te/ sems bskyed do/ /༈ 'phel phyir skabs dbye mi bya ste/ /dzñā na shrī'i paṇa chung gu na shrī zhes pa/ 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa de ci yang mi 'dzin pas/ gtor ma rdo leb kyi steng du/ khyor bas chu ldugs pa la/ bla chen stag tshas mi bzhed bzhin du gtor snod cig nan gyis phul/ de'i grogs su chu bum zhig kyang phul/ de nas mchod cha/ dpe rten sogs 'bul ba bag re blangs pas/ phyis 'dod pa 'phel te/ mnga' ris kyi mkhan po mdzad nas/ stod phyogs kyi gnas dgon thams cad btad kyang chog ma shes par/ thang chung du yi ge skur phyin pa zhig byung ngo*/ / gang zhig yid 'ong mi 'dzin pa/ /spyal chos bzang rdo rje gdan na/ lo tsā slob pa'i rgyags skyel ba lho phyogs kyi tshong pa mang po dang 'grogs te/ phyin pa'i lam du shi skyid byung nas/ nor kun khyer/ mi kun bsad de/ gser mid yod de zer nas rgyu ma'ang ded pa la/ nyang stod sgom dad ces pa skud pa tsam zhig kyang bdag tu mi 'dzin pa zhig kyang sangs rgyas kyi gdan sa lan gcig mthong na snyam nas 'grogs phyin pa de la/

nam bza' phyag dar lhum po zhig las med par/ pen da ba de la reg na/ mkhar che ldog go zer te/ gsod 'phrog lta zhog reg pa'ang ma byung ba bzhin no/ / 'gro la phan phyir lus btang bya/ /tshong pa mang pos rgya mtsho la nor bu 'don du phyin pas/ gzings zhig nas tshong pa thams cad shi / sems bskyed pa'i mi zhig yod pa ma shi nas 'ongs pas/ rgya gar gyi phyug po'i lugs kyis/ rgyal po'i chad pa'am/ dgra byung na gsug gtong ba'i gser srang gsum bzhi re lus la 'chang ba yin pas kho la'ang gser srang gsum yod pa/ nub mo mgron khang zhig tu nyal bas rkun po kha cig byung ste/ kho la nor blang byas pas/ kho sems bskyed pa yin pas/ gser srang gsum po mod la byin pas/ rkun pos/ 'di tsam dus la ster lugs kyis/

da dung yod snyam nas/ da dung blang byas pas/ med do zer/ 'o na khyod gsod do byas pas/ gsod kyang med zer/ der snying khar pha bong zhig gis mnan nas mig tu gri btsugs te 'don no byas pas/ mig 'don kyang da nga la nor ni med kyis thon cig byas pas/ rkun po dpyad pa skyes nas/ khyod la yon tan ci yod dris pas/ nga la yon tan gzhan med/ sems bskyed de lus srog chags med du sems la btang bas so zer/ rkun po dad de/ gser yang slar byin/ kho rang yang g.yog tu byas so/ /༈ yang slob dpon klu sgrub klu'i yul nas 'bum spyan 'dren pa'i dus su/ slob dpon byad gzugs shin tu mdzes pa la/ klu rnams chags te/ khyod la nged kyi bu mo sbyin no sdod zer/ slob dpon na re/ sngon la ngas mi yul du phyin la| mchod rtain bye ba phrag rgya brtsigs te 'ong ngo zer/ der 'bum gyi po ti gcig rting par bzhag nas gzhan spyan drangs so/ / der mi yul du mchod rtain re'i nang du sgrol ma la sogs pa'i sku re re bzhugs pa bye ba phrag brgya ru gcig gis ma tshang ba brtsigs te/ klu thams cad kyis grogs byas pas myur du/ grub bo/ /gcig ni ma brtsigs te/ klu'i yul du 'gro ba dgag pa'i phyir ro/ / der slob dpon gyis lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la byon nas seng khri la bzhugs te/ nang re bzhin du/ mi rnams la ci 'dod sbyin no zhes smras nas/ bcud len dang*/ rig pa la sogs pa gang dang gang 'dod pa ster ro/ / de nas nam zhig rgyal po sa lam ba ha na zhes bya ba zhig bcud len slob par 'dod pa'i skabs su/ de'i bus ma la smras pa/ ngas yab kyi rgyal srid 'di nam thob/ ma na re/ khyod kyi pha ni slob dpon la bcud len bslabs nas tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par 'gro ste/ khyod kyis rgyal srid mi 'thob bo zer/ bu na re/ 'o na thob pa'i thabs 'dra yod dam/ yod de/ sang slob dpon klu sgrub seng ge'i khri steng nas ci 'dod sbyin no zer gyis/

de'i drung du song la dbu slongs shig/ 'on kyang khyod kyi pha la bcud len mi slob pas/ pha myur du 'chi la/ der khyod kyis rgyal srid thob bo zhes smras so/ / der bus/ ber nag cig gyon nas ral gri mchan du bcug ste/ slob dpon gyi drung du phyin nas/ bdag la dbu stsol cig byas te/ lag pa bzed pas/ slob dpon gyis rtswa ku sha zhig phyag gnyis kyis bzung ste/ dbu bcad nas byin no/ / der ske'i rtsa bo che lnga'i nang nas/ nga yi yid ni bde ba can gyi zhing du 'gro/ / tshe lo lnga bcu pa la 'gro ba'i don du 'ong*/ /zhes sogs/ tshigs tshogs bcad mang du byung ngo*/ / de nas rgyal po'i bus dbu khyer te phyin pas/ slob dpon gyi mngag gzhug pa'i gnod sbyin rnams kyis/ rgyal bu ske btsir te bsad do/ / gnod sbyin rnams kyis/ dbu btegs la/ sker bzhag par gzas pas dbu ma theg go / lo re zhing nas tsam gyis je nye je nyer 'ong ste/ phrad tsam na slob dpon 'byon no/ / da lta las dag pas kyang sku dang*/ dbu mthong ste/ rtag tu 'o ma 'dzag cing*/ rlangs pa thol le/ deng sang ni phrad la khad yod par grags te/ tshe lo lnga bcu par nye ba'i phyir ro/ / le'u brgyad pa'o/ / // ka9 le'u dgu pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ bcom ldan sgyu ma mkhan gsum dang*/ / mig sman sang ku gsal thub dang*// sgur chung me mgal khy-i gu dang*/ / las 'bras bar phyug bzang po'o/ / bcu gsum nor ba yang blo khyad kyi/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ / kun dga' bo'i shes rab brtag pa'i ched du/ bka' bstsal pa/ kun dga' bo/ 'di nas rgyal po'i khab tu khyod song la/ nga na ba la 'o ma tshol la shog cig ces so/ / der kun dga' bos grong khyer du phyin pa dang li tsa byi dri ma med par grags pa shes rab mchog tu gyur par mthong nas dris pa dang*/ kun dga' bos lan ji lta ba bzhin du gsol bas/

dri med grags pas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni rdo rje'i sku ste/ sdug bsngal ma lus pa nye bar bcom pas na/ sku la snyun mi mnga' ste/ de ltar sems dpa' ni khyod rab tu 'khrul lo zhes sogs rtsod pa du ma'i sgo nas sun phyung pas/ kun dga' bo slar log nas bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin pas/ khyod kyis 'o ma rnyed dam gsungs/ lan du dri ma med pa'i gtam rgyud smras pas/ bcom ldan 'das na re/ de de bzhin du bden te/ 'on kyang ngas ni/ 'khor ba'i chos dang bstun te/ khyod kyi shes rab brtag pa'i ched du'o/ / gsung ngo*/ /༈ gal te sems can sgyu 'dra na/ /mnyan yod kyi grong khyer na sgyu ma mkhan zhig gi khyim du/ mgron po lha bzo ba zhig gis zhag sa byas so/ / der sgyu ma mkhan des/ bu mo shin tu mdzes pa zhig sprul te/ nub mo mgron po lha bzo ba de la rngul yab byed du bcug go / der mgron po de bu mo la sems shin tu chags nas lag pa 'jus pas/ shing khrog la sogs par gyur te/ bu mo zhig go / der mgron po skyengs nas ngo tsha ste/ nyal ba'i logs de nyid du/ kho rang bkyigs te shi ba'i gzugs brnyan cig bris te bros nas phyin no/ / der nang par nyi ma shar tsam na/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis mgron po bos pas/ med de/ nang du phyin tsam na bkyigs nas shi bar mthong ngo*/ / der chad pa byung gis dwogs skrag nas/ gnyer byed pa'i rgyal po'i 'khor 'du sa ta zhes bya ba bos nas khyim du khrid de/ ngas ma bsad pa'i rgyu mtshan yid ches par bya ba'i phyir bstan no/ / der des kyang mthong nas bkyigs pa'i thag pa la gri btab pas/ gyang logs kyi ri mor song nas/ yang sgyu ma mkhan skyengs so/ / ༈ rgyun ring tsam gyis ji ltar na/ / sgyu ma mkhan gyi khyim du/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis zhag 'ga' bzhugs nas/ de nas sgyu ma mkhan gzhan zhig gi grong du phyin pas/ sgyu ma mkhan des mthong ste/

'di lta bu'i dge slong mdzes pa 'dir 'ong ba/ nges par sgyu ma mkhan gyis nyams sod pa yin snyam nas/ khos kyang*/ de lta bu'i dge slong zhig sprul nas drung du btang ngo*/ / klu sgrub kyis/ dge slong de la bde bar 'ongs sam dris pas/ sgyu ma'i dge slong gis smra ma shes so/ / de nas ring zhig lon nas sgyu ma'i dge slong slar zhig ste song nas/ sgyu ma mkhan de 'di snyam du sems te/ nga bas sgyu ma mkhan gzhan nges par mkhas so snyam mo// de'i bsam pa mkhyen nas/ 'phags pas/ nga ni klu sgrub yin no/ khyod ni sgyu ma yin te/ sgyu ma mkhan gnyis mthu mnyam mo/ / zhes gsungs pas/ sgyu ma mkhan de bdag mi mkhas so snyam pa'ang med do/ /༈ sgyu ma de yang sna tshogs nyid/ / rgyal po zhig gi drung du/ mi zhig lag pa g.yas su ral gri zhig khyer g.yon du phub cig bzung*/ bud med cig khrid de byung nas/ bud med rgyal po la bcol nas/ kho nam mkha' la thag pa zhig brgyangs nas de la 'dzegs song ngo*/ / dar cig na kho'i lag pa dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ mgo bo dang*/ gri phug rnams kyang rim par lhung byung bas der lha dang lha min 'khrugs pa'i bar du kho shi bar bzung bas/ skyes bu na re/ da kho ni shi / chung ma 'di nga la blang zer bas/ rgyal pos kyang byin no/ / der kho'i mgo lus kun tshogs pa na/ khong langs byung ste/ rgyal po la nga'i chung ma bcol ba 'dod zer/ khyod shi snyam nas bud med gzhan la byin byas pas/ ma nyan par/ slar kho rang la byin no/ /༈ grub pa'i mig sman sbyor ba las/ /mig sman phyogs gcig tsam ni/ byi la la/ ma he sha'i mar snyod do/ / de ma bzhu bar 'phongs nas byung ba/ thod pa'i nang du ar ka'i lo mas sdong bu byas te/ mar me btang ba'i dud pa/ thod pa steng ma'i nang du chags pa mig la bskus na'o/ / yang na ar ka'i lo ma'i cang lham gyon pa'o/ / de min na/ khye'u 'am/ bu mo rkang pa sngon la skyes de'i gnya' khung du bzhon nas rkang pa sa la ma reg par phyin na/

sa 'og gi gter bum rin chen gyis gang pa mthong ngo*/ /༈ dper na nam mkha' lding gi ni/ / zhes pa'i skabs su lho phyogs grong khyer kri yar/ bram ze spun bdun yod pa klu dang 'gras te/ klus spun drug rim gyis zos so/ / tha chung bram ze sang ku zhes pa zhig lus pa de'ang zos kyis dwogs nas/ mkhar sum brtsegs byas te/ 'og tu byi la mang po bzhag/ bar du sang ku bza' mi gnyis bzhag nas/ steng khang du rma bya mang po bzhag nas bsrungs so/ / nyin cig sang ku'i chung mas klu'i grong du phyin nas mchod mang po byas so zer/ sang ku khros nas klu'i khang pa thams cad bshig go / der klu rnams kyis gros byas te/ 'di la gnod pa sus nus byas pas/ sus kyang 'gro ma nus pa la/ klu mo mchu can ma chen mo na re/ ngas nus kyis zer nas phu zhes brjod pas/ rlung chen po langs pas/ steng khang gi rma bya rnams 'og tu bros so/ / der klu mos sbrul chung ngu zhig tu sprul nas/ steng khang du 'dzegs te/ sang ku nub mo nyal ba'i brla la so btab bo/ / nang bar chung mas sang ku longs byas pas shi nas 'dug go / de nas mya ngan byed cing chu bo gaṅgā la gru chen po zhig gi nang du/ sang ku'i ro dang*/ chung ma rnams bcug ste phy-in no/ / de nas chu bo'i phar 'gram tshur 'gram na phyugs rdzi mang po yod pas/ gru'i nang na bud med ngu ba mthong nas dris pa dang*/ nga'i khyo klus bsad khyed la gso thabs yod dam zer ro/ / la la na re med zer/ la la na re ngas khyo bya yis tshur shog zer/ de bzhin nyi ma gsum phyin pas/ yang phyugs rdzi zhig snga ma bzhin du 'dri ba la/ sngar bzhin lan byas pas/ de na re tshur chod cig dang*/ 'di na klu'i grong khyer yod kyis zer nas/ der phyin tsam na phyugs rdzi na re/ yo byad phyung zhig zer/ bud med kyis yo byad phyung ste klu la mchod pa byas pas klu yis dug phyung ste/ sang ku sos par byas so/

/ der phyugs rdzi la de na yod pa'i yo byad lhag ma thams cad byin nas nga'i yul du 'dong zhig/ yo byad mang po sbyin no/ /byas pas/ thag ring zer te 'gror ma nyan/ khyo shug gnyis pos yul du phyin nas/ mi zhig dang phrad de/ yul 'dir mi snyan pa med dam dris pas/ gzhan med/ bram ze sang ku shi ba'i bdun tshigs dang chos ston byed do zer/ der mi de slar btang nas/ nga bram ze sang ku shi ba slar gsos kyis/ pha ma la phyir phrad du shog bsrings pas/ shi ba gsos pa med do/ / zhes pha ma slar ngus so/ / der bza' mi gnyis pos nang du phyin pas/ gnyen 'dun thams cad yid gnyis su gyur bzhin du dga'o/ / der sang kus klus mi tshugs pa'i rig pa du ma yang bslabs so/ / yul gzhan zhig tu phyin pa na/ bud med mang po chu 'gram na ras 'khru ba mthong nas der phyin tsam na bud med gcig pu gcig khur byung ba/ bu des ngus nas/ ras 'khrur mi stair ba la/ bud med des shog byas pas/ sbrul cig byung nas des bu'i rkang pa la so btab pas dran med du song ngo*/ / der ras bkru ba zin nas/ yang shog byas pas sbrul cig gis blags pas/ bu de bos te khyim du song ngo*/ / der sang kus zla ba drug tu thal ba phyag cing bzhag /zhabs tog byas pas/ bud med na re/ khyod ci 'dod zer/ der sang kus lo rgyus zhib tu gsol nas/ klus mi tshugs pa'i man ngag 'dod byas pas/ snod du mi rung bas phan mi thogs zer/ nan gyis zhus pas/ dam rdzas kyang rnyed dka' zer/ 'bad pas rnyed de/ mkha' lding gi rigs sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas 'thung du bcug pas/ phul drug gi bar du rim bzhin yog/ lhag ma lus na gnyis ka la gnod ces sdigs kyang*/ bdun las ma yog par/ phul gang lus nas bud med na re sngar du snod du mi rung byas ste mi nyan 'dug/ brgyad bar 'thungs na klu rigs brgyad bar gyi dug las grol te/ phul gang lus pas/

khyod la nam zhig na/ klu nor rgyas kyi gnod pa 'byung bas/ de'i gso thabs su rgya mtsho'i lbu ba dam tshig gsum gyis longs la byugs shig/ klu rigs bdun las grol ba'i dngos grub thob pa yin no zer/ de nas sang kus klu nad sngar byung sos shing phyis 'byung gso ba'i thabs su/ mkha' lding gi mchod sdong zhes pas/ rdo ring gi steng du bya khyung gi gzugs byas te/ gzungs sngags kyi nus pa bgos nas bzhag go / sngags kyi nus pas klu'i bu mo thams cad bkug cing longs spyod pa na/ nor rgyas kyi sring mo la/ sang kus klu ci rtse thub dris shig byas pa bzhin/ dris pas/ sang kus gsang ma thub kyis dwogs nas thams cad thub byas so/ / der klu mos ming po la smras pas nor rgyas kyis sang ku'i ltag par so btab pas/ der g.yog gnyis la rnal 'byor mas bsgo ba bzhin du/ phyir mig ma lta/ ltas na'ang gtam ma smra/ smras pa'ang ma nyan zhes pa'i dam tshig gsum gyis rgya mtsho'i sbu ba longs shig ces btang bas/ longs nas dris pa'i grong 'dabs su slebs pa dang*/ klus ma bzod par sman par sprul nas bdas pas/ zin nas 'bod kyang ma ltas pa la sman pa'i skad du grag nas bltas pas/ 'di ltar phyin byas pas/ kho shi zin na/ da sbu bas ci byed pho las thong zer nas pho phyin pas/ sang ku ma shi bar sbu ba longs sam zer/ longs te/ 'di ltar zer nas pho byas pas/ dam tshig gsum gang rung zhig bsrungs na 'grub pa la/ de klu'i sprul pa yin gyis/ slar song la sbu ba sa dang 'dres pa phyogs las shog zer te/ phyin pas/ sbu ba pho ba'i shul kyang*/ klu gdug pa'i stobs kyis rdzing bu zhig tu byas nas 'dug go / der bram ze yi ched 'das na'ang*/ des bsgrubs pa'i mchod sdaung des da dung klu nad zhi bar byed pa bzhin no/ / ༈ 'das kyang don rnams thams cad mdzad/ /sngon bskal ba grangs med pa'i sngon rol du/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir/

rgyal po gsal thub ces bya ba/ rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong snyed la dbang bskur ba zhig byung ba des/ sangs rgyas bi shwa zhes pa zhig 'jig rten du byon pa de la/ yo byad rnam pa mang po'i sgo nas mchod cing bsnyen bkur yang*/ mya ngan las 'da' khar/ rgyal pos zhus pa| ston pa thugs rje dang ldan pa lags na/ bdag gi rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong 'di/ mi dge ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ ston pa'i zhal ma mthong zhing mchod pa'ang ma phul bas 'di rnams ngan song du 'khyam pa ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ 'das pa'i 'og tu nga'i gzugs brnyan bzhengs su gsol la/ mchod pa lugs su phul cig 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so/

/ de nas rgyal po gsal thub kyis/ rin chen lugs su blug pa dang*/ ras bris la sogs pa sku brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhengs te/ rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong po thams cad sbran nas/ mchod pa phul cig par bsdams te/ thams cad kyis de bzhin du byas pas/ 'bras bu thob bo/ /nor bu/ de'i tshe/ de'i dus na| rgyal po gsal thub ni/ da ltar gyi shākya thub pa'o/ / rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong ni/ nyan thos kyi dge slong brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ zhes so/ /༈ las kyi nus pa mthong ba yin/ / mnyan yod kyi grong khyer na/ khyim bdag dbul po zhig gi chung ma la/ bu zhig btsas pa cher skyes nas kyang pha ma dang bcas pa 'dam pa 'ba' zhig za'i/ gzhan bzar med pas/ bu'i ming yang 'dam zan sgur chung zhes grags so/ / deng sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la/ rab tu byung nas/ bden pa bzhi bsgoms pas dgra bcom pa thob bo/ / de nas grong khyer du bsod snyoms la phyin pas cung zad kyang ma rnyed de/ zhag gsum du ltogs so/ / der mnyan yod kyi grong khyer du 'phags pa sgur chung ni zhag gsum du ltogs so zhes grags so/ / der gnas brtan 'od srung gis/ lhung bzed gnyis khyer te bsod snyoms byas nas bkang ste 'ongs pas/ sgur chung la sbyin rgyu'i lhung bzed lam du bya rog gis pho nas/ der zhag bzhi ltogs so/ / yang shā ri'i bus kyang sngar bzhin lhung bzed gnyis blangs te 'ongs pas/ ba zhig gis brdungs te sgur chung gi lhung bzed bo bas/ zhag lngar ltogs so/ / yang mo'u 'gal gyi bus kyang sngar bzhin 'ongs pas/ rang gi bsod snyoms gsol ba'i bar la/ sgur chung la dmigs pa'i lhung bzed sa'i steng du song ste/ de ltar zhag bdun du ltogs pa'i nangs par/ 'phags pa sgur chung de nyon mongs med kyang*/ sngon gyi las kyi nus pas ltogs grir shi'o/ / de nas/ 'khor rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ 'phags pa sgur chung ni nyon mongs pa bcom nas dgra bcom par gyur bzhin du/

'tsho ba'i zhal zas la rkyen du mas bar du bcad nas/ ltogs par 'gro ba'i rgyu thams cad mkhyen pas bshad du gsol/ zhes zhus pas/ bka' bstsal pa/ sngon ma ta ga'i grong du/ khyim bdag phyug po gcig la bu med nas/ sde pa drug gi ston pa la chos ston drangs te bu blangs pas/ smon lam btab ste lo dus na bu zhig btsas te/ de cher skyes nas pha shi / der ma des dge 'dun la sbyin pa du ma gtong ba la/ bu shin tu ser sna can du gyur te/ mas nga'i nor rdzas brlag par byed snyam nas/ sbyin gnas rnams la ni khro zhing*/ mdzod sgo la lcags bcug go / der ma na re nga la bza' ba blang zer ba la/ bus 'dag pa byin pas/ zhag bdun na ma ni ltogs grir shi'o/ / der bu de'ang rjes su 'gyod pa drag pos sangs rgyas la bshags shing*/ tshe'i dus byas nas/ skye ba lnga brgyar ltogs grir shi ba'i rnam smin gyi lhag ma'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ / yang*/ ༈ mchog zung zhig 'gro lngar ci rigs su 'chags pa na/ dmyal ba'i mtha' zhig na/ lus ri bo tsam pa'i lce yul ljongs tsam zhig la/ rmos dor lnga brgya'i gshol mda' 'bar bas rmos pa'i sdug bsngal nyin mo myong la/ mtshan mo ni rmos glang skyes nas bde bar gnas pa zhig gzigs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ bdag 'dzam gling du/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 'od srung rdzogs byed du gyur pa na/ nyin par chos log bstan cing*/ mtshan mo ni dpal dal bar bsdad pa'i las 'bras so/ / 'phags pa dag 'dzam gling du gshegs na/ bdag gi slob ma rnams la/ chos log bstan pas shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ / khyed kyis chos bshad pa dang nga'i rus bu la mchod pa tsam gyis nga'i sdug bsngal rgyas par 'gyur gyin 'dug pas/ khyed thams cad kyis log lam bor la drang lam la zhugs shig ces bsrings te/ gnyis pos 'dzam gling du byon pa'i tshe/ kho'i slob ma rnams chos bshad cing 'dug pas mthong nas/ kha cig na re/

shākya sras kyi dge sbyong dag snang na/ de la 'o skol gyis ji ltar sgrub par bya zer/ kha cig na re/ gzhan sgrub rgyu ci yod/ ldal du zad mod zer/ kha cig na re de kho nar ldal na ma legs kyis sngon la bsnyad brtsal bar bya'o zer/ der shā ri'i bus sngon la 'ongs pa dang*/ kun tu rgyu de dag na re/ shā ri'i bu nged kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong yod dam med zer/ shā ri'i bus dgongs te/ kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong yod/ dge sbyong yang dag lam zhugs yin zhes smras pas skabs ma rnyed de/ legs par smras kyis thongs shig zer/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus phyi nas 'ongs nas/ yang*/ de dag na re/ nged kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong yod med dri ba la/ khyed kun tu rgyu la dge sbyong med/ dge sbyong nang pa'i khyad chos yin zhes brjod de/ slob dpon gyi 'phrin yang bzlas pas/ de dag sngangs shing 'khrugs nas dge sbyong 'go reg pa 'dis/ bdag cag la kha zer du ma zad/ bdag gi ston pa la yang mi snyan pa brjod pa 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ gzhan sgrub rgyu ci yod/ brdeg tu zad mod ces dbyug brdungs byas te/ 'dam bu'i khyim du glang po che shor ba ltar rtsib ma thams cad bcom nas de nyid du sa la 'gyel lo/ / der thogs nas shā ri'i bus gzigs su byon nas drin dris pas/ mu stegs pas 'di ltar byas so/ / zer/ khyed sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu lung bstan pa ma yin nam/ 'phags pa rdzu 'phrul gyis mi byon par byas pas/ dge sbyong dag las kyi nus pa la ltos/ 'dir las kyi nus pas non nas/ rdzu ba lta zhog 'phrul ba'ang ma dran na zer/ shā ri'i bus/ bu chung la bya ba ltar chos gos kyi khud du khur 'ongs te/ gsal rgyal la rgyu mtshan bshad pas/ kun tu rgyu la chad pas gcod par thos te bros nas ma rnyed do/ / mtsho byed bos nas/ 'di ma sos na khrims dang sbyor zhes btad kyang*/

bgres shing brdung tshabs che bas skrag nas/ nyid la skyabs su song bas/ nga'i las kyi nus pa mthong zhing*/ ston pa'ang myur du gshegs pas bsdad long med kyis/ kho bos zhag bdun na rdzul 'phrul gyis chad pa las bkrol te 'da'o/ / zhes pa la/ sman pas kyang zhag bdun na gdangs te/ grong khyer du bsod snyoms la byon no// zhes bsgrags te/ bdag nyid ji lta bar sprul nas mnyan yod nas bsod snyoms blangs te/ lha mi dad pa'i rdzul 'phrul sna tshogs bstan te/ na len+d+rar dgra bcom pa bdun khri dang bcas te mya ngan las 'das so/ / shā ri'i bu de'i sngon la dgra bcom brgyad khri dang bcas te/ grong khyer shing 'thag can du mya ngan las 'das te/ chung bu grogs mya ngan las 'da' ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pas so/ / las kyi nus pa ji ltar na/ sngon ri brag cig tu bram ze khyo shug gnyis kyi bur gyur pa na/ khyim thab kyi phra ma la brten nas/ pha ma rgan rgon 'di dag gi yan lag kun 'dam bu dkrugs pa bzhin btang ngo*/ / zhes pa'i ngag rtsub kyis/ skye ba du mar ngan song myong*/ mir gyur kyang*/ skye ba lnga brgyar rtsib ma 'dam bu dkrugs pa bzhin gyur cing 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal myong la/ da lta nyon mongs zad kyang las kyi nus pa de lta bu mthong ba yin no/ / zhes so/ / sdug bsngal de nyid du yod na/ ma gha dha na mi zhig la shu ba gsar pa chus bkang pa zhig yod pa'i nang du/ khang thog nas khyi yis chu btang ba sa bon dang 'dres nas lhung ngo*/ / der mi des de ltar ma tshor bar 'thungs pas/ khong par lhums su gyur te ya mtshan che bar gyur te/ der zla ba mang po lon nas yid shin tu mi bde ba la/ sman pas chu mang po 'thung du bcug pas/ chus khyi gu khong pa'i stod du bteg go / snying kha'i gong du slebs tsam na/ mi de mi gtsang ba la bsgom du bcug pas/ khong pa'i nang gi khyi gu shin tu dga' ste/ mi gtsang ba bza' bar 'dod pas mi de'i kha nas skyes so/

/ de nas/ mi gtsang ba'i dri la snom pa'i dus su/ mi la sdug bsngal yod la/ khong pa'i khyi gu la bde bar yod pas/ bde sdug don la bden par mi rigs so/ / rigs na gnyis ka mtshungs dgos so/ /zhes pa'o/ /༈ re zhig 'jig rten mngon sum gyis/ /kun rgyu byang chub bam/ tshangs pa'i skye rabs sogs brjod nas/ las rgyu 'bras mi bslu bar gtan la dbab bo/ /dbang phyug 'gro ba'i rgyu yin na/ rgya gar du bram ze spun gsum skyes pa'i/ phu bo ni/ ba ra swa mi ste/ rdo rje gdan bzhengs so/ / bar pa ni/ pa ki la swa mi ste/ mu stegs kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs so/ / de gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das dang*/ dbang phyug gang zag la rtsod pa byas so/ / phu bo na re/ khyod gangs te se la dbang phyug chen po bzhugs kyis der song la/ gang bzang dbang phyug rang la dris shig zer ro/ / der nu bos gangs ti se la phyin nas sgo phye byas pas/ de'i nang nas dge slong bdun nam mkha' la 'phur te rdzul 'phrul gyis song ngo*/ / de'i rjes la/ dbang phyug chen po yum dang bcas pa byung ba la/ dbang phyug khyed dang bcom ldan 'das gang bzang byas pas/ dbang phyug na re/ de de lta ma yin te/ go'u ta ma'i nyan thos bdun po 'di'ang nga'i mchod pa'i gnas yin na/ bcom ldan 'das nga bas bzang ba lta ci smos zer/ der pa ki la swa mi'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs so/ / ༈ sgyu ma la ni khyad ci yod/ /rgyal po'i khab na/ bzang po zhes pa sgyu ma'i rtul zhugs la shin tu mkhas pa des/ sgyu ma'i sgo nas skye'o/ / thams cad 'dun par byas kyang*/ 'khor rnam bzhi po sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul gyis ngos nas/ bzang pos mgo rmongs par bya ma nus pa'i tshe/ go tam thams cad mkhyen pa min par sgyu mas mgo rmongs par nus na/ skye bo ril bdag la 'dun par 'gyur ro/ / snyam nas thams cad mkhyen pa yin min sad par bya ba'i phyir/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la song ste/

sang bdag cag can gdugs tshod la byon par zhus pas/ bzang po 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ zhal gyis bzhes pa'i tshe/ mo'u 'gal gyis/ bzang po dad pa min par/ tho 'tsham pa la mi gshegs par zhus pas/ khyod snying las chung ngur gyis shig/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ de pa la sus kyang tho 'tsham par mi nus so gsung ngo*/ / der bzang pos rgyal khab tu sgyu ma'i khang bzangs su/ khri stan zas sogs bshams pas/ lha klu mir bcas thams cad tshogs te/ bzang pos de bzhin gshegs pa la tho 'tsham pa lta'o/ / de nas bsams pa/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas te byon pa la/ thams cad phyag mchod byed pa ltar na/ bdag gis mgo rmongs su gzhug par mi rigs snyam na/ rings par phyin nas/ nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ gdugs tshod la gzhan du gshegs par zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ sgyu ma'am sangs rgyas la sgyu ma'i bsnyen bkur gyis shig dang*/ 'bras bu sgyu ma'i sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs nas byon te/ 'khor rnams la/ ngas stan la ma bsdad par khyed rnams stan la ma 'dug cig/ ngas zas sogs la ma spyad par/ khyed rnams ma za zhig gsung nas byon pa'i tshe/ bzang pos/ gzhig par 'dod kyang gzhig ma nus par/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ ngas byin gyis brlabs pas gsung ste legs nas/ gang gis sbyin pa gang la btang*/ / sbyin pa ji ltar mi rtog pa/ / sbyin pa mnyam pa de nyid kyis/ / bzang po la ni yongs rdzogs shog/ ces dang*/ ngas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'o/ / zhes ma bstan nam/ zhes sogs gsungs nas bzang po dad par byas te/ 'thu 'bras bu la bkod do/ / sher phyin gyi le'u dgu pa'o/ / // ka10 le'u bcu pa'i skabs kyi gtam rgyud bshad pa/ ༈ grang pas nyams thag dro thob shog/ tsha grang la sogs ngan song gsum// zag bcas dge bas lha mi dang*/ / thabs mkhas dge bas 'tshang rgya zhes/ / blang dor zhib tu bshad par byas so/ / 'ga' zhig gis/ rten gsum sogs kyi nam bza' bshus pa dang*/

skam la gnas pa'i sems can chur skyur ba la sogs pas/ grang dmyal/ chu bur can dang*/ chu bur rdol ba dang*/ a chu zer ba dang*/ kye hud zer ba dang*/ so tham tham pa dang*/ ut+pal ltar gas pa dang*/ pad ma ltar cher gas pa ste/ brgyad po der skyes pa na/ sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod ni/ ming gis shes la/ tshe tshad ni/ mdzod las/ til sbyangs nang nas lo brgya zhing*/ /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin/ /gzhan gyi 'gyur ni nyi shu 'gyur/ /zhes sogs las rgyu 'bras zhib tu bshad do/ /༈ tsha bas nyams thag bsil bar shog/ 'gro ba drug gi tshig le'ur byas pa las/ chags dang gti mug 'jigs dang khros/ / mi gang mi ni gsod pa dang*/ / gzhan yang skyes nas bsad byas na/ / de dag yang sos 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/ med par lta ba gang zhig gis/ / chos dang chos min log ston zhing*/ / gzhan dag la ni nyon mongs byas/ / zhes sogs dang*/ yon tan dag gis che ba la/ / gnod pa drag po byas pa'am/ / pha ma bla ma bsad byas na/ / mi de mnar med bsreg par 'gyur/ / zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa ltar/ las de dang de dag bsags pas/ yang sos thig nag / bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med de/ tsha dmyal brgyad po der skyes pa na/ me de rnams kyis sreg pa shin tu bzod dka' ste/ tha mal gyi me dang*/ mgar ba'i me dang*/ tsan dan gyi me dang*/ dus mtha'i me dang*/ dmyal ba'i me brgyad po thams cad snga ma snga ma las/ phyi ma phyi ma rnams bzhi 'gyur gyis tsha'o/ / mo'u 'gal gyi bus/ dmyal ba'i me nyungs 'bru tsam zhig/ lhung bzed du khyer 'ongs pas/ gling bzhi'i mi dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha thams cad dmyal bar gyur te/ gzhan du dor yang sems can la gnod pa mkhyen nas rdzu 'phrul gyis chu bzhi'i rgyun phab ste/ zhi bar byas pa bzhin no/ / tshe tshad ni/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ / 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/

/des na de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin/ /rab tu tsha byed mnar med ni/ /bar gyi bskal ba'o/ / dud 'gro rnams/ mchog ring bskal ba'o/ / yi dwags rnams/ zla ba nyin zhag gis lnga brgya/ /zhes sogs ltar/ mdzod dang*/ 'gro ba drug gi tshigs bcad sogs sbyar te/ ngan song de rnams kyi rgyu/ tshe tshad/ lus tshad/ sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod kyi tshad sogs zhib tu bshad nas/ spang bya dang nyes dmigs kyi gnyen po'i sgo nas/ gdul bya 'jigs shing skrag pa skyed nus par yang bshad do/ ༈ lha rnams dang lhan cig dal gyis 'bab gnas shog/ zag bcas kyi dge ba 'ga' byas pas/

gling bzhi'i mi dang*/ 'dod pa khams kyi lha rigs drug dang*/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun dang*/ gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi sogs su skyes pa na/ de dag gi lus tshad/ tshe tshad de/ bde ba'i longs spyod kyi tshad la sogs pa'i sgo nas zag bcas kyi bde ba rgyu 'bras dang*/ yang*/ skye mched dam bsngo bas zin pa'i dge ba 'ga' bsags pas/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu lam lnga sa bcu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zag med kyi yon tan sde tshan nyer gcig dang ldan pa sogs zhib tu bshad de/ blang dor gyi gnas la mkhas par bya'o/ / le'u bcu pa'o/ / // gsum pa/ mjug gi don bshad pa/ thub pa'i gsung dang de yi dgongs 'grel rnams/ / dpang du byas te legs par bshad mod na'ang*/ / bdag blo byis pa'i dbang gyur 'gal 'khrul rnams/ / dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ / bdag gi phan sems rgya mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ / sgrung 'grail ngo mtshar rin chen phreng ba 'di/ / skye rgu'i blo yi dbul ba gtan bcom nas/ / kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig/ bdag kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ste/ thos bsam sgom pa'i dpal 'byor gyis phyug cing*/ /'bras bu sku bzhi'i dngos grub myur thob nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i dpal la spyod par shog/ dpe legs la dag pa 'di/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa/ yon tan dbang phyug gis bsam pa bzang ba'i bsgo nas/ bzhengs pa lags/ maṅgaṃ laṃ bha wan+tu/ shubhaṃ/ zhus dag / / / mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel/ spyod 'jug sgrung 'grel las 'bras gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 54--PAGE 53--PAGE 1-
